jobs.title: Academy Performance & Planning Lead (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking an experienced Academy Performance & Planning Lead to play a crucial role in driving the success of our training and development initiatives in Saudi Arabia. The KAUST Academy Performance & Planning Lead is a key operational role responsible for managing the academy's strategic planning, performance reporting, and financial forecasting. This position coordinates the annual budget development, tracks strategic initiatives for board-level reporting, and manages risk and audit compliance. The Lead also provides high-level project management for new initiatives, develops long-range revenue projections, and oversees the academy's policy and procedures framework to ensure operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement strategic plans for academy programs, ensuring alignment with business objectives and workforce development needs.
  • Reporting & Analysis: Design and produce all academy reports related to program performance, cost-benefit analysis, and revenue generation, providing insights and recommendations for improvement.
  • Budgeting & Financial Planning: Lead the development of the academy's annual budget in collaboration with program managers and central operations.
  • Revenue Forecasting: Develop multi-year revenue projections for each program, monitor financial execution against targets, and provide regular forecasts.
  • Monitor and evaluate program performance by analyzing data and metrics to measure effectiveness and identify areas for improvement.
  • Risk & Audit Management: Monitor, track, and manage the closure of all risk and audit observations for the academy, ensuring timely resolution and compliance.
  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders to understand training needs and translate them into actionable training strategies.
  • Oversee the design and delivery of training programs, ensuring they meet quality standards and achieve desired outcomes.
  • Provide leadership to the academy team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional development.
  • Prepare regular reports and presentations for senior management, showcasing program performance and key insights.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, or a related quantitative field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in a strategic planning, financial planning & analysis (FP&A), or business operations management role.
  • Prior experience in Design and produce all academy reports related to program performance, cost-benefit analysis, and revenue generation, providing insights and recommendations for improvement.
  • Experience in development of the academy's annual budget in collaboration with program managers and central operations.
  • Strong understanding of performance management principles and methodologies.
  • Proven ability to analyze data and translate it into meaningful insights for program improvement.
  • Excellent leadership and team management skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence and build relationships at all levels.

jobs.title: Accountant / Administrative Officer (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is is seeking a detail-oriented Accountant/Administrative Officer to manage daily accounting operations alongside vendor management and procurement activities. The role combines financial responsibilities with purchasing and supplier coordination to ensure smooth business operations, cost efficiency, and accurate financial reporting.

Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate bookkeeping records, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, and inter-company transactions
  • Perform monthly bank reconciliations and resolve discrepancies
  • Support internal and external audits with required documentation
  • Manage vendor relationships and ensure timely procurement of goods and services
  • Create, process, and track purchase orders in line with company policies
  • Monitor inventory levels and coordinate restocking with suppliers
  • Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and delivery schedules with vendors
  • Prepare VAT-related documents and assist with VAT and corporate tax (CIT) filings
  • Track orders and resolve delivery issues or discrepancies
  • Maintain vendor contracts and manage renewals or terminations

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field
  • Proven experience in accounting or a similar finance role
  • Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., ERP systems, Excel, or similar tools)
  • Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Good organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Strong communication skills in English (written and verbal)
  • Ability to handle both financial and administrative responsibilities efficiently

jobs.title: Accountant / Bookkeeper
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is looking for a meticulous and reliable Accountant/Bookkeeper to manage accurate financial records and ensure the integrity of all accounting transactions. The Accountant/Bookkeeper maintains accurate financial records and supports reporting, payroll, and analysis to enable sound financial management and timely decision-making. Reporting to the Operations Manager, the role owns day-to-day bookkeeping including journal entries, accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliations, and ledger maintenance. It prepares periodic financial statements and management reports, processes payroll and related statutory deductions, supports budgeting and cashflow tracking, monitors expenses against budget, and assists with audits, tax filings, and compliance. The role also provides financial analysis and insights to support operational and commercial decisions, coordinating cross-functionally with HR on payroll and with operations on budgets. The ideal candidate has 3–5 years of relevant experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Record and maintain all financial transactions including purchases, sales, receipts, and payments.
  • Maintain and update general ledgers and reconcile accounts.
  • Prepare bank reconciliations and ensure discrepancies are resolved timely.
  • Assist with payroll processing and related accounting entries.
  • Prepare and submit timely financial reports to management.
  • Full-cycle bookkeeping: journals, AP/AR, ledger maintenance, and bank reconciliations
  • Financial statement preparation and periodic management reporting
  • Payroll processing and statutory deductions/compliance
  • Budgeting, cashflow monitoring, and expense control
  • Financial analysis, variance analysis, and reporting dashboards
  • Audit support, tax filing, and regulatory compliance
  • Chart of accounts management and month-end/year-end close

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; part-qualified certification (e.g., CPA, ACCA, CMA) is an advantage
  • 3 - 5 years of proven experience as an accountant or bookkeeper.
  • Accounting software proficiency (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho, or similar)
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles and practices.
  • Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Office (Excel in particular).
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Good communication skills in English (both written and verbal).
  • Knowledge of local tax and VAT regulations is a plus.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Analyst (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is looking for a detail-oriented and efficient Accounts Payable Analyst to join our finance team in Saudi Arabia. Responsible for handling payment processing, reconciliations, vendor accounts, and financial reporting activities. Ensure invoices, bank transactions, and payment records are processed accurately and on time while supporting smooth Accounts Payable operations.

Responsibilities

  • Process and record supplier invoices and payments on a daily basis.
  • Monitor and reconcile bank transactions and payment records.
  • Reconcile vendor advances against invoices and follow up on pending items.
  • Upload POS reports and related bank transactions when required.
  • Reconcile clearing accounts and follow up on open items.
  • Prepare monthly payable and ageing reports.
  • Follow up with vendors and internal departments to resolve invoice discrepancies.
  • Respond to finance and vendor inquiries in a timely manner.
  • Ensure proper filing and documentation of AP transactions.
  • Escalate unresolved issues to the AP Specialist or Supervisor.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in accounts payable or similar role.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, or Finance
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in Accounts Payable or Finance
  • Good knowledge of Excel, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint
  • Familiarity with ERP systems
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial transactions

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Analyst (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Accounts Payable Analyst is responsible for managing and supporting Accounts Payable activities, ensuring accurate and timely processing of invoices, payments, reconciliations, reporting, and vendor accounts. The role will also provide financial analysis, ERP support, and management reporting while ensuring compliance with financial procedures and internal controls.

Key Responsibilities

  • Process and verify invoices, payment requests, and Accounts Payable transactions accurately and on time.
  • Perform Accounts Payable ledger reconciliations, identify discrepancies, validate transactions, and ensure timely settlement of outstanding amounts.
  • Prepare and consolidate aging reports, aged liabilities, outstanding exceptions, GRIR, and vendor statements.
  • Perform control account reconciliations and weekly bank reconciliations.
  • Manage prepayment accounting, advances, retention payments, and rejected transactions.
  • Process KAUST payments, P-Card and claims payments, including reconciliation and clearance.
  • Respond to vendor inquiries and resolve Accounts Payable-related issues promptly.
  • Prepare financial trend analysis, management reports, and presentations for senior management.
  • Support the development of Business Intelligence (BI) reports for Accounts Payable activities.
  • Ensure accurate financial records and compliance with Accounts Payable procedures, internal controls, SLAs, and KPIs.
  • Support SAP ERP system implementation, administration, and ongoing Finance operations.
  • Collect business requirements and identify opportunities to streamline Accounts Payable processes and eliminate non-value-added activities.
  • Coordinate with business managers and internal stakeholders to ensure accurate period-end reporting.
  • Handle urgent requests and multiple priorities while maintaining high-quality service.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in Accounts Payable or accounting within a complex organization.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Accounts Payable operations, including invoice processing, payment processing, reconciliations, aging analysis, and vendor accounts.
  • Proven experience working with SAP ERP / SAP Financial Module.
  • Familiarity with Concur is preferred.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience in financial reporting, reconciliation, and management reporting.
  • Strong understanding of financial controls, accounting procedures, and governance.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and operate effectively in a complex environment.

jobs.title: Administrative Assistant
jobs.description:

In this role, you will be responsible for a variety of administrative functions, including handling phone inquiries, managing appointment schedules, processing documents, and ensuring that the office operates smoothly. Your professionalism and interpersonal skills will be essential as you interact with staff, clients, and stakeholders.

  • Prepare and organize documentation for reports and presentations.
  • Maintain filing systems and ensure that all documents are updated and accessible.
  • Support the team with various projects and tasks as needed.
  • Handle inquiries from clients and stakeholders in a timely and professional manner.
  • Assist in the planning and coordination of company events and meetings.

Requirements

  • At least 3 years of administrative experience is preferred.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage time effectively and prioritize tasks appropriately.
  • Experience with office equipment and technology.
  • Team-oriented with a positive attitude and willingness to assist others.

jobs.title: Administrative Assistant
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to support our operations. jobs.title: Asphalt Formulation Specialist - Production (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent, a premier talent acquisition consultancy, is actively seeking an Asphalt Formulation Specialist - Production to join a leading company in Saudi Arabia. The Asphalt Formulation Specialist will be responsible for developing and optimizing asphalt formulations by selecting and combining diverse mix components - including aggregates, binders, fillers, and innovative additives - to achieve required performance and durability standards. The role emphasizes experimentation with novel and sustainable materials and other emerging technologies t.
The specialist will design and conduct laboratory trials, evaluating material properties and mix performance in accordance with ASTM, AASHTO, and local standards. They will analyze test data to refine formulations, ensuring that laboratory results accurately predict field behavior and that the final mix consistently meets all technical specifications and quality requirements.
In addition, the role involves assessing raw material, introducing new materials or processes, and possibly collaborating with research partners, suppliers, and asphalt plants to validate innovative solutions. The specialist will provide technical guidance on formulation adjustments, production troubleshooting, and performance optimization.

If selected, the job location would be in Jeddah Saudi Arabia.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and optimize asphalt formulations to meet project specifications and performance criteria.
  • Conduct laboratory tests and analysis to evaluate the properties of asphalt and related materials.
  • Collaborate with production teams to implement formulations in the manufacturing process.
  • Ensure all production activities comply with relevant safety, environmental, and technical standards (e.g., ASTM, AASHTO, local regulations).
  • Oversee and manage the daily asphalt production process at the plant to ensure quality, efficiency, and safety.
  • Monitor production processes and performance metrics to ensure compliance with quality standards.
  • Perform troubleshooting for formulation issues and implement corrective actions as needed.
  • Stay updated with industry trends and advances in asphalt technology.
  • Identify and troubleshoot plant or process issues affecting mix consistency or plant performance
  • Prepare detailed documentation and reports on formulation developments and testing results.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in asphalt formulation and production.
  • Strong knowledge of asphalt materials, chemical additives, and testing methodologies.
  • Solid understanding of asphalt mixing processes, production equipment, and quality control standards.
  • Familiarity with ASTM, AASHTO, and local road construction specifications.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure in a plant environment.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills, especially when working with QC, lab, or design teams.
  • Experience with plant troubleshooting, process improvement, or automation is a plus.
  • Knowledge of sustainable or innovative production practices is desirable.

jobs.title: Building Automation Maintenance Engineer (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Building Automation Maintenance Engineer (Maintenance Engineer – Systems) will be responsible for maintaining, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuously improving the Niagara 4-based Automation System (IKAS) and Integrated Fire Alarm Automation System (IFAS). The role involves system health monitoring, fault diagnosis, user and system administration, software backup management, network coordination, and support for automation system expansion and optimization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor IKAS/IFAS functionality and prepare daily system health reports.
  • Investigate system alarms and faults, identify root causes, and implement corrective solutions.
  • Create and manage Niagara 4 user accounts according to approved access levels.
  • Monitor and log system-user activities and report security or access violations.
  • Manage software backups and perform system restoration when required.
  • Coordinate with IT teams to resolve network, server, and virtual machine issues.
  • Support maintenance teams in resolving communication issues between Niagara and connected equipment/devices.
  • Configure Niagara machine IP addresses, network settings, and server communication ports.
  • Provide after-hours technical support when required.
  • Perform system optimization, fine-tuning, and performance improvement activities.
  • Develop and configure SQL database scripts for reporting requirements.
  • Maintain automation-related IT equipment, including servers, workstations, and JACE controllers.
  • Investigate and resolve security alerts raised by Operations and IT departments.
  • Support system expansion projects and ensure vendor/contractor compliance with approved specifications.
  • Continuously develop and maintain Niagara platforms, including system configuration and graphics accuracy.
  • Conduct audits and inspections of automation systems.
  • Develop software solutions to improve system performance and operational efficiency.
  • Prepare monthly system status and performance reports.
  • Coordinate technical activities with software developers and automation system vendors.
  • Collaborate with various departments to develop and implement smart automation solutions.
  • Develop departmental performance, operational, and statistical dashboards.
  • Manage Tridium SMA agreements for Niagara stations, including software patches, bug fixes, and version upgrades.

Required Competencies

  • Knowledge of Niagara 4, including Java and HTML5 implementation.
  • Strong knowledge of Building Automation Systems (BAS).
  • Knowledge of energy conservation and building energy optimization.
  • Strong problem-solving and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) skills.
  • Good knowledge of fire alarm, lighting control, and power monitoring systems.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (BSc) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or an equivalent approved discipline.
  • Good knowledge of Building Automation Systems and related security/automation systems.

Experience

  • Minimum 7 years of overall experience in the relevant automation/building systems domain.
  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with Niagara platform-based Building Automation Systems.
  • Experience in Niagara 4 system administration, troubleshooting, configuration, and maintenance.
  • Experience with BAS/IBMS, fire alarm, lighting control, power monitoring, and related automation systems is preferred.

jobs.title: Business Analysts (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
We are seeking experienced Business Analysts to analyze business requirements, improve business processes, and translate business needs into effective technology and operational solutions.

The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, project managers, and subject-matter experts to understand business objectives, document requirements, identify process improvements, and support the successful delivery of projects and initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with business stakeholders to understand business objectives, challenges, and requirements.
  • Conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, and requirement-gathering sessions.
  • Analyze and document current (“As-Is”) business processes and define future (“To-Be”) processes.
  • Translate business requirements into clear and actionable functional requirements.
  • Prepare Business Requirements Documents (BRD), Functional Requirements Specifications (FRS), user stories, use cases, and process flows.
  • Identify gaps, inefficiencies, risks, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Work closely with technical teams to ensure business requirements are clearly understood and implemented.
  • Facilitate communication between business users, IT teams, vendors, and project stakeholders.
  • Support solution evaluation and provide business input into proposed solutions.
  • Participate in requirements validation, solution walkthroughs, and design reviews.
  • Develop and maintain process maps, workflow diagrams, and data-flow diagrams.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test-scenario preparation, test-case review, and defect clarification.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience as a Business Analyst.
  • Experience in business/process analysis and requirements management.
  • Strong experience working with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Good understanding of SDLC and project delivery methodologies.
  • Experience with tools such as Microsoft Visio, Excel, PowerPoint, Jira, Confluence, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience in the Oil & Gas, Energy, Utilities, Industrial, or other large enterprise environments.
  • Experience with digital transformation, ERP, enterprise applications, or process improvement projects.
  • Knowledge of Agile, Scrum, BPMN, BABOK, or ITIL.

jobs.title: Business Architect (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is looking for a talented Business Architect to join our dynamic team in Saudi Arabia. As a Business Architect, you will play a critical role in bridging business strategy and technology solutions to maximize the achievement of business objectives. You will work collaboratively with stakeholders across the organization to analyze processes, systems, and data, ensuring alignment between business needs and technology capabilities.

Your role will involve defining business architecture strategies, creating roadmaps, and documenting business processes to enhance operational efficiency and enable business transformation initiatives. We are seeking a strategic thinker with a solid understanding of both business and technology landscapes, capable of driving innovation and guiding organizations through change.

This position requires a strong focus on stakeholder engagement and communication, as you will liaise with cross-functional teams to deliver business value effectively.

If selected, the job location would be onsite in Saudi Arabia.

Job Description

  • Translate business strategy, operating models and processes into business architecture artifacts that guide enterprise initiatives and technology alignment.
  • Develop and maintain business architecture frameworks that support long-term business goals and objectives.
  • Collaborate with business units to identify their needs and develop solutions that align with the overall strategy.
  • Analyze and document current business processes to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Facilitate workshops and meetings with stakeholders to gather requirements and drive consensus around business architecture initiatives.
  • Work closely with IT teams to ensure that technology solutions align with and support business strategies.
  • Monitor industry trends and best practices to ensure that business architecture remains relevant and effective.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 12 years of experience in business architecture, business analysis, or a related role.
  • Strong understanding of business process modeling and improvement techniques.
  • Proven experience in stakeholder management and ability to communicate complex ideas clearly.
  • Knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks and methodologies (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman) is an advantage.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and driving collaboration.
  • Ability to think strategically and practically to solve complex business challenges.
  • Fluency in English; knowledge of Arabic is an added advantage.

jobs.title: Campus & Community Engagement Specialist (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Campus & Community Engagement Specialist supports the planning, coordination and delivery of communication activities across Campus & Community. The role contributes to communication campaigns, content development, digital channel updates and stakeholder coordination, while maintaining consistency with KAUST and C&C standards.

 

The role is expected to work with increasing independence, exercise sound editorial judgement, and support the Engagement Lead in coordinating communication outputs. It provides operational and content support while building the capability to deputize for selected activities during periods of absence and progress toward broader communication leadership responsibilities.

Responsibilities

  • Support the planning, development, and delivery of targeted communication and engagement campaigns across designated channels.
  • Draft clear, accurate, and audience-appropriate copy, content briefs, executive summaries, and regular campaign updates.
  • Publish approved announcements and manage, update, and maintain assigned sections of the C&C website using CMS platforms.
  • Create, schedule, and publish approved content while monitoring basic performance metrics across social media tools.
  • Support the creation of key visuals, layouts, and multimedia content assets using Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Ensure strict consistency in tone, style, and messaging across all materials in alignment with KAUST and C&C branding guidelines.
  • Coordinate directly with internal proponents, GBC, consultants, and external service partners to clarify objectives, timelines, and audience needs.
  • Provide rigorous proofreading, fact-checking, and basic quality control, translating technical service updates into clear, accessible messages.
  • Monitor personal deliverables, strictly follow established approval workflows, and maintain transparent task visibility using project tracking software.
  • Provide day-to-day operational support, step up to lead select activities during team absences, and work flexible hours for events.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Media, Copywriting, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in marketing, copywriting, or corporate communications.
  • Practical experience in website publishing via CMS platforms and using social media scheduling and analytics tools.
  • Basic graphic design capability using Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or similar, with preferred photography and video editing experience.
  • Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills with high attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Strong editorial judgment to identify content risks, gaps in approvals, or issues that require immediate escalation.
  • Proven ability to remain organized, manage multiple strict deadlines, and provide reliable follow-through on assigned tasks.
  • Demonstrated capacity to work independently on defined tasks while following appropriate guidance.
  • Professional confidence to coordinate routine matters with cross-functional internal teams, service partners, and external stakeholders.

jobs.title: Change Management & Communications Specialist (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Change Management & Communications Specialist to support enterprise-wide transformation initiatives by ensuring the successful adoption of new business processes, systems, and organizational changes. The successful candidate will develop and execute change management strategies, engage stakeholders at all organizational levels, and create effective communication plans that promote awareness, understanding, and adoption of change initiatives. The role requires close collaboration with business leaders, project teams, and subject matter experts to minimize resistance, improve employee readiness, and ensure the successful delivery of transformation programs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement change management and communication plans for business transformation projects.
  • Conduct stakeholder engagement, change impact, and organizational readiness assessments.
  • Prepare communication materials, presentations, newsletters, and awareness campaigns.
  • Coordinate training activities and support employees during organizational changes.
  • Monitor change adoption, collect feedback, and prepare progress reports for management.
  • Facilitate workshops, meetings, and discussions with stakeholders and project teams.
  • Support digital transformation initiatives and ensure smooth implementation of new processes and ways of working.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Communications, Organizational Psychology, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Change Management, Organizational Development, or Business Transformation.
  • Experience in stakeholder management, change impact assessment, and organizational readiness activities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in Arabic and English.
  • Good knowledge of change management methodologies such as Prosci ADKAR or Kotter's Change Model.
  • Experience supporting digital transformation or ERP implementation projects is preferred.
  • Professional certifications such as Prosci, CCMP, or Business Communications are an advantage.

jobs.title: Change Management & Training Specialist
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Change Management & Training Specialist to support organizational transformation, business improvement, and operational change initiatives within a large-scale industrial environment.

The role will be responsible for developing and executing change management strategies, stakeholder engagement plans, communication activities, and training programs to ensure successful adoption of new processes, systems, technologies, policies, and organizational initiatives.

The successful candidate will work closely with leadership, project teams, subject matter experts, and employees to assess change impacts, manage resistance, build organizational readiness, and ensure employees have the knowledge and capabilities required to successfully transition to new ways of working.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement comprehensive Change Management Plans for organizational, operational, digital, and business transformation initiatives.
  • Conduct change impact assessments to identify how changes will affect employees, processes, roles, systems, and business operations.
  • Develop stakeholder engagement strategies and communication plans aligned with project and organizational objectives.
  • Identify potential resistance to change and develop appropriate mitigation and engagement strategies.
  • Assess organizational readiness and develop action plans to improve change adoption.
  • Work closely with project managers, business leaders, subject matter experts, and functional teams throughout the change lifecycle.
  • Develop and deliver training programs, workshops, awareness sessions, and briefing sessions to support organizational change.
  • Conduct Training Needs Analysis (TNA) based on business requirements, competency gaps, and upcoming organizational changes.
  • Develop training materials, presentations, user guides, manuals, procedures, FAQs, and other learning resources.
  • Coordinate with subject matter experts to ensure training content accurately reflects new processes, systems, procedures, and operational requirements.
  • Facilitate instructor-led and virtual training sessions for employees and stakeholders.
  • Support the development and implementation of train-the-trainer programs where required.
  • Monitor training participation, knowledge transfer, competency development, and employee adoption.
  • Collect feedback from employees and stakeholders and incorporate findings into continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Establish and track change adoption, readiness, training completion, and effectiveness KPIs.
  • Prepare regular progress reports, dashboards, and presentations for management.
  • Support post-implementation activities to ensure sustained adoption of new processes, systems, and organizational practices.
  • Develop communication materials including announcements, newsletters, presentations, awareness campaigns, and change updates.
  • Ensure change and training activities are aligned with organizational policies, procedures, standards, and business objectives.
  • Maintain appropriate documentation, training records, attendance records, assessments, and change management deliverables.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Organizational Development, Management, Education, Psychology, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in Change Management, Organizational Development, Learning & Development, Training, or transformation-related roles.
  • Experience working within large-scale industrial, energy, oil & gas, engineering, or other complex operational environments is highly preferred.
  • Proven experience supporting organizational transformation, business process improvement, digital transformation, system implementation, or operational change initiatives.
  • Strong experience in developing and delivering professional training programs.
  • Experience conducting Training Needs Analysis and developing competency-based training programs.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills across different organizational levels.
  • Excellent presentation, facilitation, interpersonal, and influencing skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.

Preferred Certifications

  • Prosci Change Management Certification
  • CCMP – Certified Change Management Professional
  • APMG Change Management Certification
  • PMP / Project Management Certification
  • CIPD
  • ATD / CPTD
  • Relevant Learning & Development or Organizational Development certifications

jobs.title: Chemical Engineer - Saudi Arabia
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Chemical Engineer to support process design, optimization, and technical operations within our oil and gas facilities. The ideal candidate will contribute to safe, reliable, and efficient production by applying advanced engineering principles to refining, petrochemical processing, or upstream production systems.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and update PFDs, P&IDs, and process simulations.
  • Optimize plant processes to improve production, energy use, and cost efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot operational issues and support daily plant activities.
  • Participate in HAZOP, PHA, and safety compliance activities.
  • Prepare technical specifications and support project engineering tasks.
  • Monitor key process parameters and provide performance reports.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering (Master’s a plus).
  • 3–7 years experience in oil & gas, refinery, or petrochemical plants.
  • Proficient in process simulation tools (Aspen HYSYS, Aspen Plus).
  • Strong knowledge of process safety and industry standards (API, ASME).
  • Good communication and problem-solving skills.

Benefits

Salary is not a constraint ,company is looking for right candidate .

jobs.title: CIP / Sterilization Operator (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a skilled CIP / Sterilization Operator to join a reputable company in Saudi Arabia. The CIP (Clean-In-Place) / Sterilization Operator will be responsible for executing cleaning and sterilization procedures for production equipment and pipelines to ensure aseptic conditions are maintained according to industry standards. This role is vital for maintaining product quality, safety, and hygiene within manufacturing environments such as food, beverage, pharmaceutical, or biotech facilities.

Responsibilities

  • Operate CIP system according to standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Monitor cleaning cycles, temperatures, chemical concentrations, and flow rates.
  • Prepare cleaning solutions and ensure proper handling of chemicals.
  • Inspect equipment before and after cleaning for proper sanitation.
  • Record cleaning data accurately in logs or digital systems.
  • Report any malfunctions, deviations, or safety concerns immediately.
  • Collaborate closely with production, quality control, and maintenance teams to coordinate cleaning schedules and troubleshoot issues.
  • Adhere to safety, hygiene, and environmental regulations at all times.

Requirements

  • Diploma or degree in Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, Food Technology, or related field preferred.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience operating CIP and sterilization systems in food, pharmaceutical, or biotech industries.
  • Strong knowledge of CIP processes, sterilization techniques, and cleaning validation protocols.
  • Ability to read and follow SOPs and technical documentation accurately.
  • Good mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills for equipment operation.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to maintaining hygiene and safety standards.
  • Ability to work in shifts and in a team environment.
  • Basic computer skills for data documentation and reporting.

jobs.title: Civil / Structural Designer (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Civil/Structural Designer to join our engineering team. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing high-quality civil and structural design deliverables, including 2D drawings, 3D models, layouts, and construction drawings for industrial and Oil & Gas facilities.

The role requires strong experience in structural steel and concrete modelling, foundations, pipe racks, equipment support structures, underground utilities, and multidisciplinary coordination throughout FEED and Detailed Engineering project phases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain 2D and 3D civil and structural design models and drawings.
  • Prepare detailed drawings for structural steel, concrete structures, foundations, pipe racks, platforms, shelters, buildings, and equipment support structures.
  • Prepare foundation layouts, pile layouts, structural framing plans, sections, elevations, and detailed construction drawings.
  • Develop and update 3D models using SmartPlant 3D (SP3D), Smart 3D (S3D), AVEVA E3D, or similar modelling software.
  • Prepare General Arrangement (GA) drawings, fabrication drawings, reinforcement drawings, and Material Take-Offs (MTO).
  • Coordinate with Civil/Structural Engineers and other disciplines including Piping, Mechanical, Electrical, and Process teams.
  • Perform model reviews and clash detection to ensure proper interdisciplinary coordination and constructability.
  • Incorporate engineering calculations, vendor data, equipment loads, and project specifications into design deliverables.
  • Ensure all drawings and models comply with project specifications, company procedures, client standards, and applicable international codes.
  • Review and incorporate engineering comments and revisions during FEED, Detailed Engineering, and construction stages.
  • Support site activities, technical queries, field modifications, and construction-related design requirements.
  • Maintain quality and accuracy of design deliverables within agreed project schedules.

Requirements

  • Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 8–12 years of relevant experience as a Civil/Structural Designer.
  • Strong experience in the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Industrial, or EPC industry.
  • Experience in FEED and Detailed Engineering projects is highly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience in structural steel and reinforced concrete modelling and detailing.
  • Strong experience with pipe racks, equipment support structures, platforms, shelters, foundations, and underground utilities.
  • Proficiency in SmartPlant 3D (SP3D), Smart 3D (S3D), or AVEVA E3D.
  • Good working knowledge of MicroStation and AutoCAD.
  • Experience in extracting drawings, MTOs, and other deliverables from 3D modelling systems.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, calculations, specifications, and vendor documents.
  • Familiarity with international structural and civil design standards.
  • Experience working in multidisciplinary engineering environments.
  • Good communication and coordination skills.

jobs.title: Civil Construction Manager (EPC) - Oil Gas Separation Projects
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is actively seeking a highly skilled Construction Manager on behalf of a prestigious client operating in the Saudi Arabian oil and gas sector.

Our client requires a seasoned leader to oversee critical construction phases on major Saudi Aramco projects. The ideal candidate will bring a robust background in civil construction and mechanical/equipment installation works, coupled with a proven ability to manage both local and international subcontractors effectively.

Candidates bringing successful execution experience in Saudi Aramco Gas Oil Separation Plant (GOSP) projects will be highly prioritized for this role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Project Execution & Site Management: * Direct and oversee all daily construction activities on the client’s site, focusing heavily on civil engineering and installation works.
    • Ensure all construction phases are completed on schedule, within budget, and in strict compliance with Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards (SAES).
  • Subcontractor Management: * Actively manage, evaluate, and coordinate with a diverse network of international and local subcontractors on behalf of the client.
    • Ensure subcontractors are fully aligned with project deliverables, schedules, and stringent safety mandates.
  • Quality & Safety Assurance: * Champion a zero-incident safety culture, ensuring total compliance with Saudi Aramco’s safety protocols (e.g., work permit systems, GI requirements).
    • Collaborate with QA/QC teams to guarantee that all civil and installation works pass client inspections and meet all contractual quality benchmarks.
  • Planning & Reporting: * Review and approve construction methodologies, project schedules, and resource allocation plans.
    • Provide regular, detailed progress reports to the project leadership and client representatives, mitigating risks and resolving site bottlenecks promptly.

Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.

Aramco Experience: Extensive, verifiable experience working directly on Saudi Aramco projects as a Construction Manager or in a senior site leadership capacity.

Technical Expertise: Solid, hands-on experience managing heavy civil works and complex installation phases in the oil & gas or heavy industrial sectors.

Subcontractor Leadership: Proven track record of successfully integrating, managing, and driving performance from a mixed portfolio of subcontractors.

Knowledge: Deep understanding of Saudi Aramco standards, procedures, and safety regulations.

Priority Qualifications:

  • GOSP Experience: Candidates with a successful track record in the execution and delivery of Saudi Aramco Gas Oil Separation projects will be given absolute priority during the shortlisting process.
  • Certifications: PMP, OSHA, or specific Aramco approvals (e.g., a previously approved Aramco SAP number) are a distinct advantage.

jobs.title: Civil Engineer - Transportation Planning & Traffic Engineering (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is a leading recruitment company focused on connecting top talent with industry leaders. We are currently looking for a skilled Civil Engineer specializing in Transportation Planning & Traffic Engineering to join our team in Saudi Arabia. This role involves working on the design, analysis, and implementation of transportation systems that enhance mobility and ensure safety on the roads.

As a Civil Engineer in this field, you will be responsible for conducting traffic studies, developing transportation plans, and collaborating with various stakeholders to improve traffic flow and reduce congestion. You will utilize advanced modeling tools and technologies to assess current transportation systems and propose innovative solutions that address both operational and environmental concerns.

If selected, the work location would be onsite at Saudi Arabia.

Responsibilities

  • Interface with company representatives and government authorities to address traffic and transportation safety improvements in the Eastern Province.
  • To act as a technical lead to various traffic safety engineering related work tasks. To oversee work being carried out by subordinate members of the engineering group. To support and guide work being undertaken by group members.
  • To review and assist in developing scope-of-works for the company’s projects/studies (e.g., Road Safety audit, Traffic Impact study, Temporary Traffic Management, etc.)
  • To review and provide initial inputs on design, specifications of existing/proposed roadway schemes within and around company facilities utilizing applicable industry standards and guidelines.
  • To prepare letters, meeting notes, working papers, technical notes, reports and technical presentations.
  • To enhance Traffic Safety Services Dept. - Engineering group staffs’ technical capacity by: establish proper training and develop efficient processes for knowledge sharing/transfer.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in transportation planning and traffic engineering.
  • The candidate shall have technical proficiency in Highway Design, Transportation Planning & Traffic Safety Studies
  • The candidate shall to be familiar with using international standards such as AASHTO-Green Book, HCM, HSM, MUTCD, and related ITE & FHWA guidelines.
  • Certification Requirement: The candidate must be professional certified & licensed (i.e., PE, PTOE, PTP, RoSPA, or RSP)
  • Proficient in traffic modeling software (e.g., VISSIM, SYNCHRO, HCS).
  • Strong knowledge of transportation engineering principles, policies, and standards.
  • Experience in conducting traffic studies and designing signal plans.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective communication and teamwork abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

jobs.title: Civil Maintenance Engineer (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The Maintenance Engineer (Civil) is responsible for ensuring that buildings, architectural assets, and external areas are maintained in a safe, functional, and aesthetically acceptable condition. The role ensures compliance with KAUST standards, specifications, applicable building codes, and maintenance best practices. The position also monitors maintenance quality, conducts inspections and audits, assesses asset conditions, and recommends corrective and preventive actions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor the quality of civil and architectural maintenance works performed by service providers.
  • Conduct inspections and audits of existing facilities, ongoing maintenance activities, and completed works to ensure compliance with approved standards and specifications.
  • Participate in construction inspections, project handovers, walkthroughs, snagging, and verification of rectification works.
  • Audit preventive maintenance programs and ensure planned inspections and maintenance activities are completed as scheduled.
  • Audit reactive maintenance work orders, identify recurring issues, and recommend corrective and preventive measures.
  • Conduct condition assessments of civil and architectural assets and recommend repair, refurbishment, or replacement as required.
  • Review maintenance plans, task lists, failure modes, failure codes, and causes, and recommend improvements.
  • Monitor PM/RM/CM work orders and support initiatives to reduce maintenance backlogs.
  • Conduct incident and failure investigations, perform root cause analysis, and recommend actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Prepare inspection, audit, condition assessment, and maintenance reports and provide technical recommendations for facility improvements.
  • Ensure maintenance activities comply with applicable KAUST standards, specifications, building codes, and industry best practices.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or equivalent.
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in building maintenance, civil/architectural inspections, audits, construction, or facilities management.
  • Experience in design, construction, quality inspection, project handover, and snagging is desirable.
  • Experience with maintenance management systems/CMMS such as SAP or Maximo is desirable.

Technical & Professional Competencies

  • Working knowledge of AutoCAD and Microsoft Office.
  • Good knowledge of building construction, architectural finishes, civil works, and maintenance practices.
  • Working knowledge of applicable building codes, standards, and specifications.
  • Ability to conduct inspections, audits, condition assessments, and root cause analysis.
  • Ability to perform mid-level data analysis, including auditing, assessing, deducing, and drawing conclusions.
  • Familiarity with USGBC LEED requirements is desirable.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and reporting skills.

jobs.title: Civil Supervisor - Maintenance (Water Utility) - Saudi Arabia
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is currently seeking a skilled Civil Supervisor - Maintenance specializing in Water Utility for a position based in Saudi Arabia. The Civil Supervisor is responsible for supervising and coordinating all civil maintenance activities related to water utility infrastructure, ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient operation of facilities. The role includes preventive, corrective, and emergency maintenance of civil assets such as reservoirs, pump stations, pipelines, chambers, concrete structures, buildings, drainage systems, roads, and utility infrastructure.

The candidate must possess strong technical expertise in civil maintenance within the water utility industry, with hands-on experience in maintenance planning, execution, workforce supervision, and compliance with safety and quality standards.

Responsibilities

  • Supervise and coordinate all civil maintenance activities for water utility infrastructure and facilities.
  • Execute preventive, corrective, and emergency maintenance works to ensure uninterrupted operations.
  • Monitor maintenance and repair of reservoirs, pump stations, pipelines, valve chambers, and drainage systems.

  • Coordinate with operations, mechanical, and electrical departments during shutdowns and maintenance execution.
  • Prepare maintenance reports, inspection records, work progress updates, and support continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Strong technical knowledge of civil maintenance for pipelines, concrete structures, pump stations, and utility facilities.
  • Hands-on experience in preventive, corrective, and emergency maintenance planning and execution.
  • Ability to read and interpret civil drawings, structural layouts, and maintenance documentation.
  • Good understanding of HSE standards, permit-to-work systems, and quality control procedures.
  • Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and team coordination skills.

jobs.title: CNC Coolant Filling Technician - PWHT Plants Experience
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a detail-oriented and highly skilled CNC Coolant Filling Technician with specific experience in Post Weld Heat Treatment (PWHT) plant environments. The successful candidate will be responsible for the comprehensive management, preparation, and maintenance of metalworking fluids and coolants for high-precision CNC machinery. This role is critical to maximizing tool life, ensuring machining quality, and maintaining safe, continuous operations within a heavy industrial setting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coolant Management: Accurately mix, distribute, and replenish coolants, cutting fluids, and lubricants across multiple CNC machines according to specific operational parameters.
  • System Testing & Monitoring: Perform daily chemical tests using refractometers and pH meters to monitor coolant concentration, alkalinity, and biological control.
  • Equipment Maintenance: Execute routine cleaning of machine sumps, operate tramp oil skimmers, and maintain coolant recycling and filtration equipment to prevent fluid degradation.
  • PWHT Plant Integration: Safely navigate and operate within heavy industrial environments, specifically alongside Post Weld Heat Treatment (PWHT) operations, ensuring all fluid management aligns with the plant's production and heat-treating schedules.
  • Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve fluid-related issues such as foaming, foul odors, rust, or poor tool life, adjusting chemical dosing as necessary.
  • Inventory Control: Track the consumption of chemical inventory, manage stock levels of raw coolant fluids, and initiate purchase requests to prevent shortages.
  • HSE Compliance: Strictly adhere to all Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) protocols regarding the handling, storage, and disposal of hazardous chemicals and waste fluids. Maintain accurate logs and Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS).

Requirements

Education: High School Diploma, Technical Diploma, or equivalent certification in mechanical maintenance, machining, or industrial chemistry.

Core Experience: Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in CNC machine maintenance, specifically focused on fluid and coolant management.

Industry Experience (Mandatory): Proven work history within heavy manufacturing, Oil & Gas, or large-scale industrial plants. Specific experience working in or around PWHT (Post Weld Heat Treatment) plants is strictly required.

Technical Skills: * Proficiency in using fluid testing equipment (e.g., refractometers, titration kits).

  • Strong understanding of coolant chemistry, mixing ratios, and bacterial control.
  • Familiarity with CNC sump cleaning operations and industrial pumping equipment.

HSE Knowledge: Solid understanding of industrial safety standards (e.g., OSHA, local regulations) and safe chemical handling/disposal procedures.

Soft Skills: Excellent physical stamina, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively both independently and alongside machining operators.

jobs.title: Commissioning & Start up Lead (Steam Methane Reformer (SMR) Hydrogen plants)
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and safety-conscious Commissioning & Start-Up (CSU) Lead to oversee the successful transition of our Steam Methane Reformer (SMR) hydrogen production assets from the construction phase to commercial operation. You will lead the field execution team, manage interfaces between engineering, construction, and operations, and ensure that all plant systems are safely commissioned, tested, and fully functional in accordance with project specifications and industry standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leadership & Strategy: Provide technical and operational leadership for the site commissioning team. Develop and implement the Commissioning Execution Plan, including scheduling, resource mobilization, and budget management.
  • Technical Oversight: Lead the end-to-end commissioning of SMR units, including the reformer furnace, shift converters, PSA (Pressure Swing Adsorption) purification systems, compressors, steam systems, and balance-of-plant (BOP) utilities.
  • Safety & Compliance: Enforce rigorous safety protocols (Permit-to-Work, LOTO, HAZOP/HAZID compliance) throughout the construction, commissioning, and startup phases. Act as a safety champion on-site.
  • Pre-Commissioning & Testing: Manage pre-commissioning activities, including mechanical completion walkdowns, piping system flushing/cleaning, leak testing, instrumentation loop checks, and control system (DCS/PLC) functional validation.
  • Startup & Stabilization: Direct the first-time introduction of feedstocks and gases, manage the ramp-up process, and conduct performance test runs to verify that the plant meets design efficiency and production targets.
  • Documentation & Handover: Ensure all commissioning documentation (test reports, punch lists, as-built records, handover dossiers) is accurate and complete. Facilitate the formal turnover of the facility to the Operations team.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Act as the primary liaison between project engineering, EPC contractors, vendors/OEMs, and the client/owner’s operations team to resolve technical issues and resolve punch list items efficiently.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Chemical, Mechanical, or Process Engineering.
  • Experience: Minimum of 10+ years in the oil, gas, or chemical industry, with at least 5 years specifically in a lead capacity for the commissioning and startup of SMR Hydrogen plants.
  • Technical Depth:
    • Deep understanding of SMR process chemistry, thermodynamics, and high-temperature furnace operations.
    • Expertise in hydrogen safety, high-pressure gas systems, and PSA unit operations.
    • Proficiency in interpreting complex P&IDs, control logic, and loop diagrams.
  • Leadership Skills: Proven track record of managing multi-disciplinary site teams and coordinating effectively with contractors and subcontractors.
  • Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills to perform root cause analysis (RCA) during technical troubleshooting of complex process issues.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to report progress to stakeholders and train operational personnel on new systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with other hydrogen technologies (e.g., electrolysis, carbon capture integration).
  • Certification in Project Management (PMP) or relevant industry health and safety certifications.
  • Experience in both greenfield and brownfield project environments.

Working Conditions

  • This is a field-based, 100% site-presence role.
  • Must be willing to work at construction sites, which may include remote or international locations.
  • Requires flexibility to work extended hours, weekends, or shifts during critical startup milestones.

jobs.title: Communications Specialist (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Communications Specialist supports the planning and execution of internal and external communication initiatives for the Education & Advancement sector. The role is responsible for developing high-quality communication materials, executive presentations, reports, digital content, and branding assets that strengthen stakeholder engagement and align with organizational communication strategies and brand standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, edit, and proofread internal and external communication materials, including emails, newsletters, reports, presentations, web content, and announcements.
  • Support the planning and execution of communication campaigns and strategic communication initiatives across the department.
  • Create executive-level presentations, briefing materials, reports, and visual communication assets using PowerPoint, Canva, and other design tools.
  • Produce engaging written content and storytelling materials that promote organizational initiatives, programs, and achievements.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to gather information, ensure content accuracy, and maintain consistent messaging across communication channels.
  • Collaborate with branding, design, and external vendors to deliver communication materials that meet quality and branding standards.
  • Support communication and branding activities for events, including presentations, invitations, digital assets, signage, and promotional materials.
  • Maintain communication calendars, project trackers, and monitor timelines to ensure the timely delivery of communication projects.
  • Ensure all communication outputs comply with corporate branding guidelines while maintaining high standards of quality, professionalism, and consistency.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Journalism, Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field.
  • 4 years of experience in corporate communications, marketing, public relations, or a similar communications role.
  • Excellent written, verbal, editing, and proofreading skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Canva, with the ability to develop executive-level presentations and visual communication materials.
  • Knowledge of corporate branding, visual identity standards, and digital communication best practices.
  • Experience developing communication materials for leadership, stakeholders, and both internal and external audiences.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and web content management systems is an advantage.

jobs.title: Community & Startups Coordinator (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Community & Startups Coordinator supports the engagement, coordination, and overall experience of founders and startups participating in the accelerator program. The role focuses on building an active and connected startup community by coordinating founder engagement activities, community initiatives, and program events. Working closely with the accelerator team, the coordinator helps create a positive founder experience by ensuring smooth communication, supporting community-building initiatives, and coordinating the logistics and execution of program activities throughout the accelerator journey.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the day-to-day point of contact for founders and startups throughout the accelerator program.
  • Coordinate founder onboarding, communications, engagement activities, and key program milestones.
  • Build strong relationships with founders and maintain an active and connected startup community.
  • Coordinate workshops, meetups, networking sessions, peer-learning activities, and community initiatives.
  • Support founder engagement by connecting startups with mentors, resources, internal teams, and relevant program activities.
  • Coordinate event logistics including registration, venues, catering, transportation, accommodation, schedules, invitations, and materials.
  • Maintain accurate founder, startup, attendance, feedback, and engagement records in CRM and program management systems.
  • Collect founder feedback and participation data to support reporting and continuous improvement.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Marketing, Events, and accelerator teams to ensure smooth program delivery.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Entrepreneurship, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
  • Minimum 2+ years of experience in community management, startup programs, accelerator operations, or event coordination.
  • Experience coordinating events, logistics, workshops, meetups, and multiple activities simultaneously.
  • Experience working with startup ecosystems, innovation programs, founder communities, or accelerator programs is highly desirable.
  • Strong interpersonal, relationship-building, and communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Arabic.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, CRM, and project/program management tools.
  • Passion for startups, entrepreneurship, innovation, and community building.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

jobs.title: Computer Engineer (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Computer Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data analysis, application development, and system integration. You will be responsible for managing large datasets, developing applications, generating reports, and ensuring seamless database and system operations in line with business requirements.

Minimum Job Requirements:

  • Education:
    Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Engineering or Information Systems
  • Experience:
    Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in Data analysis and Application/software development
  • Technical Proficiency:
    • Strong knowledge and experience with SQL and Power BI
    • Solid understanding of system integration and database management
    • Familiarity with backend programming languages such as C# and Python
  • Language Skills:
    • Proficient in English and Arabic, both oral and written

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certifications:
    • Power BI / Data Analytics Certification
    • Oracle Database / SQL Certification

Preferred Major Study:

    • Computer Engineering or Information Systems

jobs.title: Computing & Cloud Architect (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a Computing & Cloud Architect to join our innovative team in Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing and deploying cutting-edge cloud computing solutions that meet the needs of our clients in a rapidly evolving technological landscape. This role combines deep technical knowledge with strategic insight, allowing you to develop tailored cloud architectures that take advantage of the best cloud services available. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate solutions, promote cloud adoption, and drive digital transformation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the enterprise architecture for computing platforms across on-prem, private cloud, public cloud, and HPC/AI infrastructure.
  • Define target reference architectures, standards, and roadmaps, and provide architectural assurance for major programs and solutions.
  • Develop and implement cloud strategies that support the organization’s short and long-term goals, ensuring high availability, performance, and security.
  • Provide leadership and guidance in cloud technology best practices, promoting a culture of innovation within the organization.
  • Integrate existing systems with cloud-based solutions, ensuring interoperability and data consistency across all platforms.
  • Collaborate with software engineering teams to define cloud architecture for new applications and features.
  • Evaluate new cloud services and technology trends, making recommendations to enhance functionality or efficiency.
  • Monitor and analyze cloud performance metrics, adjusting architectures to optimize costs and performance.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; a Master’s degree is a plus.
  • Experience:
    • 15+ years of experience in IT, with at least 5 years focused on cloud computing architectures.
    • Hands-on experience with major cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
    • Solid understanding of cloud services (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and technologies such as containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
    • Experience in cloud migration projects and managing hybrid cloud environments.
  • Certifications: Cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Cloud Professional) are preferred.
  • Skills:
    • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a focus on scalable cloud solutions.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, capable of conveying technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
    • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing business needs.

jobs.title: Contract Advisor (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Contract Advisor provides professional contractual and commercial support in the development, administration, and management of contracts within the assigned organization. The role serves as the Contract Proponent representative and provides expert advice throughout the contract lifecycle, from development of requirements and scope of work through execution, administration, amendments, claims, renewals, and close-out.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide professional contractual and commercial advice to contract proponents throughout the contract lifecycle.
  • Support the development of contract requirements, scopes of work, commercial terms, and contract documentation.
  • Review and coordinate contracts and amendments through internal review, approval, and execution processes.
  • Administer assigned contracts and monitor contractor performance, compliance, deliverables, milestones, and contractual obligations.
  • Coordinate contract amendments, extensions, renewals, terminations, and other contract actions.
  • Review proposals, bid responses, pricing structures, and contractual terms and provide recommendations.
  • Participate in bid evaluations, bidder qualification, contract negotiations, and preparation of negotiation positions and counteroffers.

Mandatory Technical Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Public Administration, Law, Finance, Supply Chain Management, MIS, or a related field.
  • Minimum 12 years of relevant experience, preferably in the petroleum, oil & gas, energy, or related industry.
  • Experience in contract administration, contract development, commercial management, procurement, or a related operational area.
  • Minimum 3 years of progressively responsible experience involving contracting, accounting, auditing, commercial analysis, or related techniques and procedures.
  • Strong knowledge of contract lifecycle management, including contract development, execution, administration, amendments, renewals, claims, and close-out.
  • Knowledge of lump-sum, unit-price, and time-and-materials contracts.
  • Knowledge of corporate contracting policies, procurement procedures, governance requirements, and internal controls.
  • Demonstrated experience in contract performance monitoring, compliance tracking, change control, and contract administration.
  • Experience in bid evaluation, commercial analysis, contractor negotiations, claims management, and contract amendments.
  • Ability to prepare and review scopes of work, contract documentation, commercial analyses, reports, and management presentations.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, and familiarity with ERP/business systems used for contract administration and reporting.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate proposals, pricing, contractual risks, and commercial exposure.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with senior management, professional specialists, contractors, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple contracts and priorities simultaneously.

jobs.title: Contract Advisor - Saudi Arabia
jobs.description:
Eram Talent, a leading talent acquisition firm in Saudi Arabia, is looking for an experienced Contract Advisor to join our team. In this role, you will manage and oversee contract negotiations, ensuring that all terms meet the legal requirements and align with company and client objectives. Your expertise will be crucial in guiding our clients through complex contractual agreements in various sectors.

The position is based in Saudi Arabia.

Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and negotiate contracts while ensuring compliance with legal, regulatory, and client requirements.
  • Provide expert advice on contract terms and conditions to internal stakeholders.
  • Manage the contract lifecycle from initiation to completion, ensuring timely delivery and compliance.
  • Conduct risk assessments and identify potential issues related to contracts.
  • Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to ensure that all contracts align with industry standards and regulations.
  • Train and mentor junior staff on best practices in contract management.
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation of contracts and related communications.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Law, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of proven experience in contract management, preferably within the oil and gas or similar sectors.
  • Strong knowledge of contract law and relevant commercial regulations.
  • Exceptional negotiation skills along with effective verbal and written communication abilities.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent organizational skills to manage multiple contracts simultaneously.
  • Proficient in contract management software and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a diverse team environment.

Benefits

Salary is not a constraint ,company is looking for right candidate .

jobs.title: Contracts Advisor - Capital Projects (EPC) Experience
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking an experienced Contracts Advisor with expertise in Capital Projects and EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) contracts. As a leading recruitment company under ERAM Holdings, Eram Talent specializes in connecting skilled professionals with premier companies. In this role, you will be responsible for managing contract negotiations and administration for large-scale capital projects, ensuring compliance and risk mitigation across all stages of EPC contracts.

If selected, the work location would be onsite at Saudi Arabia.

Responsibilities

  • Draft, negotiate, and manage EPC contracts and subcontracts for capital projects
  • Ensure contract compliance with legal, regulatory, and company standards
  • Identify risks and propose mitigation strategies related to contract terms
  • Collaborate with project, legal, finance, and procurement teams to facilitate contract execution
  • Manage contract amendments, claims, and dispute resolution processes
  • Maintain accurate contract documentation and reporting throughout project lifecycle
  • Provide expert advice on contractual obligations impacting capital projects

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering (preferably Mechanical), law, business administration, or related discipline
  • 15 years of experience in contracts procurement and administration within the oil & Gas sector
  • Ability to develop and administrate Capital Project contracts
  • Preferred Certificates : PMP, CPCM, CCMP, CICCM, CLS, NCMA, IPSCMI (Any one).
  • Extensive experience across all phases of the contracting lifecycle, including solicitation, award, execution, administration, and close-out
  • Solid experience in managing and negotiating EPC, EPCM, LSTK, and service contracts, with a strong understanding of commercial and legal implications
  • Deep understanding of contract types and structures, with the ability to tailor terms to project specific risks and requirements
  • Strong knowledge of international contracting standards, local legal, regulatory frameworks, and Saudi Aramco contracting procedures is preferred.
  • Experience in risk management, claims analysis, and dispute resolution mechanisms, including mediation, arbitration, and litigation
  • Proficient in using contract management systems, ERP tools (SAP), and project management software
  • Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make sound decisions in complex and high-pressure environments
  • Expertise in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating contracts, including Lump Sum Turnkey (LSTK), Lump Sum Procure and Build (LSPB), EPC, EPCM, and service agreements
  • Knowledgeable in Saudi Aramco contracting policies, procedures, safety requirements, and legal requirements, including internal controls and governance standards
  • Ability to manage contractor performance throughout the contract lifecycle, including scope, cost, schedule, and quality, to ensure delivery against agreed milestones and service levels

jobs.title: Contracts Advisor - PMT Experience (Saudi Arabia)

jobs.title: Control Manager (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

Responsible for managing and controlling project schedule, cost, progress, performance, and reporting to ensure successful delivery of Oil & Gas projects within the approved time and budget.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the Project Controls team covering Planning, Scheduling, Cost Control, Progress Measurement, and Reporting.
