jobs.title: Control Room Operator
jobs.description:
Eram Talent, a division of ERAM Group, is seeking a skilled Control Room Operator to join our team in the Oil & Energy industry. As an independent Talent Acquisition Consultancy, Eram Talent is dedicated to providing outstanding recruitment solutions that satisfy the needs of our clients. With a global reach and network, we specialize in attracting high-potential professionals with sophisticated skills from various industries, including Oil & Gas, Petroleum, Infrastructure, Energy, Water, Transportation, Science & Technology, and Health Care.

As a Control Room Operator, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation of control systems within the oil and energy sector. Your responsibilities will include monitoring, operating, and maintaining control panels, systems, and equipment to regulate and optimize production processes. You will collaborate closely with technicians, engineers, and other team members to achieve operational excellence while adhering to safety guidelines and industry regulations.


Responsibilities

  • Monitor and operate control systems, including control panels, consoles, and computer systems, to manage and regulate the production process
  • Adjust variables such as temperature, pressure, and flow rates based on operational requirements
  • Perform routine checks on equipment and ensure proper functioning of all systems
  • Identify and resolve any issues or abnormalities that may arise during operations
  • Coordinate with technicians, engineers, and other staff to implement necessary adjustments or repairs
  • Prepare and maintain records, logs, and reports detailing operational activities, incidents, and equipment performance
  • Comply with safety regulations, standard operating procedures, and industry best practices to ensure a safe working environment

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Control Room Operator in the Utility Industries
  • Strong knowledge of control systems, including consoles, panels, and computer-based systems
  • Familiarity with process plant operations, including pumps, compressors, turbines, and other equipment
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings, diagrams, and procedures
  • Proficient in using computer systems, data entry, and software applications for control operations
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Coral Husbandry Technician Supervisor
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking an experienced and passionate Coral Husbandry Technician Supervisor to support the KAUST Coral Restoration Initiative (KCRI), one of the world's largest coral reef conservation and restoration programs. Reporting to the Coral Husbandry Specialist, the role is responsible for supervising coral husbandry operations, co-culture systems, and fish husbandry activities to maximize coral production for reef restoration. The successful candidate will oversee daily nursery operations, ensure the highest standards of coral care and aquatic husbandry, supervise technical staff, and contribute to the successful implementation of advanced coral restoration techniques. The ideal candidate has extensive experience in coral husbandry, coral sexual and asexual reproduction, aquaculture, and marine conservation, with the ability to work in remote project environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise daily coral husbandry, co-culture, and fish husbandry operations to ensure optimal coral growth and production.
  • Implement advanced coral restoration techniques, including coral sexual and asexual reproduction methodologies.
  • Manage coral nursery operations while maintaining the highest standards of cleanliness, animal welfare, and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor coral health, identify and diagnose coral diseases, and implement appropriate corrective actions.
  • Supervise and support husbandry technicians to ensure compliance with established husbandry procedures and quality standards.
  • Develop, maintain, and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational records, and production documentation.
  • Coordinate daily activities with the Coral Husbandry team, management, and multidisciplinary project stakeholders.
  • Support the successful delivery of nursery operational readiness, commissioning, and ongoing coral production programs.
  • Monitor and maintain aquatic life support systems, water quality, and environmental conditions.
  • Participate in diving operations to support coral monitoring, maintenance, and restoration activities when required.
  • Attend project meetings and provide operational updates and technical input.
  • Ensure compliance with Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) policies and report incidents, hazards, and near misses promptly.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to enhance coral production, nursery operations, and restoration outcomes.

Requirements

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Marine Biology, Marine Science, Aquaculture, Environmental Science, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in coral husbandry with a strong emphasis on coral sexual reproduction.
  • Proven experience in coral propagation, co-culture husbandry, fish husbandry, and aquaculture operations.
  • Strong understanding of aquatic life support systems, coral health management, and marine husbandry practices.
  • Experience supervising technical teams in marine, aquarium, aquaculture, or coral restoration environments.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and digital documentation systems.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Previous experience working in remote or project-based environments is highly desirable.
  • Middle East experience and Arabic language skills are advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Willingness to relocate to a remote project location and participate in diving activities as required.

jobs.title: Core Logging Geologist (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Core Logging Geologist to join our mineral exploration team. The successful candidate will be responsible for detailed geological logging of drill core, sample management, and supporting exploration programs focused on base metals with a strong emphasis on gold exploration. The role requires excellent geological interpretation skills, adherence to industry standards, and the ability to work effectively in remote field environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform detailed geological, structural, alteration, mineralization, and geotechnical logging of diamond drill core.
  • Identify and record lithological units, mineral assemblages, alteration styles, and structural features accurately.
  • Support exploration targeting through geological interpretation and integration of drilling data.
  • Ensure accurate sample selection, marking, and preparation in accordance with QA/QC procedures.
  • Maintain high-quality geological databases and ensure data integrity.
  • Work closely with drilling contractors and exploration teams to coordinate drilling activities and core handling.
  • Assist in geological mapping, trench logging, and field reconnaissance as required.
  • Interpret exploration results and contribute to technical reports and daily progress updates.
  • Follow company Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) policies and maintain safe work practices.
  • Support resource evaluation activities by providing accurate geological data.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Geology, Applied Geology, or a related Earth Science discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on field experience in mineral exploration.
  • Proven expertise in core logging for base metal exploration, with significant experience in gold exploration projects.
  • Strong understanding of structural geology, alteration mineralogy, and ore deposit geology.
  • Experience with geological logging software and database management systems.
  • Knowledge of QA/QC protocols for drilling and sampling.
  • Ability to work independently in remote field locations under challenging conditions.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and report-writing skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and geological data management software.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience working on greenfield and brownfield exploration projects.
  • Familiarity with industry reporting standards and exploration best practices.
  • Ability to interpret geological data and contribute to exploration targeting.
  • Strong teamwork and problem-solving abilities.

Work Environment

  • Field-based role with extended rotations at remote exploration sites.
  • Willingness to travel and work flexible schedules based on project requirements.

Key Competencies

  • Geological interpretation
  • Core logging and sampling
  • Mineral exploration
  • Data accuracy and attention to detail
  • Team collaboration
  • Safety awareness
  • Technical reporting
  • Time management

jobs.title: Corporate Training & Development Specialist (Saudi Arabia)

The Corporate Training & Development Specialist will play a vital role in assessing training needs, designing impactful training interventions, and implementing programs that align with strategic business objectives. You will collaborate with leaders across departments to identify skills gaps and develop training solutions tailored to enhance employee performance and career development.

  • Strong expertise in designing and delivering effective training programs tailored to business needs.
  • Excellent presentation and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage diverse learners.
  • Strong analytical skills to assess training effectiveness and identify areas for improvement.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and other training technologies.

jobs.title: Data Center Planner
jobs.description:
Data Center Planner oversees activities carried out by 24x7 shift teams for Data Centers as well as responsible for ensuring sufficient personnel is available for each Operations shift. Shall also carry out capacity planning, ensuring new deployments meet the capacity requirements. Is responsible for making sure the racking and associated activities, including any changes, are in compliance with the Data Center standards and Change processes.

The work location would be in Thuwwal, Saudi Arabia.

Scope of Work

  • Capacity planning for Data Center hosting.
  • Prepare racking diagrams and assign it to relevant shifts.
  • Oversee racking and related activities carried out by the DC Operations team.
  • Manage the shift schedule for the Data Center Operations.
  • Liaise with OSP/ISP Team for the interbuilding connectivity requirements.
  • Plan and recommend Data Center Operational requirements.
  • Vendor Management
  • Manage Data Center Asset Register
  • Oversee break/fix of all Windows/Linux servers throughout the Data Center when hardware failures occur by helping the system owners/proponents troubleshoot issues and sending the appropriate hardware in coordination with the Vendor.
  • Proactive Monitoring and recording of facility security, HVAC, Fire Detection and Suppression Systems, Temperature, Humidity and critical power systems.
  • Ensuring that the Data Center is secure at all times. Ensure all visitors are signed in and escorted at all times while in the Data Centers.
  • Perform other various misc. operational duties as per the SOP approved by the Data Center Lead
  • Compliance with TIA 942 standards for Copper and Fiber cabling across all Data Centers
  • Interface with vendors such as HP, Dell, SUN and Supermicro on the implementation of hardware/systems.
  • Willing to work a flexible shift including nights and weekends, and participate in an on-call rotation, if and when required.
  • Participates and performs any other tasks that are assigned by upper management as required.

Requirements

  • BS or diploma in computer science engineering, IT, Electrical/ Electronics engineering or Mechanical engineering is required.
  • Minimum 5 years of IT experience with at least 3 years in Data Centers.
  • APC infrastructure experience is required.
  • Should be able to co-ordinate the day to day activities and preventive maintenance with the facility team and IT staff as per the instructions of the Data Center Lead.
  • Should have good experience with communications circuits and Ethernet cabling (structured copper cabling and fiber

optic cables).

  • Proficient in Windows server and Linux configuration and troubleshooting.
  • Proficient in MS Office.
  • Basic knowledge of electrical and mechanical components like Online Double Conversion UPS, Dynamic Rotary UPS,

medium/low voltage circuits, and chilled water-cooled HVAC systems.

jobs.title: Data Center Technician
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is currently looking for a knowledgeable and motivated Data Center Technician to join our team in Saudi Arabia. Data Center Technician perform 24x7 shifts for Data Centers. Handle incidents and ensure safety requirements are met. Monitor environmental, power and server hardware. Handle cabling tasks for copper and fiber. Control access into the data centers, ensure work permits and material gate passes are issued. Install equipment in racks and document changes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate and support Data Center facilities on a 24x7 shift basis, ensuring safety and uptime.
  • Perform racking, de-racking, and physical installation of servers, network devices, power, KVM, and cabling.
  • Handle copper and fiber cabling in compliance with TIA-942 standards.
  • Monitor and record environmental and facility systems including power, HVAC, fire detection/suppression, temperature, and humidity.
  • Perform break/fix support for Windows and Linux servers in coordination with system owners and hardware vendors.
  • Conduct basic OS installation and server configuration.
  • Ensure data center security, including access control, visitor logging, escorting, and work permit compliance.
  • Interface with vendors (HP, Dell, Sun, Supermicro) for hardware implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Prepare end-of-shift reports and maintain accurate documentation of changes.
  • Participate in on-call rotation, night/weekend shifts, and other operational duties as assigned.

Requirements

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Computer Science, IT, Electrical Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.
  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of IT experience, with at least 3 years in Data Center operations.
  • Hands-on experience with server hardware installation, troubleshooting, and cabling (copper and fiber).
  • Intermediate knowledge of Windows Server and Linux installation, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Basic understanding of data center electrical and mechanical systems, including UPS, power circuits, and HVAC.
  • Familiarity with data center safety, security, and operational SOPs.
  • Proficiency in MS Office and basic documentation/reporting.
  • Ability to work shifts, nights, weekends, and on-call schedules.

jobs.title: Data Control Analyst
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a meticulous and skilled Data Control Analyst to join our esteemed consultancy team. As a key player in our efforts to maintain data integrity and compliance, the Data Control Analyst will be responsible for developing and managing data control frameworks that ensure data accuracy and security across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the maintenance of data dictionaries, data classification, and data lifecycle management practices.
  • Maintain the physical security and system security including physical security of servers and data user security
  • Support data stewardship activities, including data standardization, metadata management, and data quality improvement initiatives.
  • Utilise identity and access management (IAM) systems to verify user identity and control data access.
  • Make sure data is consistent with the common data models
  • Perform data validation and auditing using standard technical processes resolving data quality issues.
  • Identify the most suitable data storage system ensuring that versions of the data with a history of changes are stored alongside the latest version.
  • Employ the necessary technologies and processes to safeguard data, both physically and digitally.
  • Stay updated on KSA data protection laws, regulations, and industry best practices to ensure compliance.
  • Assist in data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes for business intelligence and reporting purposes.
  • Collaborate with business users to understand their data requirements and provide data insights as needed.
  • Recommend training and development interventions for team members to build their capabilities.
  • Contribute to the identification of opportunities for the continuous improvement of systems, processes and practices to increase productivity and operational efficiency.
  • Implement all relevant Department’s policies, processes, procedures and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
  • Contribute to the preparation of timely and accurate reports to meet departmental requirements, policies and standards.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is required
  • 5 years experience in the same Field
  • Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE) preferred
  • Demonstrated proficiency in oral and written English
  • Experience in Information Technology / Data Solutions / Networking / Cybersecurity preferred
  • Proficiency in data analysis tools and software (SQL, Excel, etc.).
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams.

jobs.title: Data Governance Specialist
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is on the lookout for a dedicated and detail-oriented Data Governance Specialist to join our dynamic team. This role is essential in ensuring that the organization maintains high standards of data quality, integrity, and compliance with relevant regulations. As a Data Governance Specialist, you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and managing data governance frameworks and policies that promote effective data management practices across the organization.

The ideal candidate will possess a solid understanding of data governance concepts, data management, and regulatory requirements. You will work collaboratively with various teams to foster a culture of data stewardship and ensure that data is treated as a strategic asset within the organization. Additionally, you will assist in implementing data quality initiatives and assessing data risks to support business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute the data governance and data quality strategy, incorporating industry best practices.
  • Define, Deploy and Communicate data quality policies, procedures, and guidelines to all business units of the organization ensuring data is used and maintained properly
  • Manage the Personal Data Protection agenda within ASMO and monitor the compliance
  • Monitor the current data quality situation, identifying gaps and root causes, and work towards resolving issues efficiently.
  • Execute data quality business cases, establish, and measure variances between actual and target outcomes.
  • Develop terms of reference for data quality programs and launch new and improved programs across all units of the organization.
  • Establish control measures and procedures for data management information (MI) in line with organizational frameworks and guidelines.
  • Execute data quality implementation roadmap, making necessary changes and enhancements to people, processes, technology, and information.
  • Conduct data quality projects from inception to implementation, including performance tracking and communication.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve data quality processes, tools, and methodologies to enhance overall data governance and data quality within the organization.
  • Incorporate feedback from external technology auditors into controls put in place to ensure compliance of Technology systems at ASMO.
  • Stay updated on KSA data protection laws, regulations, and industry best practices to ensure compliance.
  • Utilize enhanced cybersecurity measures to protect data and incorporate this seamlessly into protective measures against data theft, breaches, or loss.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is required
  • 7+ Years in a Data Governance Role is required.
  • Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE) preferred
  • Experience in Information Technology / Data Solutions / Networking / Cybersecurity preferred
  • Strong understanding of data governance concepts and frameworks.
  • Familiarity with data quality management, data privacy regulations, and compliance standards.
  • Proven experience in conducting data assessments and audits.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills for effective stakeholder engagement.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.

jobs.title: Data Program Analyst (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking an analytical and detail-oriented Data Program Analyst to join our team in Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and analyzing data programs to enhance operational efficiency and decision-making processes. As a Data Program Analyst, you will collaborate closely with various teams to translate raw data into meaningful insights, ultimately contributing to the success of our initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in the design, implementation, and management of data programs aimed at collecting and analyzing vital information.
  • Collect and manage data from various sources, ensuring its accuracy and integrity.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards and reports to monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and program outcomes.
  • Analyze program data to identify trends, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support stakeholders by providing insights and recommendations based on data analysis.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure effective data sharing and communication.
  • Prepare presentations and reports to convey complex data in a clear and actionable manner.
  • Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in data analytics and program management.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in data analysis or program management.
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret and present data effectively.
  • Experience with programming languages such as Python or R is a plus.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple tasks.
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
  • Fluency in English; proficiency in Arabic is a plus.

jobs.title: Data Quality Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a dedicated Data Quality Business Analyst to join our growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and reliability of data across our business systems. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to define data quality standards, develop metrics, and implement processes that enhance data management practices.

Your responsibilities will include performing data analysis, identifying data quality issues, and recommending solutions to improve data governance. You will also work on data quality initiatives and may be involved in data profiling, cleansing, and monitoring to ensure adherence to organizational data quality standards.

Responsibilities

  • Consolidate guidelines, processes and parameters for conducting business analysis in order to follow a consistent approach in the process followed for collating data and carrying out analytics.
  • Support in coordinating with Technology departments through periodic meetings to understand the specific business requirements related to business analytics.
  • Coordinate with different internal departments to identify the most suitable data resources to ensure effective data collection and analysis based on the requirements.
  • Support in identifying potential external vendors/market research agencies etc. and coordinate with them to establish the data collection and reporting needs in order to ensure efficiency in the data collection process.
  • Coordinate with external consultants/forums to keep updated with the latest developments in the Technology landscape.
  • Perform data cleaning and standardisation for conducting the relevant analysis and ensures adherence to data quality standards while developing reports on procurement and logistics updates.
  • Stay up to date on the latest business intelligence tools, databases, systems or methods etc. and shares insights with Master Data Quality Manager on leveraging the same for business requirements.
  • Develop the requisite reports (weekly/monthly/ad-hoc) and ensures timely submission of the same to facilitate decision making.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is required.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Quality Analyst or in a related field.
  • Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE) preferred.
  • Experience in Information Technology / Data Solutions / Networking / Cybersecurity preferred.
  • Strong understanding of data management principles, data governance, and data quality best practices.
  • Proficient in data profiling and analysis tools (e.g., SQL, Python, or ETL tools) to assess data quality.
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify data quality issues and develop actionable solutions.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on delivering high-quality results.
  • Familiarity with data privacy and regulatory compliance standards is a plus.

jobs.title: Data Quality Development Analyst
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is in search of a dedicated Data Quality Development Analyst to enhance our commitment to delivering exceptional staffing solutions. In this pivotal role, you will ensure that our data quality standards are met and continuously developed, contributing to our data-driven decision-making capabilities across the organization.

The role holder is responsible for designing data quality assurance policies and standards, developing an enterprise data quality solution, defining metadata repositories and master data management to enable leverage enterprise data for business intelligence. The role holder is also responsible for installing and maintaining business intelligence tools and fine-tuning their performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for designing, testing, deploying and documenting the data quality procedures and their outputs
  • Design processes and technology to enable the client to leverage the enterprise data for business intelligence purposes.
  • Define the data policy, standards and guidelines and ensure consistency.
  • Coordinate with Master Data Quality Manager and define metadata repository for digitally and physically storing and cataloguing data.
  • Design master data management to provide processes, governance, policies, standards and tools to define and manage master data.

jobs.title: Date Palm Tissue Culture Technician
jobs.description:
The Date Palm Tissue Culture Technician is responsible for the initiation, maintenance, multiplication, and acclimatization of date palm (Phoenix dactylifera L.) plantlets using in vitro tissue culture techniques. The technician will support large-scale micropropagation, ensure culture quality, and maintain sterile laboratory operations in compliance with standard protocols.

Scope of Work / Deliverables

  • Initiate and maintain date palm explants (shoot meristems, somatic embryos) under aseptic conditions
  • Prepare and sterilize culture media, reagents, and consumables
  • Perform subculturing, multiplication, shooting and rooting of in vitro cultures
  • Monitor cultures for contamination, physiological disorders, and growth performance
  • Conduct somatic embryogenesis and organogenesis protocols.
  • Assist with acclimatization and hardening of plantlets in the greenhouse.
  • Maintain detailed records of cultures, protocols, and production output
  • Follow laboratory safety, hygiene, and quality control procedures
  • Support protocol optimization and scaling-up activities

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Biotechnology, Plant Pathology, Agronomy, Horticulture, Biological Sciences, or a related field. (Associate degree/Diploma with relevant hands-on lab experience will also be considered)
  • Hands-on experience in plant tissue culture, preferably with date palm
  • Strong knowledge of aseptic techniques and culture media preparation
  • Plant tissue transformation
  • Hands-on experience in plant tissue culture, preferably with date palm
  • Strong knowledge of aseptic techniques and culture media preparation
  • Plant tissue transformation

jobs.title: Deburring & marking Technician (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a skilled Deburring & Marking Technician to perform deburring, surface finishing, and part marking activities on machined and fabricated components. The successful candidate will ensure components meet quality standards by removing burrs, sharp edges, and surface imperfections while accurately marking parts in accordance with engineering drawings, specifications, and customer requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform deburring, edge breaking, and surface finishing of machined and fabricated components using hand and power tools.
  • Remove burrs, sharp edges, excess material, and surface defects without affecting dimensional accuracy.
  • Mark components using approved methods such as stamping, engraving, vibro-etching, or laser marking as per engineering drawings and specifications.
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, work instructions, and marking requirements.
  • Inspect finished components to ensure compliance with quality standards and customer specifications.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Technical or vocational training in mechanical or manufacturing disciplines is an advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum 2–5 years of experience in deburring and marking of machined or fabricated components in a manufacturing, fabrication, oil & gas, or heavy engineering environment.

Skills & Competencies

  • Experience using deburring tools, grinders, files, rotary tools, and polishing equipment.
  • Knowledge of part marking methods such as stamping, engraving, vibro-etching, or laser marking.
  • Ability to read engineering drawings and manufacturing specifications.
  • Familiarity with measuring instruments such as vernier calipers and micrometers.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Good understanding of workplace safety and housekeeping practices.

jobs.title: Design Engineer - Mechanical (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is looking for a talented and detail-oriented Design Engineer - Mechanical to join our dynamic team in Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will be responsible for the Design, plan and review all technical packages related to Mechanical Engineering that includes major mechanical equipment such as, Chillers, Pumps, Motors, Air Handling Units, Cooling Tower cells, Refrigerant Management System, air conditioning, ventilation and cooling, conducting technical assessments, Engineering technical assessment, feasible studies for enhancement or modification of existing facilities and impact on existing system.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, plan, and develop HVAC and mechanical systems for new and existing projects.
  • Prepare conceptual designs, technical assessments, and engineering documentation.
  • Review design drawings, material selections, and technical submittals for compliance with project requirements.
  • Develop Scope of Work (SOW), Bill of Quantities (BOQ), and system specifications for HVAC-related projects.
  • Perform HVAC load calculations, duct sizing, and equipment selection using appropriate design software.
  • Conduct technical evaluations and feasibility studies for system upgrades or modifications.
  • Provide technical reports and recommendations for improvement of mechanical systems.
  • Act as a technical authority for mechanical design to ensure adherence to standards and best practices.
  • Offer engineering solutions for issues related to chillers, AHUs, FCUs, pumps, motors, and cooling towers.
  • Coordinate design activities with other engineering disciplines to ensure integration and efficiency.
  • Provide technical support during project execution, installation, and commissioning stages.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, consultants, and contractors to resolve design or technical issues.
  • Ensure all designs comply with international codes and standards such as ASHRAE, SMACNA, IBC, ANSI, ASME, ASTM, ARI, SAES, and SAMSS.
  • Maintain and update design documentation as per organizational and international requirements.
  • Prepare and present technical assessments, feasibility reports, and engineering studies.
  • Support the Engineering Manager in monitoring capital project designs and performance.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Engineering Manager.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering.
  • Minimum 5–6 years of experience in mechanical systems and HVAC design within large-scale or industrial projects.
  • Strong understanding of HVAC principles, heat load calculations, duct sizing, and equipment selection.
  • Proficiency in design software such as HAP, Carrier, AutoCAD, and Revit MEP.
  • Sound knowledge of international mechanical design codes and standards (ASHRAE, SMACNA, ASME, etc.).
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and coordination abilities.
  • Detail-oriented, reliable, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Capable of managing multiple priorities and delivering results within deadlines.

jobs.title: Design Engineering Manager (China)
jobs.description:
The Design Engineering Manager will lead and manage multidisciplinary engineering design activities for petrochemical and oil & gas projects, with a strong focus on oil and gas separation systems. The role is responsible for overseeing design development across project phases, ensuring compliance with international standards, project specifications, and client requirements, while coordinating with EPC teams and stakeholders. This position is based in China.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage engineering design activities for petrochemical and oil & gas projects.
  • Oversee design of oil & gas separation systems, including process facilities and related units.
  • Manage multidisciplinary engineering teams (process, mechanical, piping, electrical, instrumentation).
  • Review and approve engineering deliverables, calculations, drawings, and technical documents.
  • Ensure engineering designs meet project scope, schedule, quality, and cost objectives.
  • Coordinate with project management, procurement, construction, and commissioning teams.
  • Interface with clients, licensors, vendors, and regulatory authorities.
  • Ensure compliance with international codes, standards, and project specifications.
  • Support technical issue resolution during engineering, procurement, and construction phases.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and performance management for engineering teams.

Educational Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, or related discipline).
  • Master’s degree is an advantage.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 15 years of engineering experience in petrochemical and oil & gas projects.
  • Proven experience in oil & gas separation systems.
  • Minimum 5 years in a Design Engineering Manager or Lead Engineering role.
  • Strong EPC project experience.

jobs.title: Diesel Mechanic
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a skilled and experienced Diesel Mechanic to perform maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and overhaul of diesel-powered vehicles, heavy equipment, and machinery. Reporting to the Maintenance Supervisor, the role is responsible for ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational efficiency of diesel engines and associated mechanical systems. The successful candidate will carry out preventive and corrective maintenance while adhering to company procedures, safety regulations, and client requirements. Candidates with prior Saudi Aramco project experience are required. The ideal candidate is locally available in Saudi Arabia and willing to work within the offered salary range.

Key Responsibilities

  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair diesel engines, heavy equipment, and mechanical systems.
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on diesel-powered vehicles and machinery.
  • Inspect, repair, and replace engine components, fuel systems, cooling systems, and transmission components.
  • Carry out engine overhauls and mechanical repairs in accordance with manufacturer specifications.
  • Read and interpret technical manuals, service manuals, and mechanical drawings.
  • Conduct routine inspections to identify faults and ensure equipment reliability.
  • Test repaired equipment to verify proper operation and performance.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records and service reports.
  • Ensure compliance with Saudi Aramco safety standards, company procedures, and HSE regulations.
  • Coordinate with supervisors and maintenance teams to minimize equipment downtime.
  • Maintain tools, equipment, and work areas in a safe and organized condition.
  • Support emergency breakdown maintenance when required.

Requirements

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Diploma or ITI/Technical certification in Mechanical Engineering, Diesel Mechanics, Automotive Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Proven experience as a Diesel Mechanic in industrial, construction, or heavy equipment environments.
  • Saudi Aramco project experience is mandatory.
  • Strong knowledge of diesel engines, hydraulics, transmissions, fuel systems, and preventive maintenance.
  • Ability to diagnose and repair heavy equipment and diesel-powered machinery.
  • Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with HSE procedures and safe maintenance practices.
  • Locally available in Saudi Arabia.
  • Nationality: Open to all nationalities.

jobs.title: Drafting Trainer (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Drafting Trainer is responsible for planning, delivering, and evaluating technical training programs in drafting for trainees and employees. The role involves classroom instruction, practical demonstrations, assessment of trainee performance, and the development of training materials. The trainer ensures that trainees acquire the knowledge and skills required to perform drafting work in accordance with industry standards and organizational requirements, particularly within the Oil & Gas sector.

Requirements

  • Plan, prepare, and deliver classroom and practical drafting training programs covering basic, intermediate, and advanced drafting techniques and standards.
  • Develop and maintain training materials, including lesson plans, presentations, training manuals, quizzes, examinations, and instructional resources.
  • Assess trainee performance through written and practical evaluations, provide constructive feedback, and recommend improvement plans.
  • Monitor trainee attendance, progress, and classroom discipline to maintain an effective and productive learning environment.
  • Maintain accurate training records, assessment results, and documentation in accordance with company procedures.
  • Ensure training activities comply with company policies, engineering standards, and Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) requirements while supporting continuous improvement of training programs.

Requirements.

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Associate Degree/Two-year Diploma in Drafting Technology, or High School/Vocational Diploma in Engineering Drawing or Drafting
  • Minimum 4 years of relevant Oil & Gas industry experience (with a degree) or 11 years (without a degree).
  • Fluent in spoken and written English with a minimum of IELTS 6.0 or equivalent TOEFL score (Arabic proficiency is an advantage).
  • Proficiency in MicroStation and/or AutoCAD, with experience in mechanical, civil, structural, or architectural drafting.
  • Experience in training, mentoring, coaching, or delivering classroom and practical technical instruction.

jobs.title: Drilling Engineer (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is looking for an experienced Drilling Engineer to join our client in Saudi Arabia, a prominent player in the Oil & Gas sector. This role offers a unique opportunity to engage with challenging drilling projects, streamlining operations and enhancing efficiency in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing and executing drilling programs, optimizing drilling performance, and ensuring rigorous adherence to safety and environmental standards. Collaboration with geologists, reservoir engineers, and drilling teams to develop innovative drilling solutions will be essential.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement comprehensive drilling programs.
  • Optimize drilling operations to enhance performance and reduce costs.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to create strategic well plans.
  • Conduct risk assessments and ensure compliance with safety regulations.

  • At least 10 years of experience in drilling engineering within the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Strong understanding of drilling technologies and equipment.
  • Proficiency in drilling software and data interpretation.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills.
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal.
  • Willingness to reside and work in Saudi Arabia and travel to field locations as necessary.

jobs.title: Drilling Rig Foreman (Rig-Less)
jobs.description:
Functional Job Title: Rig-less Completion Operations Foreman

Eram Talent, a division of the ERAM Group, is in search of a talented Drilling Rig Foreman (Rig-Less) to join our esteemed team in the Oil & Energy sector. As a prominent talent acquisition company, we specialize in connecting the best candidates with opportunities to advance their careers. The Drilling Rig Foreman will play a critical role in overseeing rig-less operations, ensuring that all tasks are executed safely and efficiently while meeting project deadlines.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The incumbent supervises field operation of land and/or Offshore Well completion sites, either contractor or Saudi Aramco-owned, engaged in carrying out programmed work on deep or otherwise critical wells.

Has direct field responsibility for the drilling or working over of wells located anywhere in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and its territorial waters as specified in the well drilling or workover program. Such wells may be exploratory or development and entail the search for or development of hydrocarbon deposits, principally oil and gas. The Senior Liaisonman/ Foreman will supervise work on wells below 15,000 feet or wells complicated by pressure above 10,000 psi,sourgas, highly deviated, or that cost in excess of $10,000,000. The safety of rig crews and contracted service personnel numbering as high as +100 people and the loss prevention of well materials and drilling equipment valued in millions of dollars is the direct responsibility of the position. Other responsibilities include fiscal accountability for Saudi Aramco- owned equipment and materials, timely communications with Well completion Operations headquarters and logistical co-ordination of transportation services, materials movement, well services (Saudi Aramco and contractor supplied), water support and roads/location support. Responsibilities include:

a. Perform Unit level supervisory function at well locations remote to Operations headquarters on a 24 hour per day basis, 14 days on duty, 7 days off work schedule.

b. Direct all well operations expediently, safely and according to accepted industry practices as outlined and specified in the Well Completion program issued by the Production Engineering Dept and approved Standard Operation procedures (SOP).

c. Co-ordinate the timely ordering of required well materials, equipment and services according to the well program. Documents the receipt, usage and transfer of Saudi Aramco

supplied materials and equipment. Reviews service company field tickets for accuracy of services provided and associated charges.

d. Ensure that Saudi Aramco Blowout Prevention Standards are met in all respects including equipment configuration, testing and crew response. Assures that site and personnel comply with Saudi Aramco established safety standards and procedures.

e. On sites contracted to Saudi Aramco, assures compliance with terms, conditions and equipment/personnel as specified in the Contract.

f. Provides headquarters a complete daily report of work progress as required in the Daily Morning Report.

g. Promotes cost-savings ideas and awareness with the view toward operational optimization consistent with safely meeting well objectives.

h. Provides on-job training to less experienced personnel assigned to the site.

Requirements

QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE:

a. B.S. degree in Engineering.

b. 10 years’ experience related to the well completion activities and high pressure of oil and gas wells.

OR

a. High School or completion of ITC: English, ERW; Math, MI.

b. Fifteen (15) years related experience on the well completion activities and high pressure well

c. Proven job knowledge to handle operational responsibilities

on critical wells as outlined above and demonstrated personnel

attributes of sound judgment, dependability, honest work ethic

and leadership.

Work Location: Field

Work Hours: 12 Hrs per Day

Work Schedule: '28 days On and 28 days Off

jobs.title: Drilling Rig Foreman (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Drilling Rig Foreman to join the Unconventional Resources Drilling Department (URDD). The successful candidate will be responsible for supervising and overseeing the daily operations of land drilling and workover rigs performing programmed activities on deep or critical wells, including wells ranging from approximately 18,000 to 23,000 feet.

The Drilling Rig Foreman will ensure that all drilling and workover activities are conducted safely, efficiently, and in accordance with company requirements, Saudi Aramco safety standards, applicable procedures, and contractual obligations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise and oversee daily drilling and workover rig operations.
  • Ensure all rig personnel, contractors, and service providers comply with Saudi Aramco safety standards and requirements.
  • Monitor and supervise all operations performed on the well site.
  • Ensure drilling and workover activities are carried out safely, efficiently, and in accordance with approved programs and procedures.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between the company and the drilling/workover contractor.
  • Administer and monitor contractor compliance with all contractual requirements.
  • Coordinate the delivery of well materials, equipment, and other required resources to ensure availability when needed.
  • Make recommendations regarding alternative methods, procedures, or equipment when unusual or challenging situations arise.
  • Work closely with Drilling and Workover Engineers to ensure that modern and approved drilling practices are followed.
  • Review and approve the contractor’s daily tour reports.
  • Ensure that the contractor’s rig and equipment are properly maintained to minimize downtime.
  • Ensure compliance with Saudi Aramco Blowout Prevention (BOP) standards, including equipment configuration, testing, and crew response.
  • Ensure that all rig personnel are properly trained and prepared to respond to well control and emergency situations.
  • Monitor contractor performance and ensure compliance with safety, operational, and contractual requirements.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as directed by the supervisor or superintendent.

Requirements

  • Minimum 13 years of relevant experience in drilling and workover operations, including supervisory experience on a drilling or workover rig; or a Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering with a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience.
  • Proven experience in land drilling and workover operations, preferably involving deep or critical wells.
  • Strong experience in supervising drilling rig crews, contractors, and service providers.
  • Good knowledge of well control operations and Blowout Prevention (BOP) standards, including equipment configuration, testing, and crew response.
  • Strong understanding of Saudi Aramco safety standards, HSE requirements, and drilling/workover procedures.
  • Willingness to work in remote locations and mobile camps on a 28 days on / 28 days off rotational schedule, working 12 hours per day.

jobs.title: Drilling Safety Coordinator (Safety and Environment)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is currently partnering with a leading global Oil & Gas client to identify a highly skilled Drilling Field Compliance Coordinator (Safety & Environment). In this critical field-based role, you will serve as the primary HSE Advisor for assigned operations division and group rigs. You will play a pivotal role in driving safety, loss prevention, environmental protection, and occupational health compliance across drilling and workover operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • HSE Advisory & Oversight: Act as the Operations Division Field HSE Advisor for assigned rigs, overseeing all matters related to safety, loss prevention, environment, occupational health, and compliance.
  • Audits & Inspections: Conduct frequent internal HSE audits and ad-hoc field inspections in accordance with the client's Safety Management System (SMS) and relevant HSE/Operations standards.
  • Action Planning & Reporting: Complete Non-Conformance Reports (NCR) for each inspection and develop SMARTER action plans for all audits. Assist engineering, operations, and HSE teams in upkeeping and developing safety processes related to risk management, safety training, asset integrity, and emergency preparedness.
  • Incident Investigation: Lead and/or contribute to comprehensive incident investigations through all stages, ensuring meticulous completion and review of all related reports.
  • Pre-Commencement & Compliance: Conduct internal pre-commencement inspections for new rigs. Support rigs in developing action plans to close out findings identified during official pre-commencement inspections.
  • Audit Preparation: Pre-assess assigned rigs for RHSEI, Well Control, LPD, Corporate, and EPD audits. Support teams in addressing and closing out findings identified by official audit teams.
  • Mentorship & Evaluation: Act as a dedicated mentor to assigned rig foremen regarding all HSE matters. Guide and evaluate rig safety officers to ensure strict compliance with Unconventional Resources (UR) Drilling requirements.
  • Behavioral Safety: Assess rig workers, leaders, and managers on behavioral safety through frequent rig visits, active participation in safety/operations meetings, and on-the-job HSE awareness initiatives.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, HSE, Science, Industrial, or a related discipline from an accredited institution (or equivalent).
  • Certifications: Possess a globally recognized international safety certification, such as NEBOSH IGC, IOSH, or equivalent.
  • Experience: A minimum of 10 years of professional experience in safety operations within the Oil & Gas industry, including a mandatory minimum of 7 years specifically dedicated to Drilling and Workover operations.
  • Technical Expertise: Deep technical knowledge and proven capability in incident investigation, hazard identification, risk management, emergency preparedness and response, and robust Safety Management Systems.

jobs.title: Driving Instructor
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is currently seeking a qualified and passionate Driving Instructor to join our team. As a renowned Talent Acquisition company, we are dedicated to connecting skilled professionals with outstanding career opportunities.

As a Driving Instructor, you will be responsible for teaching students how to operate vehicles safely and efficiently. You will provide comprehensive driving lessons tailored to the needs of each learner, ensuring they comply with road safety regulations. Your role is pivotal in building confident, responsible, and skilled drivers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct theoretical and practical driving lessons in a professional and patient manner.
  • Assess students’ driving skills and provide constructive feedback.
  • Explain traffic laws, road signs, and safe driving practices clearly.
  • Prepare students for driving tests and help them overcome any learning challenges.
  • Maintain accurate records of student progress and lesson schedules.
  • Ensure all training vehicles are maintained and safe to operate.

Requirements

  • Valid driving training certification approved by the Traffic Police.
  • Minimum of two years of professional driving experience (additional experience is preferred).
  • Excellent knowledge of driving rules, regulations, and safety procedures.
  • Flexibility to work in night shifts as requested.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills (English & Arabic).
  • Patience and ability to teach learners of varying skill levels.
  • Valid and clean driving license pertinent to the vehicle categories instructed.
  • Ability to assess and adapt teaching methods to individual learner needs.

jobs.title: E & I Engineer (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The E & I Engineer is responsible for the safe, reliable, and efficient maintenance and troubleshooting of electrical and instrumentation systems. The role includes ensuring system integrity, supporting cathodic protection systems, and maintaining compliance with operational and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform maintenance and troubleshooting of electrical equipment and instrumentation systems.
  • Maintain and monitor cathodic protection (CP) systems to ensure pipeline and asset integrity.
  • Execute preventive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance activities for E&I systems.
  • Inspect, test, calibrate, and maintain instruments such as transmitters, control valves, analyzers, and protection systems.
  • Maintain electrical systems including motors, switchgear, MCCs, transformers, and power distribution systems.
  • Support plant and pipeline operations by ensuring reliable E&I system performance.
  • Participate in shutdowns, turnarounds, and major maintenance activities.
  • Ensure compliance with HSE standards, permit-to-work systems, and regulatory requirements.
  • Prepare maintenance reports, technical documentation, and work orders.
  • Coordinate with operations teams, contractors, and vendors during maintenance activities.
  • Use SAP PM for maintenance planning, execution, and reporting (preferred).

Qualifications & Experience

Education:

  • University degree in Electrical Engineering or Electronics Engineering.

Experience:

  • 5–8 years of experience in maintenance and troubleshooting of electrical equipment and instrumentation.
  • Proven expertise in cathodic protection systems.

Technical Skills:

  • Strong knowledge of electrical and instrumentation systems in plant and pipeline environments.
  • Experience with CP system design, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • SAP PM experience preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Good understanding of electrical safety standards and procedures.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
  • Effective communication and reporting skills.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to safety and reliability.

jobs.title: Electrical Construction Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Electrical Construction Manager to lead and manage industrial electrical and E&I construction projects from mobilization and installation through testing, commissioning, energization, and final client handover.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, manage, and supervise industrial electrical construction projects.
  • Lead installation of MV/LV substations, transformers, switchgear, MCCs, and switchyards.
  • Supervise cable laying, jointing, termination, testing, and energization activities.
  • Oversee installation of motors, pumps, VFDs, protection, metering, and control systems.
  • Coordinate PLC, SCADA, instrumentation, and communication-system works.
  • Review electrical drawings, specifications, BOQs, method statements, and project schedules.
  • Support planning teams with construction plans, manpower requirements, and material forecasts.
  • Manage engineers, technicians, labor teams, and subcontractors.
  • Coordinate with clients, consultants, vendors, and other engineering disciplines.
  • Monitor project progress, productivity, cost, quality, and schedule performance.
  • Ensure compliance with approved drawings, project specifications, and applicable standards.
  • Enforce HSE requirements, permit-to-work procedures, and safe working practices.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized university.
  • 15+ years of experience in industrial electrical construction projects.
  • Extensive experience with MV/LV systems, substations, transformers, switchgear, MCCs, cables, motors, protection, and control systems.
  • Strong experience in installation, testing, commissioning, energization, and project handover.
  • Proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams, subcontractors, project schedules, costs, quality, and HSE requirements.

A senior electrical construction professional with strong hands-on project leadership experience across industrial electrical systems, capable of managing construction activities, teams, subcontractors, and client coordination while delivering projects safely, on schedule, and to specification.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer - Facilities Management (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Electrical Engineer supports the Senior MEP Engineer in managing the maintenance and performance of all medium and low-voltage power distribution systems within the Primary Nursery Facility at NEOM. This includes electrical substations, switchgear, distribution boards, emergency generators, UPS, lighting, and general power infrastructure. The role is responsible for supervising the execution of preventive, reactive and corrective maintenance activities carried out by the service provider, ensuring compliance with safety protocols, technical standards, and contractual KPIs. The Electrical Engineer supports maintenance planning, monitors spare parts consumption, oversees electrical testing and commissioning activities, and ensures system reliability and energy efficiency across the facility. Collaboration with other engineering disciplines, particularly the Low Current and Mechanical teams, is essential to maintaining safe and seamless MEP operations.

  • Support the Senior MEP Engineer in maintaining MV/LV electrical systems, substations, generators, UPS, lighting, and power infrastructure.
  • Monitor preventive, corrective, and reactive maintenance activities in line with approved plans and manufacturer guidelines.
  • Supervise service providers to ensure safe, high-quality work and compliance with electrical safety standards.
  • Assist in developing and improving electrical maintenance programs and schedules.
  • Conduct inspections and audits to ensure system reliability, efficiency, and QA/QC compliance.
  • Assess service provider performance and recommend training or improvements.
  • Monitor spare parts usage and support inventory planning.
  • Assist with asset condition assessments and planning for upgrades or replacements.
  • Support preparation and review of technical documents and maintenance reports.
  • Troubleshoot electrical faults and support root cause analysis.
  • Assist with commissioning, handover, and closeout of electrical installations.
  • Promote electrical safety and participate in HSE audits and corrective actions.
  • Support energy efficiency initiatives and best maintenance practices.
  • Assist in design reviews, decommissioning activities, and coordination with contractors and stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline (mandatory).
  • 4–6 years of experience in electrical system design, operation, and maintenance, with good knowledge of applicable codes and standards.
  • Strong understanding of MV/LV power distribution systems, substations, generators, UPS, and lighting systems.
  • Experience in preventive and corrective maintenance planning and execution.
  • Familiarity with electrical safety regulations, HSE practices, and QA/QC procedures.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and review electrical drawings, schematics, and technical documents.
  • Experience in supervising contractors or service providers.
  • Basic knowledge of asset management systems and maintenance reporting.

jobs.title: Electrical Foreman (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking an experienced Electrical Foreman to join our team in Saudi Arabia within the construction and energy sectors. Our consultancy specializes in matching high-caliber professionals with esteemed clients across diverse industries, including Oil & Gas, Infrastructure, Energy, and more.

In this essential role, you will supervise and coordinate electrical construction activities on-site, ensuring that all work is performed according to project specifications, safety regulations, and quality standards. The Electrical Foreman will lead a team of electricians and apprentices, ensuring effective communication and collaboration throughout the project lifecycle.

Join a dedicated and dynamic team that values excellence and integrity in delivering high-quality electrical solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Supervise day-to-day electrical activities on-site, ensuring compliance with design specifications and adherence to safety protocols.
  • Supervise and lead electricians and technicians in daily electrical operation and maintenance activities at utility plants and facilities.
  • Execute preventive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance of electrical systems supporting water, wastewater, and seawater cooling operations.
  • Ensure safe and reliable operation of electrical distribution systems including transformers, switchgear, MCCs, control panels, motors, and lighting systems.
  • Plan, assign, and monitor work orders to ensure tasks are completed efficiently and within required timelines.
  • Troubleshoot electrical faults in motors, pumps, panels, and control systems to minimize downtime of utility assets.
  • Ensure strict compliance with MASA QHSE policies, permit-to-work systems, LOTO procedures, and safety regulations.
  • Review electrical drawings, single-line diagrams, and technical documents to support maintenance and repair activities.
  • Coordinate with operations, mechanical, and instrumentation teams to support continuous plant operation.
  • Maintain maintenance records, reports, and logs in line with O&M requirements.

Requirements

  • Diploma or technical qualification in Electrical Engineering or Electrical Technology.
  • Minimum 5 years of industrial electrical experience, preferably in utilities, water treatment, wastewater, or large O&M plant environments.

jobs.title: Electrical Lead Design Engineer (China)
jobs.description:
The Electrical Lead Design Engineer leads all electrical engineering design activities for EPC oil & gas and petrochemical projects. The role ensures technical integrity, compliance with Saudi Aramco standards, and successful project execution from design through commissioning, while acting as the main electrical interface with Saudi Aramco and project stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and approve electrical system design including HV/MV/LV power distribution, substations, MCCs, lighting, grounding, and hazardous area systems.
  • Perform and review power system studies using ETAP or SKM (load flow, short circuit, harmonics, protection coordination).
  • Ensure compliance with Saudi Aramco electrical standards, IEC codes, and project specifications.
  • Coordinate electrical design with other engineering disciplines and review vendor technical documents.
  • Lead and mentor the electrical engineering team and support construction and commissioning activities.
  • Identify technical risks and ensure safe, reliable, and cost-effective electrical solutions.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field; CEng, P.E., or equivalent certification required.
  • Minimum 15 years of electrical design experience in oil & gas or petrochemical EPC projects.
  • Electrical Lead experience on at least two full-cycle Saudi Aramco projects.
  • Experience with major international EPC contractors preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Expertise in HV/MV systems (115/110 kV, 33 kV and below) and large substations.
  • Proficient in ETAP or SKM and Dialux/Relux.
  • Strong knowledge of SAES electrical standards and IEC codes.
  • Fluent in English with strong leadership and communication skills.

jobs.title: Enterprise Architect
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking an experienced Enterprise Architect to lead the design and evolution of enterprise-wide technology architecture that aligns with business objectives and drives digital transformation. The Enterprise Architect will be responsible for defining architectural standards, governance frameworks, and technology roadmaps while ensuring scalable, secure, and efficient IT solutions across the organization. Reporting to the Enterprise Architecture Manager, the role will collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to evaluate technology solutions, guide project teams, and maintain architecture documentation across business, application, data, and technology domains. The ideal candidate has 7+ years of experience in Enterprise Architecture or a related IT architecture role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain the Enterprise Architecture strategy aligned with business objectives.
  • Document current-state and target-state enterprise architecture across Business, Application, Data, and Technology domains.
  • Develop and maintain enterprise architecture principles, standards, governance frameworks, and best practices.
  • Create and maintain architecture artifacts, including architecture diagrams, models, blueprints, and technical documentation.
  • Develop and manage enterprise technology roadmaps supporting business growth and digital transformation.
  • Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership throughout solution design and project implementation.
  • Review and evaluate proposed technologies and solutions to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards and strategic objectives.
  • Conduct architecture reviews, impact assessments, and gap analyses for new initiatives and system enhancements.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, project teams, and IT leadership to ensure technology solutions meet business requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize, modernize, and standardize enterprise systems and infrastructure.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise architecture governance, security standards, and organizational policies.
  • Research emerging technologies and recommend innovative solutions to support long-term business strategy.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field from a recognized and accredited university.
  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related discipline is preferred.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, or a related IT architecture role.
  • Professional certifications such as TOGAF, Zachman Certified Enterprise Architect (ZCEA), Certified IT Architect (CITA), or equivalent are preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Enterprise Architecture frameworks, governance models, and technology roadmaps.
  • Experience with business, application, data, and technology architecture.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, enterprise applications, infrastructure, integration technologies, and information security principles.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong documentation, presentation, and communication skills.
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English.

jobs.title: Estimation Consultant - Capital Projects (2 Month Renewable Contract)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent, an ISO 9001:2015 certified division of Eram Group, delivers human resources, industrial projects, and maintenance services solutions across a broad range of sectors, including oil and gas, petrochemical, power, infrastructure, water, mining, healthcare, and IT. In this role, you will provide high-value estimating support for major capital projects, bringing rigorous cost validation and project insight to complex project decisions.   • Proven experience in upstream Oil & Gas projects.
  • Extensive involvement in capital projects exceeding USD 500 million; experience on multi-billion-dollar capital programs preferred.
  • Experience with Aspen Capital Cost Estimator (ACCE).

  • Expertise in EPC project delivery models.

jobs.title: Field compliance coordinator (Drilling Safety & Environment)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is a leading Talent Acquisition Consultancy focused on placing highly skilled professionals in various industries across the globe. We are currently seeking a Field Compliance Coordinator specializing in Drilling Safety and Environment for one of our prominent clients in the oil and gas sector. In this role, the Field Compliance Coordinator will ensure that safety and environmental regulations are adhered to in drilling operations, collaborating closely with field teams, contractors, and management to mitigate risks and promote a safe working environment.

Functional Job Title: Drilling Field compliance coordinators (Safety and Environment)

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The successful candidate will be required to perform the following:

  • Act as the UR Operations Excellence & Compliance Division Field HSE Advisor, EMS focal point, reports to Group Lead and maintains daily communications with assigned departments ops managers to provide key support, in regards of E&OH for field and office activities;
  • Provide field support in regards of daily activities environmental impacts, environmental release events and E&OH audits/inspections;
  • Review the annual environmental objectives and programs (action plans) proposed by UROE&CD with department management and signs off on department approved environmental objectives;
  • Obtains monthly updates from department training coordinator to verify the department’s environmental/ EMS compliance and reports deficiencies, if any, to the group lead;
  • Reviews and reports new (or changes in) departmental processes and/or procedures that may have an environmental impact (adverse or beneficial) and may affect achievement of desired EMS outcomes to UROE&CD;
  • Conduct EMS assessments, E&OH inspections (ECAs, OHHAs, CEHAs, RPAs, NORM surveys and EH surveys) as per schedules;
  • Produce the non-compliance reports and communicate them to unit supervisor;
  • Monitors the performance of Environmental emergency drill scenarios and follows up with any identified deficiencies;
  • Monitor and reports the department daily activities environmental data and performance indicators on Flaring, SO2, Greenhouse gas emissions (GHG), Water Conservation, Energy, etc; and
  • Advice UR Operations on managing environmental risks and provide recommendations to mitigate impacts

Requirements

  • The successful candidate should hold a Bachelor degree in, Engineering, HSE, Science, Industrial, or in a related discipline from an accredited entity or equivalent. A Master’s Degree in Environment is preferable.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in environmental compliance related to drilling and completion operations
  • shall demonstrate/prove a high level of Environmental management skills with expertise in oil and gas or other related activities.
  • Certified and/or have knowledge and field experience in Environmental management systems (preferably Internal/Lead audit certifications ISO 14001, other training certifications related to environmental sustainability, air mitigations, hazardous waste, GHG, water/wastewater management, NORM/ radioactive, spill control, noise control, and etc.)
  • preferably to have demonstrated knowledge of delivering hands on environmental training and conducting of different environmental awareness sessions.
  • preferably to have good knowledge of environmental concepts, international environmental standards, and industry related environmental standards, and research methods.
  • Ability to write reports; ability to work with others and communicate technical concepts and ideas to non-technical personnel and the public; ability to read, write, speak, understand, and communicate in English sufficiently to perform the essential duties of the position; ability to use computer applications.

jobs.title: Field Compliance Coordinator (Drilling Safety & Environment) - Saudi Arabia
jobs.description:
The Field Compliance Coordinator is responsible for supporting Saudi Aramco Upstream Drilling & Workover Operations by ensuring full compliance with Saudi Aramco HSE requirements, drilling standards, and regulatory obligations. The role serves as the field HSE focal point for assigned rigs, promoting safe drilling operations through audits, inspections, incident investigations, risk management, and continuous improvement of safety performance.

Requirements

  • Act as the Field HSE Advisor for assigned drilling and workover rigs, ensuring compliance with Saudi Aramco HSE Management System (SMS), General Instructions (GIs), and Upstream Drilling standards.
  • Conduct routine HSE audits, field inspections, and compliance assessments, issuing Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and tracking corrective actions to closure.
  • Lead and participate in incident investigations, root cause analysis, and implementation of preventive and corrective actions.
  • Support pre-commencement inspections for new drilling rigs and prepare rigs for Saudi Aramco RHSEI, Well Control, Loss Prevention Department (LPD), Corporate, and Environmental Protection Department (EPD) audits.
  • Facilitate hazard identification, risk assessments, emergency preparedness, contractor HSE compliance, and environmental protection initiatives.
  • Mentor rig foremen, supervisors, and Safety Officers to strengthen HSE leadership and improve field safety performance.
  • Conduct behavioral safety observations, participate in rig safety meetings, and promote a proactive safety culture across drilling operations.
  • Prepare HSE reports, compliance documentation, and performance metrics as required by Saudi Aramco management.

Qualifications & Experience.

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline from a recognized university.
  • NEBOSH International General Certificate (IGC), IOSH Managing Safely, or equivalent internationally recognized HSE certification.
  • Minimum 10 years of HSE experience in the oil and gas industry, including at least 7 years supporting Saudi Aramco or major upstream drilling/workover operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Saudi Aramco Safety Management System (SMS), drilling HSE requirements, incident investigation, risk assessment, emergency response, and audit processes.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting Saudi Aramco drilling compliance audits, field inspections, and HSE performance improvement programs.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, report writing, and stakeholder coordination skills.
