jobs.title: Finance & Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Specialist (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The KH Finance & Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Specialist is responsible for overseeing the financial operations and revenue cycle management of KAUST Health, ensuring accurate financial reporting, effective budget management, and efficient insurance claims processing. The role focuses on validating invoices and quotations, managing end-to-end insurance claim activities, monitoring financial performance, and optimizing revenue collection while ensuring compliance with contractual agreements and healthcare regulations. Working closely with healthcare operators, insurance providers, finance teams, and senior leadership, the specialist plays a key role in improving financial sustainability, minimizing claim denials, strengthening financial controls, and supporting strategic decision-making through data-driven financial analysis and reporting.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Review and validate invoices submitted by the healthcare operator to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with contractual agreements before payment approval.
  2. Evaluate and approve quotations for healthcare services by verifying pricing, scope, and alignment with agreed contracts and organizational policies.
  3. Lead the annual budgeting process, including budget preparation, monitoring, forecasting, and expenditure control to support KAUST Health's financial objectives.
  4. Prepare financial reports and conduct variance analysis, providing monthly financial insights, forecasting, and recommendations to improve operational and financial performance.
  5. Manage the end-to-end Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) process, ensuring timely and accurate submission of insurance claims to all insurance providers.
  6. Validate insurance claims by reviewing billing accuracy, medical coding, documentation, and compliance with payer requirements to minimize claim denials.
  7. Monitor claim rejections, collections, and reimbursement performance, analyze denial trends, implement corrective actions, and improve cash flow and revenue recovery.
  8. Lead reconciliation meetings with healthcare operators and insurance companies to resolve payment discrepancies, outstanding claims, billing issues, and account reconciliations.
  9. Develop and present financial and revenue cycle KPIs to senior leadership, identifying financial risks, revenue optimization opportunities, and process improvement initiatives.
  10. Ensure financial compliance and stakeholder collaboration by supporting internal and external audits, maintaining compliance with financial policies and healthcare regulations, and serving as the primary liaison between KAUST Health, Finance, healthcare operators, and insurance companies.

Requirements

  1. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline (Finance or Accounting preferred).
  2. Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or Healthcare Management is preferred.
  3. Professional certification such as CPA, CMA, ACCA, or equivalent is considered an added advantage.
  4. Minimum of 6 years of professional experience, including at least 3 years in a leadership or specialist role in finance, healthcare finance, or revenue cycle management.
  5. Proven experience in healthcare finance, including budgeting, financial planning, financial reporting, cost control, and expenditure management within hospitals or healthcare organizations.
  6. Extensive knowledge of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), including insurance claims processing, claim validation, reimbursement, denial management, collections, and financial reconciliation.
  7. Strong financial analysis and reporting skills, with experience in budget preparation, forecasting, variance analysis, KPI reporting, and financial performance management.
  8. Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, financial modeling, dashboards, data analysis, and reporting; experience with ERP or healthcare financial systems is highly desirable.

jobs.title: Finance & Revenue Cycle Management Specialist (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is searching for a Finance & Revenue Cycle Management Specialist to join our team in Saudi Arabia. This role is essential in ensuring the effective financial management of the organization's revenue cycle processes. The specialist will be responsible for analyzing financial data, optimizing revenue streams, and ensuring compliance with financial regulations and policies. This role is crucial in ensuring the accurate, timely, and transparent validation of invoices, quotations, and insurance claims across all providers and insurers. The position requires close coordination with the operator, insurers, and internal finance teams to ensure compliance, reduce rejections, and improve financial sustainability.

Responsibilities

  • Financial Oversight:
  1. Review and validate all invoices submitted by the operator for accuracy and compliance.
  2. Review and validate quotations for services and ensure alignment with agreed contractual terms.
  3. Collaborate with Finance and KAUST leadership on budget adherence, forecasting, and expenditure control.
  4. Lead the preparation, monitoring, and control of annual budgets in alignment with KAUST Health's strategic and operational goals.
  5. Provide monthly financial analysis and variance reports with recommendations for corrective actions.

  • Insurance & Revenue Cycle Management:
  1. Oversee the monthly insurance claim submission process across all insurance companies.
  2. Validate claim accuracy, completeness, and compliance with insurance requirements.
  3. Monitor rejection rates and develop action plans to reduce claim denials and improve collection timelines.
  4. Lead reconciliation meetings with the operator and insurers to resolve discrepancies.
  5. Ensure transparency and accountability in claim and payment processes.

  • Reporting & Analysis:
  1. Provide regular financial and insurance claim performance reports to senior leadership.
  2. Track KPIs related to financial and revenue cycle performance.
  3. identify risks and opportunities for revenue optimization.
  4. Work closely with the Head of Health, Operations Manager, and Finance department to ensure alignment of financial and operational objectives.
  5. Support audits and ensure compliance with internal and external financial regulations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree (required) in Finance or Accounting (preferred).
  • Master’s degree in Finance (preferred).
  • Professional certifications (e.g., CPA, CMA) are an advantage.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience, with at least 3 years in a lead role.
  • Proven experience in the healthcare sector finance, insurance, or revenue cycle management.
  • Strong background in financial analysis, budgeting, and reporting.
  • Hands-on experience with insurance claim processes, validation, and reconciliation.
  • Demonstrated experience in preparing, managing, and monitoring budgets within a healthcare environment.

jobs.title: Finance Officer

  • Good planning and organizational skills

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications

jobs.title: Finance Officer -Shared Services (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Finance Officer provides customer-focused finance and procurement support to the (VPR) portfolio. The role ensures efficient and compliant day-to-day purchasing, supports staff in using procurement processes correctly, and promotes best practice across purchase-to-pay activities.

The position also supports revenue generation and financial management by developing, maintaining, and updating costing and pricing for research infrastructures and platforms, in alignment with institutional strategy, offering competitiveness, and approved costing principles.

Responsibilities

  • Provide customer-focused procurement and finance support to the VPR portfolio.
  • Process purchase requisitions, receipting, and purchase-to-pay activities in compliance with institutional policies.
  • Act as the main point of contact for purchase order, invoice, and payment-related queries, liaising with internal teams and suppliers.
  • Develop, maintain, and update costing and pricing for research infrastructure services in line with institutional costing principles.
  • Coordinate with Core Labs, Platform teams, and Business Partners to prepare accurate project-based quotations.
  • Ensure pricing is competitive, strategically aligned, and accurately maintained in internal systems.
  • Prepare, issue, and process customer and supplier invoices, ensuring accuracy and supporting documentation.
  • Monitor invoice status through to payment and follow up to ensure timely settlement.
  • Ensure correct financial coding and allocation of costs, resolving discrepancies as required.
  • Maintain accurate records, support audits, and contribute to continuous improvement of finance and procurement processes.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, supply chain, business administration, or a related discipline.
  • 4 years’ experience in finance, procurement, or administrative support, preferably in a higher education or complex organisation.
  • Experience working in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment with multiple priorities.
  • Understanding of procurement policies, compliance, and financial controls (or willingness to learn).
  • Strong organisational skills with high attention to detail.
  • Confidence using financial and procurement systems.
  • Experience working with ERP systems (e.g. SAP, Oracle, or similar financial/procurement platforms).
  • Ability to extract, review, and reconcile financial data, including pricing, invoices, and cost allocations.

jobs.title: Financial Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Eram Talent, a leading global talent acquisition solutions provider specializing in multi-industry recruitment, is hiring for its prestigious client.

The Financial Operations Analyst is responsible for the invoice verification and accounting operation of C&C active contracts and projects. The Financial Operations Analyst role’s main responsibilities are: invoice verification, tracking, reporting, analysing, and recording all contractual and associated financial expenditure.

The work location for this role would be onsite at Thuwwal, Saudi Arabia.


Key Responsibilities

Invoice Verification: Verify invoices for accuracy of C&C active contracts and projects in accordance with Purchase Orders and contract terms and conditions, ensuring full compliance with published organizational policies, procedures, accounting principles, and financial regulations.

Financial Processing & SAP Management: Ensure completeness of documentation for all invoices and financial actions across all projects and contracts; obtain appropriate approvals, create SAP entries, ensure all costs are correctly charged to assigned WBS/Cost Center and GL codes, and support the Finance department for payment finalization.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Develop strong relationships with proponents, vendors, and internal departments. Handle customer requests and queries, resolve discrepancies or operational issues (such as PO extensions or invalid charging codes), investigate slow approvals, and assist with past due or denied invoices.

Reporting & Financial Analysis: Provide accurate reports and detailed analysis on invoices, vendor financial data, trends, and performance across contracts and projects using modern business tools and analytical techniques.

Process Improvement: Continuously review business processes and systems to recommend effective, practical improvements in line with industry best practices.

General Support: Perform other applicable tasks and duties assigned within the realm of the employee’s knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of the position.

Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, or a closely related field.
  • Experience: Minimum of four (4) years of relevant professional experience in a similar financial operations, accounting, or project finance role.

Technical & Core Competencies

  • Software Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of MS Office Suite and the SAP Finance Module.
  • Accounting Expertise: Comprehensive understanding of best practices in accounting, financial management, and business processes in compliance with relevant legislation and accounting standards.
  • Communication: Excellent command of both oral and written English.
  • Professional Conduct: Demonstrated ability to handle confidential information with discretion and work professionally with individuals across all organizational levels.
  • Performance Under Pressure: Proven ability to manage competing priorities, work under pressure, and deliver high-quality results within tight deadlines.

jobs.title: Financial Program Controller
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Program Controller on behalf of our esteemed client in Dhahran. In this role, you will play a critical part in supporting enterprise-level strategic programs by driving financial oversight, program governance, performance tracking, and executive reporting.

The ideal candidate possesses strong financial acumen, expertise in dashboard design, and the ability to synthesize complex project data into actionable insights for senior leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cost & Benefits Validation: Support cost estimation, calculate estimated program benefits, and validate financial outcomes against business cases.
  • Program Governance & Management: Apply strong program governance frameworks to support the planning, coordination, and execution of strategic enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Dashboard Development: Design, build, and maintain comprehensive performance dashboards tracking financial metrics, schedules, risks, and benefit realization.
  • Executive Reporting: Synthesize complex program data into clear, concise, and visually compelling communication materials to facilitate executive decision-making.
  • Variance Analysis: Conduct detailed variance analysis (cost vs. budget, schedule vs. plan) and propose proactive corrective action plans.
  • Risk & Issue Tracking: Track program risks and issues within established governance frameworks, ensuring effective mitigation strategies are implemented.
  • Analytical & Quantitative: Strong ability to interpret complex financial data, perform quantitative modeling, and deliver clear strategic insights.
  • Problem-Solving: Proven ability to identify, analyze, and resolve cost overruns or budget deviations effectively.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a strong track record of collaborating across Project Management and Finance teams.
  • Technical & Data Tools: * Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot tables, complex formulas, financial modeling).
    • Hands-on proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, or similar dashboarding tools.
    • Familiarity with project management platforms (e.g., MS Project, Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet).
  • Attention to Detail: High accuracy and precision in data analysis and financial reporting.

Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in one of the following fields:

  • Finance
  • Accounting
  • Economics
  • Business Administration
  • Information Systems
  • Industrial Engineering (with a focus on Finance)

Academic Threshold: Minimum GPA of 3.0 / 4.0 (or 4.0 / 5.0 equivalent).

  • Hands-on experience with Earned Value Management (EVM) principles.
  • Familiarity with tracking Capital Expenditure (CapEx) and Operational Expenditure (OpEx).
  • Knowledge of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems for integrated financial tracking.
  • Preferred Certifications
    • Certified Cost Professional (CCP) or Certified Cost Technician (CCT)
    • Certified Financial Planner (CFP) or Certified Management Accountant (CMA)
    • Project Management Professional (PMP)
    • Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate (Power BI)
    • Microsoft Office Specialist (MOS) – Advanced Excel

jobs.title: Fire Apparatus Operator (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Job Purpose:

Provide 24/7 fire and emergency response to protect personnel, property, and the environment. Maintain readiness of all firefighting equipment and ensure safe, effective incident control.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Respond to fire, rescue, and hazardous material incidents.
  • Follow company fire protection policies, SOPs, and safety standards.
  • Participate in regular drills and emergency response training.
  • Maintain operational readiness of personnel, vehicles, and equipment.
  • Support review and updates of Emergency Response Plans.
  • Submit timely reports on fire and emergency activities.

Educational requirement:

  • High School
  • Diploma Holder with related disciplines

Required Certifications:

  • NFPA 1001: Firefighter I & II
  • NFPA 472: Hazmat Awareness & Operations
  • NFPA 1002: Fire Apparatus Driver/Operator

Skills & Requirements:

  • Strong firefighting and rescue skills.
  • Physically fit and safety-oriented.
  • Team player with good communication skills.
  • Willing to work shifts and relocate as required.

Reports To:

Fire Station Officer / Fire Protection Supervisor

Location:

Tabuk, Sulail, Jouf, Turaif, Mubaraz – Saudi Arabia

jobs.title: Fire fighters - NFPA (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
We are looking for qualified Firefighters to join our client’s emergency response team in the Eastern Province. The role involves responding to fire and emergency incidents, operating firefighting equipment, supporting emergency preparedness activities, and ensuring the readiness of personnel and equipment in accordance with company procedures and applicable fire safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Respond promptly to fire, rescue, hazardous materials, and other emergency incidents within the designated area to protect life, property, and the environment.
  • Perform firefighting, rescue, containment, and emergency control activities using appropriate equipment and established procedures.
  • Follow company fire protection policies, standard operating procedures, emergency response plans, and applicable Saudi fire safety requirements.
  • Participate in scheduled emergency response drills, training exercises, and reviews or updates of Emergency Response Plans.
  • Inspect, maintain, and ensure the operational readiness of firefighting vehicles, breathing apparatus, protective equipment, tools, and other emergency response equipment.
  • Respond to hazardous materials incidents using appropriate personal protective equipment and established Hazmat response procedures.
  • Coordinate with firefighters, emergency response personnel, operations teams, and relevant authorities during emergency situations.
  • Prepare timely and accurate reports on fire incidents, emergency response activities, equipment inspections, drills, and other assigned activities.

Requirements

  • High School Diploma or Diploma in Firefighting, Fire & Safety, or a related field.
  • Previous professional experience as a Firefighter in industrial, commercial, residential, drilling, or similar emergency response environments.
  • NFPA 1001 – Fire Fighter I & II certification is required.
  • NFPA 472 – Hazmat Awareness & Operations (A&O) certification is required.
  • Good knowledge of fire emergency response, hazardous materials, technical rescue, fire prevention, and fire safety procedures.
  • Ability to participate in emergency drills, emergency response planning, and maintain readiness of firefighting personnel and equipment.
  • Good English proficiency.
  • Knowledge of applicable Saudi fire safety standards and requirements.
  • Ability to work in emergency response environments and follow safety procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Oil & Gas, petrochemical, industrial, drilling, or similar high-risk environments.
  • Experience with industrial firefighting vehicles, pumps, hoses, breathing apparatus, and rescue equipment.
  • NFPA 1002 – Fire Apparatus Driver/Operator Professional certification is preferred for candidates assigned to Fire Apparatus Pump Operator responsibilities.
  • Experience participating in emergency response drills and fire risk mitigation activities.

jobs.title: Fire Safety Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Fire Safety Engineer to join our team. The Fire Safety Engineer is responsible for delivering technical fire and life safety engineering activities under the direction of the Fire Safety Engineering Lead. The role supports

delegated Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) governance framework by conducting technical reviews,

field assessments, inspections, compliance verification, fire risk assessments, and technical investigations

within approved procedures and delegated authorities. The role prepares technical

recommendations for review and approval through the Lead, Fire Safety Engineer and the Health and

Safety Manager, as applicable. The Fire Safety Engineer also supports compliance with Saudi Civil Defense

requirements, Saudi Building Code (SBC), National Fire Protection Association (NFPA), International Fire

Code (IFC), and requirements by maintaining audit-ready evidence, verifying fire protection system

performance, supporting Civil Defense-related documentation and inspections where applicable, and

escalating significant fire and life safety risks.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct fire and life safety engineering reviews, inspections, assessments, and field verifications.
  • Review new construction, renovations, fire protection systems, and high-hazard facilities.
  • Conduct fire risk assessments and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
  • Ensure compliance with Saudi Building Code (SBC), Saudi Civil Defense, NFPA, IFC, and applicable fire safety requirements.
  • Support inspection, testing, maintenance, commissioning, and verification of fire protection systems.
  • Review systems including fire alarms, water-based and special suppression, smoke control, passive fire protection, fire doors, barriers, and means of egress.
  • Investigate fire incidents, system failures, unwanted alarms, and other fire and life safety issues.
  • Coordinate with projects, facilities, contractors, consultants, and other stakeholders.

Requirements

Bachelor's Degree in Fire Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related Engineering discipline.

Minimum 6 years of professional experience in Fire Protection Engineering, Fire Systems, Fire Prevention, or Fire & Life Safety Compliance.

Strong knowledge of SBC, NFPA, IFC, and Saudi Civil Defense requirements.

Experience in fire protection system inspections, testing, commissioning, and compliance.

Experience reviewing technical drawings, designs, specifications, and inspection documentation.

International fire safety certifications such as CFPS, CFPE, NICET, IFE, or equivalent are preferred.

Valid driver's license required.

jobs.title: Fire Safety Engineering Lead (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Fire Safety Engineering Lead will act as a technical subject matter expert responsible for leading fire and life safety engineering activities at KAUST. The role will provide technical leadership in fire engineering design reviews, compliance validation, fire risk assessments, inspections, investigations, and continuous improvement.

The position will also lead and mentor Fire Safety Engineers, support the Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) framework, and ensure compliance with Saudi Building Code (SBC), NFPA, International Fire Code (IFC), and KAUST requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical delivery and execution of fire and life safety engineering activities.
  • Lead, supervise, mentor, and develop a team of Fire Safety Engineers.
  • Conduct technical reviews and compliance validation in accordance with KAUST procedures and delegated authorities.
  • Review fire and life safety designs for new construction, renovations, research facilities, and high-hazard environments.
  • Apply and interpret Saudi Building Code (SBC), NFPA, International Fire Code (IFC), and KAUST requirements.
  • Conduct fire risk assessments and develop risk-based mitigation strategies.
  • Oversee fire and life safety inspections, field assessments, system verifications, and incident investigations.
  • Provide technical assurance for inspection, testing, and maintenance (ITM) of fire protection systems.
  • Review fire protection system deficiencies and escalate overdue or high-risk corrective actions.
  • Lead or support investigations related to fire incidents, system failures, impairments, and unwanted fire alarms.
  • Identify root causes and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
  • Develop and deliver fire and life safety training for engineering, operations, emergency response, and other personnel.
  • Develop and maintain fire engineering standards, technical procedures, and guidance documents.
  • Establish and monitor fire and life safety objectives, metrics, and KPIs.
  • Analyze performance data, identify trends, and lead technical improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate and audit-ready technical, inspection, investigation, and compliance records.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Fire Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Minimum 8+ years of professional experience in fire protection engineering, fire systems engineering, or a closely related field.
  • Strong practical knowledge of Saudi Building Code (SBC), NFPA, and International Fire Code (IFC).
  • Proven experience in fire engineering design reviews and compliance validation.
  • Proven experience conducting fire risk assessments and developing mitigation strategies.
  • Experience with fire protection system inspection, testing, and maintenance activities.
  • Experience leading or supporting fire incident investigations and corrective and preventive actions.
  • Proven experience leading, supervising, and mentoring technical engineering professionals.
  • Strong knowledge of fire and life safety engineering principles and practices.
  • Chartered Engineer (CEng), Professional Engineer (PE), or equivalent certification is preferred.
  • Recognized fire protection or fire safety certifications such as NFPA CFPS, CFPE, CFAITMS, CWBSP, or NICET are preferred.

The position will also lead and mentor Fire Safety Engineers, support the Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) framework, and ensure compliance with Saudi Building Code (SBC), NFPA, International Fire Code (IFC), and KAUST requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical delivery and execution of fire and life safety engineering activities.
  • Lead, supervise, mentor, and develop a team of Fire Safety Engineers.
  • Conduct technical reviews and compliance validation in accordance with KAUST procedures and delegated authorities.
  • Review fire and life safety designs for new construction, renovations, research facilities, and high-hazard environments.
  • Apply and interpret Saudi Building Code (SBC), NFPA, International Fire Code (IFC), and KAUST requirements.
  • Conduct fire risk assessments and develop risk-based mitigation strategies.
  • Oversee fire and life safety inspections, field assessments, system verifications, and incident investigations.
  • Provide technical assurance for inspection, testing, and maintenance (ITM) of fire protection systems.
  • Review fire protection system deficiencies and escalate overdue or high-risk corrective actions.
  • Lead or support investigations related to fire incidents, system failures, impairments, and unwanted fire alarms.
  • Identify root causes and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
  • Develop and deliver fire and life safety training for engineering, operations, emergency response, and other personnel.
  • Develop and maintain fire engineering standards, technical procedures, and guidance documents.
  • Establish and monitor fire and life safety objectives, metrics, and KPIs.
  • Analyze performance data, identify trends, and lead technical improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate and audit-ready technical, inspection, investigation, and compliance records.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Fire Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Minimum 8+ years of professional experience in fire protection engineering, fire systems engineering, or a closely related field.
  • Strong practical knowledge of Saudi Building Code (SBC), NFPA, and International Fire Code (IFC).
  • Proven experience in fire engineering design reviews and compliance validation.
  • Proven experience conducting fire risk assessments and developing mitigation strategies.
  • Experience with fire protection system inspection, testing, and maintenance activities.
  • Experience leading or supporting fire incident investigations and corrective and preventive actions.
  • Proven experience leading, supervising, and mentoring technical engineering professionals.
  • Strong knowledge of fire and life safety engineering principles and practices.
  • Chartered Engineer (CEng), Professional Engineer (PE), or equivalent certification is preferred.
  • Recognized fire protection or fire safety certifications such as NFPA CFPS, CFPE, CFAITMS, CWBSP, or NICET are preferred.

jobs.title: Gas Distribution SCADA Specialist (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking an experienced Gas Distribution SCADA Specialist to join a leading energy company in Saudi Arabia. To maintain and administer SCADA system of Marafiq Gas Distribution Network (GDN) in Yanbu including its communication network in order to ensure high equipment availability and optimize system performance..

As a Gas Distribution SCADA Specialist, you will be responsible for the development, implementation, and maintenance of SCADA systems, facilitating real-time monitoring and control of gas distribution activities. Your technical expertise will be critical in maintaining operational integrity and supporting the technical needs of the distribution network.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on SCADA application software, operating systems, hardware, RTUs, and communication networks of the GDN system.
  • Administer and manage SCADA systems and networks, including installation, configuration, and troubleshooting of Windows operating systems and services.
  • Monitor SCADA system performance such as alarms, events, CPU usage, disk space, and network traffic to ensure reliability and efficiency.
  • Analyze and manage real-time data using monitoring techniques, data historian tools, and visualization platforms to extract and present system information.
  • Provide technical support to operations by troubleshooting SCADA failures, generating reports, and resolving system issues.
  • Conduct testing, commissioning, and integration of new SCADA systems, devices, and applications to ensure compatibility with existing infrastructure.
  • Manage system security and user administration, including creating and managing user accounts, password resets, and defining access responsibilities.
  • Maintain backups and disaster recovery processes, ensuring full system backups and restoration in case of partial or complete system failures.
  • Handle hardware maintenance and inventory control, including repairing SCADA equipment, monitoring spare parts stock, and supporting AMI maintenance activities.
  • Support project and engineering activities, including reviewing design packages, participating in site surveys, evaluating technical proposals, managing OPEX/CAPEX tasks, coordinating with vendors/OEMs, and participating in reliability and safety studies (RCA, RCM, HAZOP, IPF).

Requirements

  • Bachelor Degree in I&C Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering or equivalent.
  • A minimum of 8 years of experience in SCADA systems specific to gas distribution.
  • 8 years field experience with major utility organizations or SCADA system manufacturers.
  • Enough working experience in SCADA systems of Gas Distribution Network including RTUs in metering skids and related communication systems.
  • Enough working experience in Wonderware SCADA system and Emerson RTUs of Metering Skids.
  • Good understanding of communication protocols and interfaces such as Modbus, RS232/485 etc.
  • Enough working experience in SAP - Plant Maintenance module.
  • Proficient in operating Wonderware SCADA systems and working with Emerson RTUs.
  • Experience with gas distribution networks, including RTUs in metering and control systems.
  • Strong knowledge of communication protocols (Modbus, RS232/RS485, etc.) and integration of field devices.
  • Working experience with SAP - Plant Maintenance module.
  • Relevant certifications such as MCSA, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent are preferred.

jobs.title: Geologist
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Core Logging Geologist to join our mineral exploration team. The successful candidate will be responsible for detailed geological logging of drill core, sample management, and supporting exploration programs focused on base metals with a strong emphasis on gold exploration. The role requires excellent geological interpretation skills, adherence to industry standards, and the ability to work effectively in remote field environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform detailed geological, structural, alteration, mineralization, and geotechnical logging of diamond drill core.
  • Identify and record lithological units, mineral assemblages, alteration styles, and structural features accurately.
  • Support exploration targeting through geological interpretation and integration of drilling data.
  • Ensure accurate sample selection, marking, and preparation in accordance with QA/QC procedures.
  • Maintain high-quality geological databases and ensure data integrity.
  • Work closely with drilling contractors and exploration teams to coordinate drilling activities and core handling.
  • Assist in geological mapping, trench logging, and field reconnaissance as required.
  • Interpret exploration results and contribute to technical reports and daily progress updates.
  • Follow company Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) policies and maintain safe work practices.
  • Support resource evaluation activities by providing accurate geological data.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Geology, Applied Geology, or a related Earth Science discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on field experience in mineral exploration.
  • Proven expertise in core logging for base metal exploration, with significant experience in gold exploration projects.
  • Strong understanding of structural geology, alteration mineralogy, and ore deposit geology.
  • Experience with geological logging software and database management systems.
  • Knowledge of QA/QC protocols for drilling and sampling.
  • Ability to work independently in remote field locations under challenging conditions.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and report-writing skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and geological data management software.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience working on greenfield and brownfield exploration projects.
  • Familiarity with industry reporting standards and exploration best practices.
  • Ability to interpret geological data and contribute to exploration targeting.
  • Strong teamwork and problem-solving abilities.

Work Environment

  • Field-based role with extended rotations at remote exploration sites.
  • Willingness to travel and work flexible schedules based on project requirements.

Key Competencies

  • Geological interpretation
  • Core logging and sampling
  • Mineral exploration
  • Data accuracy and attention to detail
  • Team collaboration
  • Safety awareness
  • Technical reporting
  • Time management

jobs.title: Health & Safety (HSE) Analyst
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Health & Safety Analyst to join our dynamic team. As a leading talent acquisition consultancy, Eram Talent specializes in providing top-notch recruitment solutions across various industries.

In this role, you will be responsible for analyzing health and safety data, conducting risk assessments, and providing insights and recommendations to enhance the overall safety performance of the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Collects, analyzes, and interprets data to improve workplace safety, environmental performance, and regulatory compliance.
  •  Conducting risk assessments, investigating incidents, preparing compliance reports, developing and delivering training, and collaborating with teams to implement safety initiatives and reduce hazards.
  •  This role requires a strong understanding of HSE regulations and data analysis to provide insights that support management decisions and promote a safety-first culture.
  •  EHS analyst provides support in planning, implementation and monitoring of environmental, health, and safety programs and policies to ensure compliance
  •  Track Environmental, Health and Safety metrics including Ǫuarterly KPIs and PPE Acknowledgement submissions
  •  Conduct formal and systematic reviews of campus operations and activities to ensure compliance with regulations.
  •  Responsible for the accuracy and auditing of all Safety related statistics
  •  Track safety, health and Environmental audit documents
  •  Work with affected departments to coordinate, implement and maintain employee /
  • trainee injury prevention strategies and program(s)
  •  Provide hazard analysis, program customization, training and EHS support to activities within the organization, creative services and scripted television production activities
  •  Support the maintenance of EHS database of accidents and incidents
  •  Supports site in achieving EHS targets C objectives
  •  Track all the HSE related contracts’ submissions
  •  Organize and track HSE Campaigns
  •  HSE Records and Files control and management

Requirements

  • Relevant degrees such as bachelor’s degree in engineering, Industrial, Safety, Health, Environmental Science
  • Relevant Certificates in HSE Fields such as OSHA / NEBOSH.
  • 3-5 years in similar field
  • Knowledge in local safety regulations, EHS policies, standards and compliance
  • Experience in Microsoft Office
  • Fluent in English Language (Speaking, Writing, Reading)
  • Experience in Environmental Health, Fire Systems would be beneficial.

jobs.title: Health Quality Specialist (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a Health Quality Specialist to join our dynamic team in Saudi Arabia. As a leading talent acquisition consultancy, we are committed to connecting skilled professionals with top-tier companies.

The Quality and Governance Specialist ensure the maintenance of high standards of quality, compliance, and governance within KAUST Health. This role involves developing and overseeing clinical quality assurance initiatives and frameworks, ensuring adherence to regulatory standards, and working across departments to promote best practices and maintain accreditation. The Specialist provides expert knowledge and guidance to KAUST Health and helps maintain the oversight of the medical services provider, ensuring that all necessary documentation and records are kept in compliance with regulations. This position is pivotal in driving continuous improvement and safeguarding the delivery of safe, effective, and compliant healthcare services.

Responsibilities

  • Support the development and implementation of quality, governance, and clinical risk management frameworks.
  • Assist in creating and revising policies, procedures, and protocols to meet regulatory and accreditation standards.
  • Ensure compliance with JCI, CBAHI, and other accreditation requirements across all departments.
  • Conduct and support internal audits, performance assessments, and patient safety walks.
  • Analyze audit findings, KPIs, and incident reports to identify trends and areas for improvement.
  • Support Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and incident investigation processes.
  • Participate in patient safety initiatives and promote a proactive safety culture.
  • Provide operational and clinical support to the School Health Office, nursing teams, and relevant committees.
  • Engage with internal and external stakeholders to promote quality and contract compliance.
  • Oversee and support quality control initiatives at the Family and Child Support Centre (FCSC), including audits and action plans.

Requirements

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Nursing or a medical-related specialty (or graduation from an accredited nursing school).
  2. Minimum 5 years of relevant healthcare experience.
  3. At least 3 years of experience in quality, governance, or accreditation-related roles.
  4. Experience working in a healthcare environment in Saudi Arabia (preferred).
  5. Strong knowledge of quality improvement methodologies and clinical governance practices.
  6. Direct experience with JCI, CBAHI, or other healthcare accreditation processes (highly desirable).
  7. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and identify risks.
  8. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.
  9. Ability to build effective working relationships across departments and teams.
  10. Excellent verbal and written English proficiency.

jobs.title: Health, Safety and Environment Specialist (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is currently seeking a dedicated Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) Specialist to join our team in Saudi Arabia. The HSE specialist ensures the safety and compliance of construction and projects by delivering and implementing risk-based safety programs, providing expert HSE guidance, and fostering a strong safety culture throughout the project's lifecycle. They ensure construction and project safety programs are effectively designed and executed. The role ensures a robust health and safety management system throughout the lifecycle of assigned construction and projects. They provide expert advice and guidance to stakeholders, including Project Managers, Engineers, and clients on HSE matters at every stage, including project handover.  The role ensures the development and execution of risk-based safety programs, performing comprehensive safety assessments, and overseeing compliance to maintain safe, healthy, and regulation-compliant environments 

Responsibilities

  • Review and approve RAMS (Risk Assessments and Method Statements) to ensure the safety of personnel, property, and ongoing activities.
  • Implement and maintain HSE management systems and project safety programs, including risk-based inspections, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory environmental, health, and safety standards through regular inspections of equipment, structures, and work activities.
  • Lead and support incident investigations by identifying root causes, recommending corrective actions, and producing detailed reports in line with HSE procedures.
  • Conduct regular safety meetings, training sessions, and Toolbox Talks to promote awareness and reinforce a strong safety culture.
  • Monitor and analyze HSE performance metrics (KPIs), providing actionable insights and recommendations to improve safety strategies and program effectiveness.
  • Perform audits and risk-based inspections to ensure compliance, track corrective actions, and verify effective mitigation of identified hazards.
  • Review critical documentation such as safety plans, permits to work, lifting plans, MOCs, and design documents to ensure alignment with HSE requirements.
  • Maintain effective communication with stakeholders, ensuring lessons learned are shared and corrective measures are properly implemented.
  • Support overall project lifecycle activities, including site inspections, safety training delivery, regulatory compliance, and adherence to HSE policies, while demonstrating strong reporting, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement skills.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in construction safety or HSE roles within large-scale projects.
  • Experience working with Integrated Management Systems (IMS), including ISO standards (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001).
  • Certified ISO 45001:2018 Lead Auditor qualification is required.
  • Proven competency in Incident Investigation and Root Cause Analysis techniques.
  • Recognized professional HSE certification such as Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or Construction Health and Safety Technician (CHST) is preferred.
  • Internationally recognized certification such as NEBOSH Certificate or Diploma is highly desirable.
  • Certified First Aid qualification is preferred.
  • Valid driver’s license is required.
  • Strong practical knowledge of construction safety practices, risk management, and regulatory compliance in international environments.
  • Strong commitment to promoting safety culture and environmental sustainability.

jobs.title: Heavy Equipment assessor (Trainer)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking experienced professionals to conduct Heavy Equipment Assessments. As a global Talent Acquisition Consultancy, Eram Talent is committed to providing outstanding recruitment and certification solutions across various industries. The assessor will be responsible for evaluating the competencies of heavy equipment operators to ensure compliance with industry standards and safety requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct thorough assessments of heavy equipment operators’ competencies, including practical and theoretical evaluations.
  • Ensure assessments adhere to company policies and regulatory standards.
  • Maintain accurate records of assessment results and provide detailed reports.
  • Provide constructive feedback to operators to help improve their skills and safety practices.
  • Collaborate with the training team to assist in the development and updating of assessment materials.
  • Assist in quality assurance and compliance audits related to operator competency.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 3 years experience operating heavy equipment.
  • Minimum of 5 years Industrial experience of specific role.
  • 3 years of experience as instructor/teacher.
  • Academic and Professional Qualifications (minimum)
  • Technical qualifications or diploma in the relevant craft/subject.
  • Certified in specific area of expertise:
  • Heavy Equipment (Backhoe- Bulldozer- Forklift- Wheel loader- Backhoe loader- … etc, Cranes, and/or Rigging.
  • Knowledge of Training/Assessment development would be an advantage.
  • Previous experience in assessment or evaluation roles preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of heavy equipment operation including Backhoe, Bulldozer, Forklift, Grader, Wheel loader, Skid loader, Backhoe loader, Sideboom, and Telehandler.
  • Familiarity with industry safety standards and certification processes.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Ability to provide clear, constructive feedback and maintain professionalism during assessments.
  • Relevant certifications or qualifications in heavy equipment operation and assessment are preferred.

Benefits

Salary is not a constraint ,company is looking for right candidate .

jobs.description:

The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating and monitoring HSE activities, ensuring compliance with Saudi Aramco and project HSE requirements, and promoting a strong safety culture across operational sites.

Candidates with experience in both Rig/Drilling and Non-Rig Oil & Gas environments are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and monitor the implementation of HSE policies, procedures, and project safety requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with Saudi Aramco HSE standards, client requirements, and applicable regulations.
  • Conduct regular HSE inspections, audits, and site safety assessments.
  • Identify unsafe acts, unsafe conditions, and potential hazards and recommend corrective actions.

  • Participate in incident and accident investigations, including root cause analysis and corrective action follow-up.

  • Monitor the proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and other HSE-critical equipment.
  • Participate in safety meetings and communicate HSE alerts, lessons learned, and safety initiatives to employees.
  • Follow up on observations, audit findings, and non-conformances to ensure timely closure of corrective actions.
  • Promote a proactive safety culture and encourage reporting of unsafe acts and conditions.
  • Coordinate with project management, supervisors, contractors, and client representatives on HSE-related matters.
  • Monitor environmental compliance, waste management, spill prevention, and other environmental protection requirements.

Requirements

jobs.title: HSE Coordinator Rig/NonRig
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly proactive and qualified HSE Coordinator (Rig / Non-Rig) to champion our health, safety, and environmental initiatives across both dynamic field drilling operations and support facility environments. In this role, you will be responsible for implementing safety frameworks, driving compliance, and fostering a zero-incident safety culture on active rigs, industrial yards, and office locations.

Key Responsibilities

1. Rig & Field Operations Safety

  • Enforce strict compliance with company HSE policies, Life-Saving Rules, and client-specific safety frameworks.
  • Manage and audit the Permit-to-Work (PTW) system and Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures on the rig floor.
  • Conduct daily safety walks, rig inspections, DROPS (dropped objects) surveys, and lifting equipment checks.
  • Lead and facilitate daily Toolbox Talks, Job Safety Analyses (JSA / JHA), and pre-tour safety meetings.
  • Supervise high-risk operations, including confined space entry, hot work, work at height, and simultaneous operations (SIMOPS).

2. Non-Rig & Facility Safety

  • Coordinate safety programs for supply warehouses, pipe yards, logistics centers, and administrative offices.
  • Perform regular occupational hygiene walks, evaluating ergonomics, lighting, noise, and air quality.
  • Oversee waste management, hazardous material storage (MSDS/SDS compliance), and environmental controls.
  • Ensure all emergency systems, fire protection tools, and first aid supplies are inspected and fully operational.

3. Incident Management & Training

  • Deliver comprehensive HSE inductions for new employees, contractors, and visitors.
  • Participate in incident investigations utilizing root-cause tools (e.g., 5-Why, ICAM) and track corrective actions to closure.
  • Organize and evaluate routine emergency drills (fire, well control, H2S release, medical evacuation).
  • Maintain precise safety logs, incident data, and weekly/monthly HSE performance dashboards.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree or Higher Diploma in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, or a related science discipline.
  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree or Higher Diploma in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, or a related science discipline.
  • Experience: Minimum 5 to 7 years of hands-on HSE experience within the oil and gas drilling sector, with at least 2+ years working directly on Aramco-approved projects or rigs.
  • Certifications:
    • Mandatory: NEBOSH International General Certificate (IGC).
    • Mandatory: Valid Saudi Aramco HSE Approval / Work Permit Receiver (WPR) certification (or capability to clear the Aramco vendor approval process).
    • Preferred: OSHA 30-Hour, tapRooT Incident Investigation, or ISO 45001/14001 Internal Auditor certification.

  • Skills: Deep understanding of Aramco Safety Management System (SMS) expectations. Strong communication skills with command of written and spoken English.

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Experience in Oil & Gas, petrochemical, manufacturing, power generation, or other industrial environments is preferred.

jobs.title: Industrial Hygiene Technician (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a skilled Industrial Hygiene Technician to join our team in Saudi Arabia. The Industrial Hygiene Technician will support the implementation and maintenance of industrial hygiene programs to ensure a safe and healthy work environment for all employees.

Education and Certification:

  • Diploma in Environmental Science, Natural Science, Chemistry Science, or higher. 
  • Occupational Hygiene and Safety Technician (OHST) certification or equivalent
  • Knowledge and / or the ability to quickly learn OSHA and similar regulations and consensus standards governing industrial hygiene. 

Experience:

  • At least 3 years of working experience in Industrial Hygiene function in a petrochemical, refining, fertilizer and/or chemical industry. 

Other Requirements:

  • Knowledge and / or the ability to quickly learn conducting hazard identifications, PPE assessments, job safety analyses for work activities and industrial hygiene programs. 
  • Must be customer focused and results driven, with the ability to effectively collaborate and work with company and contractor personnel at various levels throughout the facility. 
  • Must have high levels of self-motivation and self-confidence. 
  • Good oral and written communication skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office computer applications. 

Requirements

Skills:

  • Knowledge and / or the ability to quickly learn using direct reading instrumentation such as sound level meters, sampling pumps, multi-gas monitors, Lux meters, and Photo-ionisation detectors (PIDs). 
  • Knowledge and/or ability to perform qualitative and quantitative hazard assessment.

 

Abilities:

  • Ability to work both independently and in a team environment
  • Support the Industrial Hygienist with the implementation and execution of the Industrial Hygiene Program.  
  • Perform industrial hygiene surveys in the workplace, e.g. Heat Stress monitoring, Noise Surveys, Chemical exposure surveys, Lighting surveys, and Ergonomic studies. 
  • Ensure calibration and operability of all industrial hygiene instrumentation; maintain inventory of associated industrial hygiene sampling consumable materials. 
  • Prepare all industrial hygiene sampling media and ensure dispatch of samples to external analytical facilities.
  • Supports implementation of Respiratory Protection Program including operation of breathing air compressor    
  • Conduct respirator fit testing and the associated record keeping. 
  • Conducts inspection/function test of respirators.
  • Supports maintenance and calibration of multi-gas detectors.
  • Provide day-to-day industrial hygiene support for Plant personnel & contractors, including participation in PPE assessments, job safety analyses and workplace hazard assessments. 
  • Participate in compliance audits, conduct formal audits on IH program

jobs.title: Industrial Skills Trainer - Computer
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking an experienced Industrial Skills Trainer – Computer to deliver technical training programs and practical learning sessions in computer and technology-related disciplines. The trainer will be responsible for developing and delivering training content, workshops, practical exercises, presentations, and assessments while ensuring effective knowledge transfer and participant engagement. The ideal candidate has 3–5 years of practical experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, Programming, or related technology areas, along with strong presentation and facilitation skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, prepare, and deliver technical training programs, courses, workshops, and seminars based on organizational training needs and objectives.
  • Deliver engaging technical learning experiences through practical demonstrations, hands-on activities, case studies, and digital learning methods.
  • Develop and deliver training content, practical exercises, presentations, and assessments using appropriate learning technologies, virtual platforms, and digital tools.
  • Explain complex technical concepts clearly to participants with different levels of knowledge and technical backgrounds.
  • Facilitate classroom and practical training sessions while maintaining strong participant engagement and knowledge transfer.
  • Adapt training approaches and learning methods based on participant needs and varying levels of technical understanding.
  • Apply strong organization, time management, problem-solving, classroom management, and adaptability skills when delivering training programs.
  • Address technical challenges and respond effectively to participant requirements during training sessions.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or another technology-related field.

3–5 years of practical experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, Programming, or other relevant technology areas.

Strong knowledge and practical experience in one or more relevant technology areas, including IT, AI, Data Science, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, or Programming.

Excellent presentation, facilitation, communication, and interpersonal skills.

Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to participants with different levels of knowledge.

Proven ability to develop and deliver technical training content, practical exercises, presentations, and assessments.

Strong organization, time management, problem-solving, classroom management, and adaptability skills.

Relevant industry-recognized technical certifications in AI, Cloud Computing, Data Analytics, Cybersecurity, Programming, or other applicable technology domains are preferred.

jobs.title: Informatica (MDM) Developer - Data Governance (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking an experienced Informatica (MDM) Developer specializing in Data Governance to join our team in Saudi Arabia. As a trusted Talent Acquisition Company, we support clients with top-tier talents to drive their data governance strategies and initiatives effectively.

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining Master Data Management (MDM) solutions using Informatica tools. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure data governance standards and processes are implemented and upheld.

If selected, the work location would be onsite at Al-Khobar, Saudi Arabia.

Responsibilities

  • Support the Product Manager in defining product roadmaps, prioritizing features, and overseeing product development processes.
  • Assist in developing project plans, timelines, and resource allocation under the guidance of the product manager.
  • Execute assigned tasks and activities within the project, ensuring adherence to project schedules and milestones.
  • Assist in identifying project risks and contribute to the development of mitigation strategies.
  • Support the product manager in communicating project progress and updates to stakeholders and senior management.
  • Support product teams in their product decisions using quantitative data to inform the next steps.
  • Utilize performance metrics to evaluate if product development is satisfactory and aligned with development plans.
  • Conduct desktop research to monitor competitor activities, as well as any price movements and make recommendations that will be used in key decision making.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience as an Informatica MDM Developer or similar role.
  • Strong expertise in Informatica MDM, including Hub Console, Data Director, and Data Integration Suite.
  • Candidate must be Informatica or MDM certified.
  • Candidate must have working experience with Master Data Management tools and technologies.
  • Must have practical experience in Data Quality, Data Governance, or IDQ.
  • Must have strong knowledge of data profiling, data validation, and data integration workflows.
  • Experience in data governance, data quality, and master data management concepts.
  • Proficiency in ETL development using Informatica PowerCenter and related tools.
  • Knowledge of relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server) and data modeling techniques.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Familiarity with data security, compliance standards, and governance frameworks.
  • Experience in the Saudi Arabia market or working with regional clients is considered a plus.

jobs.title: Innovation Consultant (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Innovation Consultant to help drive innovation initiatives across the organization. The ideal candidate will facilitate design thinking workshops, identify business opportunities, and work with cross-functional teams to develop innovative digital solutions and proof-of-concepts (POCs).

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead innovation and ideation workshops using design thinking methodologies.
  • Collaborate with business and technical teams to identify innovation opportunities.
  • Develop and validate digital proof-of-concepts (POCs) and prototypes.
  • Facilitate brainstorming sessions and support creative problem-solving.
  • Research market trends, emerging technologies, and industry best practices.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to translate business challenges into innovative solutions.
  • Promote a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Prepare presentations, reports, and recommendations for leadership.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Innovation Management, Design Thinking, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in innovation consulting, design thinking, digital transformation, or a related role.
  • Strong understanding of Design Thinking, Lean Startup, and innovation frameworks.
  • Experience facilitating workshops and managing innovation projects.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Innovation Project Associate (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is looking for an enthusiastic and driven Innovation Project Associate to join our innovative team in Saudi Arabia. The Project Associate supports the Innovation Program Manager in the operations and execution of the Innovation programs within the Entrepreneurship Center. The role entails the detailed Leading with different parties for the programs and communication with the participants to manage the full process of the Innovation programs from design to execution. The role will be responsible for working with internal and external partners, facilitate, and leading the activities required to run the Innovation programs.

Responsibilities

  • Perform applicable tasks and duties assigned within the realm of the employee’s knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of her/his position.
  • The role will be responsible for the execution of the Innovation programs in partnership with key local and global players.
  • Leading communication with internal and external stakeholders to execute the programs successfully.
  • Curate top talent to participate in the programs in partnership with the local and international universities.
  • Facilitate and co-deliver innovation activities and programs such as icebreakers, design sprints, ideation sessions and mentorship.
  • Liaise with other KAUST units in support of finalizing agreements to produce innovation program content.
  • Facilitate day to day meetings with partners to plan and execute innovation programs.
  • Monitor participation through onboarding and navigating program content.
  • Work with the marketing team on the planning, development and production of internal and external Marketing materials and publications
  • Facilitates the creation of content for Innovation programs to be delivered to the KAUST Marketing department.
  • Represent KAUST Entrepreneurship Center in local and international events and conferences.
  • Assist in implementing strategies for creating a comprehensive mechanism to communicate and manage innovation programs portfolio.
  • Support other programs within the Entrepreneurship Center in facilitating and delivering their training, sessions and workshops.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Innovation Management, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2-4 years of experience in project management, innovation, or related areas.
  • Understanding of project management methodologies and tools.
  • Strong research and analytical skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in teams.
  • Creative thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience in facilitating workshops and engaging with stakeholders is a plus.
  • Fluency in English; knowledge of Arabic is preferred.

Benefits

Salary is not a constraint ,company is looking for right candidate .

jobs.title: INSPECTOR (QM 30 AND QM 35)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a qualified and meticulous Inspector with experience in QM 30 and QM 35 inspections to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for conducting inspections as per QM 30 and QM 35 standards to ensure quality compliance in various projects across industries.

Your expertise will contribute to maintaining high-quality standards and ensuring adherence to established procedures, helping our clients achieve excellence in their operations.

Requirements

  • Proven experience working as an Inspector with specialization in QM 30 and QM 35 standards.
  • Strong knowledge and understanding of quality management systems and inspection criteria related to QM 30 and QM 35.
  • Ability to accurately perform inspections, document findings, and communicate results effectively.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to quality and safety standards.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Relevant certifications or training in QM 30 and QM 35 inspection procedures is advantageous.
  • Experience in preparing inspection reports and ensuring compliance with client requirements.

jobs.title: Instrument Foreman
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a highly skilled Instrument Foreman to join our dynamic team. As a prominent Talent Acquisition Consultancy, we focus on connecting top-tier professionals with leading organizations in the Oil & Energy sector. In this pivotal role, you will oversee and coordinate instrumentation activities on-site, ensuring that all work is executed according to project specifications and industry standards.

The Instrument Foreman will be responsible for managing a team of instrumentation technicians, providing guidance and support to ensure timely and efficient completion of assigned tasks. You will work closely with project managers and engineers to align activities with project timelines and safety protocols.

Responsibilities

  • Supervise and coordinate the installation, testing, and maintenance of instrumentation systems and equipment.
  • Lead and motivate a team of instrumentation technicians, ensuring clear communication and adherence to safety standards.
  • Plan and schedule instrumentation work according to project requirements and timelines.
  • Conduct regular inspections of ongoing work to ensure quality and compliance with specifications.
  • Provide technical support and training to team members on best practices and safety procedures.
  • Maintain accurate records of work performed and report progress to project management.

Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent; technical degree or certification in instrumentation or a related field is preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in instrumentation with at least 3 years in a supervisory role.
  • Strong knowledge of instrumentation systems, including calibration, installation, and troubleshooting.
  • Proven leadership skills and the ability to manage a team effectively.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Familiarity with health and safety regulations relevant to instrumentation operations.
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings and schematics related to instrumentation.
  • Filed experience related water metering, water pipe fitting , electromagnet water flow meters  , flow measurement maintenance , calibration of water meters etc.

jobs.title: Instrument Foreman
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a highly skilled Instrument Foreman to join our dynamic team. As a prominent Talent Acquisition Consultancy, we focus on connecting top-tier professionals with leading organizations in the Oil & Energy sector. In this pivotal role, you will oversee and coordinate instrumentation activities on-site, ensuring that all work is executed according to project specifications and industry standards.

The Instrument Foreman will be responsible for managing a team of instrumentation technicians, providing guidance and support to ensure timely and efficient completion of assigned tasks. You will work closely with project managers and engineers to align activities with project timelines and safety protocols.

Responsibilities

  • Supervise and coordinate the installation, testing, and maintenance of instrumentation systems and equipment.
  • Lead and motivate a team of instrumentation technicians, ensuring clear communication and adherence to safety standards.
  • Plan and schedule instrumentation work according to project requirements and timelines.
  • Conduct regular inspections of ongoing work to ensure quality and compliance with specifications.
  • Provide technical support and training to team members on best practices and safety procedures.
  • Maintain accurate records of work performed and report progress to project management.

Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent; technical degree or certification in instrumentation or a related field is preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in instrumentation with at least 3 years in a supervisory role.
  • Strong knowledge of instrumentation systems, including calibration, installation, and troubleshooting.
  • Proven leadership skills and the ability to manage a team effectively.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Familiarity with health and safety regulations relevant to instrumentation operations.
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings and schematics related to instrumentation.
  • Filed experience related water metering, water pipe fitting , electromagnet water flow meters  , flow measurement maintenance , calibration of water meters etc.

jobs.title: Instrument Technician
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is hiring for Instrument Technicians for one of their prestigious petrochemical client in Jubail, Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, calibrating, and repairing plant instrumentation—including electronic, pneumatic, and safety-critical systems—to ensure safe and reliable refinery operations.

Responsibilities

  • Safety & Maintenance: Follow plant safety standards, recognize hazards, carry out preventive maintenance (PM) procedures, and maintain clean work areas and workshop tools.
  • Troubleshooting & Overhauling: Diagnose and repair pneumatic/electronic instrument issues. Overhaul control valves, controllers, Rosemount smart transmitters, boilers, and furnaces.
  • Calibration & Loop Tuning: Calibrate plant equipment to ISO standards, tune field controllers/PID settings, and service analytical instruments (O2, CO, CO2, pH, and conductivity meters).
  • Critical Systems Maintenance: Test safety-critical devices, Emergency Shutdown (ESD) interlocks, turbine/compressor instrumentation, Bently Nevada monitoring systems, and fire/flame detection systems.
  • Technical Drawings: Read and interpret P&IDs (Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams) and instrument loop drawings.

Requirements

  • Education: 2-year Technical Diploma or Industrial Trade Training Certificate from a recognized institution.
  • Experience: 6 to 8 years of hands-on work experience as an Instrument Technician in a refinery or petrochemical plant.
  • Documentation: Experience certificate from a process or construction company.
  • Language: Good command of English (ability to read, write, and speak clearly).

jobs.title: Insulation Technician (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Insulation Technician to install, maintain, repair, and remove thermal, acoustic, and fire-resistant insulation systems on industrial equipment, piping, tanks, vessels, and related structures. The technician will ensure insulation work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project specifications, drawings, and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install and remove insulation materials on pipes, valves, tanks, vessels, ducts, and equipment.
  • Apply thermal, acoustic, and fire-resistant insulation systems as specified.
  • Read and interpret insulation drawings, specifications, and work instructions.
  • Measure, cut, shape, and fit insulation materials accurately.
  • Install cladding, jacketing, vapor barriers, and protective coverings.
  • Inspect existing insulation and identify damaged or deteriorated areas.
  • Repair and replace insulation as required.
  • Ensure proper sealing and weatherproofing of insulation systems.
  • Use hand tools, power tools, ladders, scaffolding, and other equipment safely.
  • Coordinate with supervisors, welders, pipefitters, mechanical technicians, and other site personnel.
  • Maintain proper housekeeping and keep the work area clean and organized.
  • Follow all company and project HSE (Health, Safety & Environment) requirements.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma, technical certificate, or equivalent qualification.
  • Relevant training or certification in insulation is preferred - Thermal Insulation Training, HSE Training
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as an insulation technician, preferably in industrial, oil & gas, petrochemical, refinery, or construction projects.
  • Experience working with insulation materials such as mineral wool, rock wool, fiberglass, calcium silicate, PIR/PUR, or similar materials.
  • Familiarity with aluminum, stainless-steel, or galvanized cladding/jacketing is preferred.
  • Ability to read basic technical drawings and measurements.
  • Knowledge of workplace safety requirements and PPE.

Required Skills

  • Good knowledge of insulation installation techniques.
  • Ability to accurately measure and cut insulation materials.
  • Basic understanding of piping and mechanical equipment.
  • Strong commitment to safety and quality.
  • Physically fit and capable of performing manual work for extended periods.

Safety Responsibilities

  • Wear required PPE at all times.
  • Follow permit-to-work, LOTO, working-at-height, and other applicable safety procedures.
  • Properly handle insulation materials, cutting tools, and equipment.

Preferred Experience

Experience in the following environments is an advantage:

  • Oil & Gas
  • Refineries
