jobs.title: IT Administrative Analyst ( Educational Institute Experience)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented IT Administrative Analyst to support the day-to-day administration, reliability, and continuity of digital systems, user devices, and classroom technology. Reporting to the Operations Manager, the role is responsible for managing IT systems, supporting end users, maintaining digital platforms, coordinating hardware and audio-visual technologies, and ensuring operational readiness across the school environment. The successful candidate will also provide operational support to cross-functional teams, contributing to the efficient delivery of academic and administrative activities. The ideal candidate has experience in IT systems support, device management, and digital operations, preferably within an educational environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and support core digital platforms, including Student Information Systems (SIS), Learning Management Systems (LMS), Google Workspace, and communication platforms.
  • Manage user accounts, permissions, and system access while ensuring compliance with security and data protection policies.
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot technical issues, and escalate incidents when required.
  • Configure, deploy, maintain, and support school-owned devices, including laptops, iPads, and shared peripherals.
  • Coordinate device inventory, repairs, warranties, replacements, and lifecycle management.
  • Provide operational support for classroom and shared-space audio-visual systems, including projectors, displays, sound systems, and conferencing equipment.
  • Support technology setup and troubleshooting for lessons, meetings, school events, and assemblies.
  • Assist with academic year preparation, including user onboarding, class creation, device allocation, and system configuration.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of systems, devices, licences, warranties, and vendor support activities.
  • Coordinate with external vendors for hardware, software, and AV support services.
  • Support continuity planning, system security, and incident response in accordance with organisational policies.
  • Collaborate with Academic, Admissions, HR, Finance, and Operations teams to support digital and operational requirements.
  • Assist with reporting, operational coordination, and technology-related projects across the organisation.
  • Ensure compliance with safeguarding, data protection, confidentiality, and acceptable use policies.

Requirements

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 Years of Experience in IT support, systems administration, or digital operations.
  • Hands-on experience supporting laptops, iPads, and end-user devices.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, Student Information Systems (SIS), Learning Management Systems (LMS), or similar platforms.
  • Experience supporting audio-visual equipment and classroom technology is an advantage.
  • Strong organisational, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to support non-technical users.
  • Previous experience in an educational or school environment is preferred.

jobs.title: IT Application & Systems Analyst
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is actively seeking an IT Application & Systems Analyst to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for analyzing, designing, and implementing IT applications and systems that support organizational objectives. You'll work closely with various stakeholders to gather requirements, troubleshoot issues, and ensure that the IT applications meet the evolving needs of the business.

Your expertise will contribute to the optimization and continuous improvement of our IT systems, enhancing performance and user experience. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a fast-paced environment where your skills and insights will drive impactful solutions.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and implement a comprehensive data management strategy to support the Operational Excellence & Compliance Division's safety goals and objectives.

• Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports to provide insights and trends on safety performance, identifying areas for improvement and opportunities for optimization.

• Develop and implement data management solutions, including data collection, storage, and analysis, to support safety-related data and metrics.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to identify and prioritize data requirements, and develop solutions to meet those needs.

• Develop and maintain data quality control processes to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency of safety data.

• Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior team members, and mentor them in the development of their skills and expertise.

• Collaborate with the IT department to implement new software and systems, including:

o Providing system requirements and specifications to ensure alignment with business needs.

o Participating in the design and development of new systems and software.

o Conducting testing and quality assurance to ensure system functionality and performance.

o Providing training and support to end-users to ensure successful adoption and utilization of new systems and software.

• Ensure compliance with relevant company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements related to data management and safety reporting.


QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE


• Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g. Computer Science, Information Technology).

• Minimum 10 years of experience in business analysis, preferably in the Oil & Gas industry, with a strong background in Safety.

• Strong knowledge of business analysis principles, data analysis, and reporting techniques.

• Experience with data management, including data collection, storage, and analysis.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Ability to work in a team environment and collaborate with stakeholders at all levels.

• Proficiency in programming languages, such as SQL, Python, and R.

• Experience with data visualization tools, such as Tableau or Power BI.

• Knowledge of machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques, including predictive analytics and data mining.

• Certification in business analysis, such as Certified Business Analyst Professional (CBAP) or Certified Management Consultant (CMC), is preferred.

• Experience with cloud-based business analysis tools and platforms, is preferred but not required


Work Location: Office

Weekly Hours: 8 hours per day (Office)

jobs.title: IT Asset Management Analyst (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is looking for a dedicated and detail-oriented IT Asset Management Analyst to join our operations in Saudi Arabia. The IT Asset Management Analyst is responsible for maintaining the asset life cycle information including but not limited to the custodian, warranty and status for technology-based hardware and software assets. The IT Asset Management Analyst is also responsible for receiving, tagging, disposing the assets, updating the Assets database system, as well as developing and implementing procedures for tracking IT assets to oversee quality control throughout their lifecycles.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the entire lifecycle of IT assets, including acquisition, inventory management, utilization tracking, and disposal.
  • Manage the complete IT asset lifecycle including receiving, tagging, tracking, loaning, repairing, and disposal of assets.
  • Maintain accurate asset records (custodian, warranty, status, refresh, and end-of-life) in the asset management system.
  • Conduct physical and system inventory audits, analyze variances, and ensure data accuracy.
  • Control asset acquisition, storage, movement, and disposal in coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Prepare asset reports and dashboards and support process improvements and governance.
  • Stay current with industry trends and best practices in IT asset management.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Information Technology or a related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in IT asset management systems and lifecycle management.
  • 4+ years of experience in data analytics and reporting
  • Strong knowledge of SAP, IT asset management processes, and supporting technologies.
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and data analysis/reporting.
  • Good English communication skills with the ability to work independently and collaborate across teams.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Relevant certifications such as Certified IT Asset Manager (CITAM) or ITIL certification are a plus.

Benefits

Salary is not a constraint ,company is looking for right candidate .

jobs.title: IT Support & Network Administrator (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a skilled and motivated IT Support & Network Administrator to support and maintain the organization’s IT infrastructure, network devices, servers, and end-user systems. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing technical support, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, maintaining network connectivity, and assisting with the administration of Windows-based systems.

The role requires strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, good communication skills, and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide day-to-day technical support to users for hardware, software, network, and connectivity-related issues.
  • Assist with the administration and maintenance of IT infrastructure and network systems.
  • Configure, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain network devices, including:
    • Switches
    • Routers
    • Firewalls
    • Wireless Access Points (WAPs)
  • Assist with network connectivity, IP addressing, LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, and basic network troubleshooting.
  • Support the administration and maintenance of Windows Server and Windows Desktop operating systems.
  • Install, configure, update, and troubleshoot computer hardware, software, and peripherals.
  • Manage user accounts, system access, and basic security

Education Required

  • Diploma in Information Technology or a related field from a recognized university or institution.
  • Relevant fields include:
    • Information Technology
    • Computer Science
    • Computer Engineering
    • Computer Networks / Networking
    • Networking & Cybersecurity
    • Information Systems
    • Or another closely related discipline.

Experience Required

  • 2 - 5 years of relevant experience in IT support, network administration, system administration, or IT infrastructure support.
  • Practical experience with switches, routers, firewalls, and wireless access points.
  • Experience supporting Windows desktop and Windows Server environments.
  • Experience in troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and connectivity issues.
  • Experience providing technical support to end users and resolving IT-related incidents.
  • Fresh graduates with relevant technical knowledge may be considered for a Junior IT Support & Network Technician role.

jobs.title: IT Support Assistant - Graphic Design Background
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a creative and technically skilled IT Support Assistant – Graphic Design Background to provide IT support services while delivering high-quality graphic design solutions for digital and print media. Reporting to the IT Supervisor/Operations Manager, the role supports the maintenance of IT systems, software, and documentation while creating visually engaging content that enhances internal and external communications. The successful candidate will assist with troubleshooting IT issues, maintaining data backups, preparing system documentation, and designing creative assets including presentations, brochures, social media graphics, advertisements, and other digital content. The ideal candidate has 3–5 years of relevant experience in IT support with a strong background in graphic design.

jobs.title: Lab Equipment Maintenance Specialist - Hydraulics Unit (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The LEM Specialist provides professional service and support for laboratory research equipment by performing field service reactive maintenance repairs, preventive maintenance, and calibrations. He/she will be a mentor to junior maintenance personnel, and will prepare, plan and complete user maintenance and equipment operation training sessions. The LEM Specialist will deliver the highest level of service to maximize equipment uptime while minimizing maintenance costs. He/she will focus in the maintenance of cooling systems, growth chambers, autoclaves, and glass washers. He/she will work within guidelines established by the LEM head and Laboratory Equipment Maintenance Leads, and will follow established standard operating procedures.

  • Perform reactive and preventive maintenance on laboratory research equipment, including cooling systems, growth chambers, autoclaves, and glass washers.
  • Troubleshoot and repair equipment issues promptly to maximize uptime and reduce maintenance costs.
  • Coordinate maintenance schedules with end-users to ensure minimal disruption to research activities.
  • Mentor junior technicians and support team development through knowledge sharing and training.
  • Conduct user training sessions on equipment operation and preventive maintenance best practices.
  • Communicate effectively with vendors and manufacturers to obtain technical support, spare parts, and training.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of maintenance activities, communications, and equipment status.
  • Ensure compliance with HSE and institutional safety policies, maintaining safe work habits at all times.
  • Collaborate with maintenance leads and team members to improve workflows, increase automation, and enhance service levels.

Requirements

  • Associate's degree or Bachelor’s degree in Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning and Refrigeration (HVACR) or related field
  • Minimum two (5) years’ of work experience in maintaining refrigeration equipment, using maintenance reporting systems, and practicing customer focus techniques
  • Experience in maintaining equipment from a KAUST preferred manufacturer: Buchi, CLF Plant Climatics, Systec, GE, Labconco, Liebherr, Smeg, Panasonic, Peak, Percival, and Thermo-Fisher is desirable
  • Experience with other major manufacturers will be considered
  • Experience maintaining equipment from one or more of the following technologies: Ultra-low temperature freezers, glassware washers, heat exchangers, press machines, chillers, heaters and ovens.
  • Strong planning and organizational skills
  • Ability to communicate in a clear and concise manner

jobs.title: Landscape Architect (Horticulture) - Saudi Arabia
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is looking for a creative and innovative Landscape Architect to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and creating functional, aesthetically pleasing outdoor spaces that meet the needs of clients while adhering to environmental regulations. As a Landscape Architect, you will collaborate with other professionals to develop site plans and landscape designs for various projects.

If selected, the work location would be onsite at Saudi Arabia.

Responsibilities

  • The candidate will direct research and experiments to identify land use problems, suitable plant varieties, techniques for nursery operations; best methods for planting, spraying, cultivating, harvesting, storing, processing, or transporting agricultural/horticultural products, as well as pest/weed management.
  • You will provide guidance on planning & developing community projects, develops programs which will achieve quality landscaping designs, effective implementation and possible cost reduction.
  • You will provide guidance on programs for training staff personnel on latest agricultural/horticultural technology or methodologies including plant insect/pest control.
  • Study soil characteristics and develops improved measurement techniques, soil conservation methods, soil sampling devices, or other technologies are also necessary.
  • You will also have to design work programs for implementation by the Gardening, Landscaping and Nursery personnel. Reviews and advises staff in the performance of their duties, preparing periodic reports for supervisory review regarding work performance.
  • You will coordinate & implement Integrated Pest Management programs to control horticultural & agricultural pests in all landscaped areas including residences. Advises & instructs on plant pest control. Conducts surveys, collects samples & studies plant pests & materials to improve control efforts.

Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture, Landscaping, or equivalent from a recognized and approved program is required.
  • You will have 8 years of experience in gardening, landscaping, agriculture or equivalent, including at least 5 years in horticulture, gardening, plantations or equivalent.
  • Responsibilities include directing research and experiments to identify land use problems, suitable plant varieties, techniques for nursery operations, and determining best methods for planting, spraying, cultivating, harvesting, storing, processing, or transporting agricultural/horticultural products, as well as pest and weed management.
  • Guidance must be provided on planning and developing community projects, and on developing programs that achieve quality landscaping designs, effective implementation, and potential cost reduction.
  • Support is required in developing training programs for staff personnel on the latest agricultural/horticultural technologies or methodologies, including plant insect and pest control.
  • Tasks also include studying soil characteristics and developing improved measurement techniques, soil conservation methods, soil sampling devices, or other technologies.
  • Designing work programs for implementation by Gardening, Landscaping, and Nursery personnel is necessary. Staff performance must be reviewed and advised on, with periodic reports prepared for supervisory review regarding work performance.
  • Coordination and implementation of Integrated Pest Management programs to control horticultural and agricultural pests in all landscaped areas, including residences, is expected. Advising and instructing on plant pest control, conducting surveys, collecting samples, and studying plant pests and materials to improve control efforts are also part of the role.

  • 10+ years of experience in finance as a Financial Controller or CFO and/or experience in a large Consulting firm related to finance set-up/integration activities (e.g. ‘Big 4’ consulting firm)
  • Experience in a range of industries and companies.
  • Broad operational finance experience which includes the below activities:
    o   Finance business partnering;

  • Excellent communication skills, capable of liaising with senior management and external auditors.
  • Proven ability to lead teams and manage multiple projects effectively.
  • Proficiency in financial software and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

jobs.title: Lead Master Data Management (MDM) Architect (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent, a leading talent acquisition company, is seeking a highly skilled Lead Master Data Management (MDM) Architect to join our team in Saudi Arabia. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for defining and implementing robust MDM strategies and frameworks that ensure the quality, consistency, and accessibility of master data across various platforms and applications.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in master data management, data governance, and architecture. You will lead cross-functional teams in designing MDM solutions that align with business objectives while adhering to industry best practices. Additionally, you will work closely with stakeholders to understand their data needs and translate them into actionable strategies.

If selected, the work location would be onsite at Saudi Arabia.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain the Master Data Management strategy to meet business requirements and enhance data quality .
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, executives, and Technology departments to understand business requirements and translate them into Master Data Management architecture solutions.
  • Lead the design and architecture of MDM solutions considering scalability, performance and integration with existing systems
  • Define and enforce Master Data Management architectural standards, frameworks, and methodologies across the organization.
  • Define data governance policies and standards to maintain the accuracy and reliability of master data.
  • Provide expertise in data modelling, data profiling, data quality assessments and data models management
  • Collaborate with Data Quality and MDM teams to provide architectural oversight, inputs on standards & mentorship
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data consumption patterns and optimize MDM solutions accordingly.
  • Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies, tools, and platforms to enhance the company's MDM capabilities.
  • Conduct the design, implementation, and maintenance of enterprise-wide Technology systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security and seek approval from the Master Data Quality Manager on the same.
  • Conduct regular assessments and audits to ensure compliance with Technology architecture standards and identify areas for improvement.
  • Drive the integration of new technologies and solutions, ensuring seamless interoperability with existing systems.
  • Provide technical expertise and support while, conducting the planning and execution of Technology projects.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends and advancements in MDM, proposing innovative solutions to enhance business operations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE) preferred
  • 7+ years of experience in data management focused on Master Data Management.
  • Strong background in data governance, data quality management, and data integration.
  • Proven experience with MDM tools such as Informatica MDM, Talend, or SAP MDG.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and implement MDM frameworks and processes that drive data quality improvements.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
  • In-depth understanding of data architecture, data modeling, and related technologies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on delivering actionable solutions.
  • Experience in guiding and mentoring teams in a collaborative environment.
  • Fluency in English; proficiency in Arabic is a plus.

jobs.title: Lead Process Design Engineer - (Oil & Gas Industry)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is looking for a highly experienced Lead Process Design Engineer to join our dynamic team within the oil and gas industry. In this pivotal role, you will lead project teams in the design and development of process engineering solutions, ensuring that all processes are optimized for efficiency, safety, and regulatory compliance. Your expertise will be critical in guiding junior engineers and collaborating with multi-disciplinary teams to achieve project objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership and Design Management
  • Assume overall responsibility for all process design activities related to the GOSP facility.
  • Lead and manage the process design team, assign tasks, review work, and ensure the quality and schedule of all process design deliverables.
  • Spearhead the development and standardization of the project's process design basis, design guidelines, and technical specifications.
  • Be responsible for finalizing key process schemes and selecting the technical execution strategy, such as separation sequence, compression philosophy, and treatment processes.
  • Organize and review core process simulation calculations, including:
  • Process calculations and preliminary sizing for major equipment (e.g., Oil-Gas Separators, Columns, Heat Exchangers, Pumps, Compressors).
  • Pipeline Hydraulic Calculations and Pressure Relief/Blowdown System Calculations.
  • Organize the preparation, review, and approval of all key process design documents, primarily including:
  • * Process Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs)
  • * Process Design Basis
  • * Equipment Data Sheets and Technical Specifications
  • * Hazardous Area Classification Drawings
  • * Pressure Relief and Blowdown System Design Report
  • * Process Description and Operating Manuals
  • Act as the primary process discipline interface for communication and coordination with the Client, the Project Management Team, other engineering disciplines (Piping, Mechanical, Instrumentation & Control, Electrical, Civil/Structural), and equipment vendors.
  • Ensure all process designs strictly adhere to Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards, Design Practices, and relevant regulations of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
  • Organize and lead process-related model reviews to ensure layout optimization for operability and maintainability.
  • Represent the process discipline in and lead project technical meetings.
  • Provide high-level process technical support to the site team during the Construction, Pre-commissioning, and Commissioning phases.
  • Review and respond to Technical Queries raised by the site team.
  • Participate in resolving site issues related to process design and review design changes.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Chemical Engineering, Petrochemical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Possess or be eligible to obtain Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) certification.
  • Hold a valid Saudi Aramco certification/work permit.
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in process design within the oil and gas industry.
  • At least 2-3 complete projects experience serving as a Process Lead/Principal Process Engineer, leading the EPC phase design for major upstream oil & gas facilities (especially GOSP, oil & gas processing stations, central processing facilities, etc.).
  • Extensive project experience working with Saudi Aramco or similar major international oil & gas companies, with a deep understanding and mastery of Aramco standards.
  • Proficient in using industry-standard process simulation software (e.g., HYSYS, PipeSIM) and capable of guiding the team in simulation work.
  • In-depth understanding of upstream treatment processes such as oil-gas separation, dehydration, desalination, and compression.
  • Familiar with international standards and Saudi Aramco standards.
  • Capable of independently reviewing critical process calculations and equipment data sheets.
  • Ability to motivate and lead technical teams, making sound decisions under pressure.
  • Capable of clear and effective technical communication with clients, management, and cross-cultural teams.
  • Ability to quickly analyze complex technical problems and propose practical solutions.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken); knowledge of basic Arabic is a plus.
  • Strong project management and time management skills to ensure design tasks are completed on schedule.

Strategy & Governance

jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking an elite Legal General Counsel for an immediate 3-month short-term engagement. This is not a standard corporate legal advisory assignment; it is an invitation to step in as the Lead Architect of the legal framework for one of Saudi Arabia's most ambitious supply chain engines. The interim Legal General Counsel will lead and drive the Legal function, protecting commercial and legal interests, ensuring operational continuity, and steering regulatory and strategic governance in alignment with Kingdom laws and regulations.

If selected, the work location would be onsite at Saudi Arabia.

Scope of Work

As the interim Legal General Counsel during this critical 3-month mandate, your key responsibilities will include:

Strategic Leadership & Governance

  • Lead, direct, and mentor the legal team, fostering a high-performance, results-driven culture during this transition phase.
  • Partner with executive leadership and the Board of Directors to provide high-level strategic legal direction aligned with corporate goals.
  • Translate corporate strategy into actionable legal department objectives and operational deliverables.
  • Ensure robust corporate governance, including the drafting and maintenance of entity documents, resolutions, consents, and corporate filings.

Legal Advisory & Risk Management

  • Provide top-tier legal support to the CEO, Board, and senior executive team on legal rights, statutory compliance, and commercial risk exposure.
  • Conduct comprehensive legal and commercial risk analyses to enable business growth while safeguarding income and assets.

jobs.title: Liaison man - Onshore Oil Drilling Experienced
jobs.description:
Eram Talent, a leading talent acquisition company in the Oil & Energy sector, is seeking an experienced Liaison Man for Onshore Oil Drilling operations. The successful candidate will serve as the vital link between the rig personnel and management, ensuring effective communication, smooth operations, and adherence to safety protocols.

In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating onshore drilling activities, managing logistics, and facilitating the flow of information between various teams. Your insights and expertise will contribute significantly to operational efficiency and safety compliance in onshore drilling projects.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the main liaison between drilling operations and onshore management, ensuring effective communication and support.
  • Coordinate logistics for personnel and equipment transport, ensuring timely arrival to and from the rig.
  • Monitor drilling operations closely, providing reports and updates to management regarding performance and incidents.
  • Assist in the planning and scheduling of drilling activities and maintenance operations.
  • Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and site-specific policies.
  • Maintain thorough records of operations, inventory, and personnel activities.

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in a liaison or coordination role within onshore oil drilling operations.
  • Strong understanding of drilling processes, logistics, and safety procedures.

  • Ability to work effectively in high-pressure environments and manage multiple priorities.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

jobs.title: Liaisonman - Offshore (Drilling OR Workover)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is looking for a dedicated Liaisonman for Offshore operations to be a part of our esteemed client's team. The Liaisonman acts as the primary interface between the Operator’s drilling/workover team, the drilling contractor, and third-party service providers to ensure smooth coordination and execution of offshore drilling and workover operations. The role ensures all operations are conducted safely, efficiently, and in compliance with company and regulatory standards.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the focal point between the Operator and Drilling Contractor during offshore operations.
  • Coordinate day-to-day drilling and workover activities to ensure alignment with operational programs and schedules.
  • Supervise and monitor drilling, completion, and workover operations to ensure adherence to the approved work program.
  • Ensure that safety, environmental, and operational procedures are strictly followed at all times.
  • Communicate operational updates, challenges, and performance reports to the onshore drilling management team.
  • Verify and endorse contractor and third-party service company daily reports, job tickets, and timesheets.
  • Participate in daily operations meetings and contribute to planning and problem-solving discussions.
  • Ensure the availability and readiness of equipment, materials, and personnel for planned operations.
  • Support incident investigations and recommend corrective actions.
  • Liaise with logistics, marine, and procurement teams for the timely mobilization/demobilization of personnel and equipment.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in offshore operations or liaison roles.
  • Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Petroleum Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
  • Minimum 8 years of oilfield experience, including:
  • Drilling projects (jack-up / semi-sub / land rigs) OR Workover operations (completion, intervention, and well servicing).
  • Previous offshore experience with major operators or drilling contractors is mandatory.
  • Strong knowledge of well control, drilling fluids, downhole tools, completions, and well servicing operations.
  • Valid offshore survival and medical certificates (e.g., BOSIET, HUET, OGUK).
  • IWCF / IADC Well Control Certification (Supervisor level preferred).
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and coordination skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure in a multicultural offshore environment.

Salary is not a constraint ,company is looking for right candidate .

jobs.title: Liaisonman - Offshore Operations (Rig & Non-Rig)

jobs.title: Machinist - Manual (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a skilled Manual Machinist to join our team in Saudi Arabia. As a leading talent acquisition consultancy, we are dedicated to connecting skilled professionals with top companies in various industries. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment where precision and craftsmanship are paramount.

The Manual Machinist is responsible for machining, repairing, and fabricating precision mechanical components used in petrochemical and oil & gas facilities. This role involves operating manual and semi-automated machine tools to meet strict dimensional, quality, and safety standards. The machinist works closely with maintenance and engineering teams to support plant reliability and continuous operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Operate manual machining equipment including lathes, milling machines, grinders, and drill presses
  • Set up machines, select appropriate tools, and determine machining methods
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and technical specifications
  • Machine, modify, and repair components such as shafts, flanges, valves, pumps, and fittings
  • Measure and inspect parts using precision measuring instruments to ensure accuracy and tolerance compliance
  • Perform routine maintenance and minor repairs on machining equipment
  • Follow HSE, safety, and quality procedures applicable to petrochemical and oil & gas environments
  • Maintain clean, organized, and safe work areas
  • Coordinate with supervisors and maintenance teams to meet operational schedules

Requirements

  • Diploma in Industrial Technology (Machining) or equivalent
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Machinist
  • Experience operating manual, semi-automated, and CNC machines
  • Strong knowledge of machine tools, metal properties, and machining processes
  • Ability to read and understand blueprints, schematics, and manuals
  • Good mathematical and analytical skills
  • Good command of English (reading, writing, and speaking)
  • Physically fit with the stamina required for machining task

jobs.title: Maintenance Engineer Systems
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a qualified Maintenance Engineer – Systems to support a leading organization in Saudi Arabia. The role will be responsible for maintaining and optimizing Niagara4-based Building Automation Systems and Integrated Fire Alarm Automation Systems, ensuring system reliability, performance, security, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and maintain Niagara4-based Integrated Automation Systems (IKAS) and Integrated Fire Alarm Automation Systems (IFAS).
  • Prepare daily system functionality and health reports.
  • Investigate and resolve system alarms, faults, and failures, including Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  • Create and manage Niagara user accounts according to approved access levels.
  • Monitor system user activities and report security or access violations.
  • Manage software backups and perform restoration when required.
  • Coordinate with IT teams to resolve network and virtual machine issues.
  • Troubleshoot communication issues between Niagara and connected equipment/devices.
  • Configure Niagara machine IP addressing and server communication ports.
  • Perform system optimization, fine-tuning, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop and maintain SQL database scripts and configurations for reporting requirements.
  • Maintain related IT equipment, including servers, workstations, and JACE controllers.
  • Address security alerts raised by Operations and IT departments.
  • Support system expansion projects and ensure vendor/contractor compliance.
  • Maintain Niagara system configurations and graphics accuracy.
  • Conduct audits and inspections of automation systems.
  • Develop software solutions to improve system performance and daily operations.
  • Prepare monthly system status reports and performance/statistics dashboards.
  • Coordinate with software developers and relevant departments on automation-system requirements.
  • Manage TRIDIUM SMA agreements, including software patches, bug fixes, and version upgrades.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering.

Minimum 7 years of overall relevant experience.

Minimum 3 years of experience working with Niagara platform-based Building Automation Systems.

Knowledge of Niagara4 Java and HTML5 implementation.

Knowledge of Building Automation Systems (BAS).

Knowledge of security systems such as:

  • Fire Alarm Systems
  • Lighting Control Systems
  • Power Monitoring Systems

Strong problem-solving and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) skills.

Knowledge of Energy Conservation.

Fluent in written and spoken English.

jobs.title: Maintenance Engineer-Biomedical (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Maintenance Engineer – Biomedical is responsible for ensuring the safe, effective, and reliable maintenance of biomedical and clinical equipment, as well as supporting broader facilities maintenance operations across KAUST’s community infrastructure. This role focuses on auditing, monitoring, and verifying the work of service providers, ensuring full compliance with technical, contractual, and safety standards.

The engineer will manage both preventive and corrective maintenance activities and contribute to long-term asset lifecycle management. The position requires technical expertise in biomedical systems, asset performance evaluation, compliance with international and local standards, and effective use of CMMS tools (SAP/Maximo).

  • Ensure effective and safe execution of preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance for biomedical and facility assets.
  • Monitor maintenance activities to ensure alignment with KAUST standards, safety protocols, SOPs, and KPIs.
  • Conduct audits, inspections, and technical reviews to verify service quality and compliance with regulatory standards (JCI, SFDA, CBAHI/SBAHI, IEC, HTM).
  • Support troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and the implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
  • Oversee calibration, maintenance, and performance verification of biomedical equipment in the community medical facility.
  • Maintain accurate asset data in the CMMS (SAP/Maximo) and support lifecycle planning and preventive maintenance strategies.
  • Coordinate with stakeholders and provide regular reports and recommendations to improve service quality and asset reliability.
  • Demonstrate expertise in biomedical equipment calibration, testing, performance verification, and lifecycle management.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering or related engineering discipline.
  • Minimum 4–6 years of experience in the maintenance and operation of biomedical systems and general facilities equipment.
  • Advanced knowledge of preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance methodologies.
  • Strong understanding of biomedical equipment standards, device safety, and infection control protocols.
  • Proficiency in Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), preferably SAP or Maximo.
  • Strong technical expertise in biomedical equipment calibration, testing, and lifecycle management.
  • In-depth understanding of international codes and standards related to facilities and medical equipment.
  • Proven track record in contractor management, inspections, audits, and performance monitoring.
  • Hands-on experience in complying with international and local regulations and standards, including: JCI, CBAHI/SBAHI, SFDA, IEC 60601, HTM
  • Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP) - Preferred
  • Biomedical Equipment Technician (BMET) certification - Preferred

jobs.title: Maintenance Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Maintenance Mechanical Engineer to support maintenance activities within an industrial/petrochemical environment.

Position Overview

The Maintenance Mechanical Engineer will provide technical expertise in troubleshooting equipment failures, repairs, maintenance activities, and equipment reliability, while supporting maintenance teams, work packages, and plant operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a technical expert for equipment failures, repairs, and troubleshooting.
  • Provide engineering support for plant issues affecting production.
  • Evaluate defective equipment and recommend appropriate repair and corrective actions.
  • Review repair requirements, including clearances, tolerances, materials of construction, welding procedures, and related technical requirements.
  • Develop and maintain appropriate repair techniques and equipment-specific maintenance procedures.
  • Support the review and identification of spare parts required for existing equipment.
  • Contribute to maintenance strategies and maintenance operating discipline.
  • Provide engineering input to projects, particularly regarding equipment maintainability.
  • Support the development of maintenance budgets and maintenance plans.
  • Provide engineering input to work packages and work orders, particularly for critical equipment.
  • Support maintenance teams in troubleshooting and resolving equipment-related issues.
  • Ensure maintenance activities comply with applicable EH&S, quality, and safety requirements.
  • Work closely with maintenance, operations, engineering, and other relevant teams to maintain reliable plant operation.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Instrument, or Electrical Engineering.

Strong experience in mechanical maintenance and troubleshooting within an industrial environment.

Proven experience dealing with equipment failures, repairs, and corrective actions.

Experience with maintenance planning, strategies, work orders, and work packages.

Knowledge of equipment repair requirements, tolerances, clearances, materials, and maintenance procedures.

Experience supporting critical equipment maintenance and reliability.

Ability to provide technical guidance and engineering support to maintenance teams.

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Experience in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Refinery, or other process industries is preferred.

The ideal candidate should be a hands-on mechanical maintenance professional with strong troubleshooting capability and experience supporting plant maintenance, rather than someone focused purely on design or project engineering.

jobs.title: Maintenance Planner (Saudi Arabia)

jobs.title: Management Executive Secretary
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a highly organized and proactive Management Executive Secretary to provide comprehensive administrative support to senior management. The successful candidate will play a critical role in optimizing the efficiency and effectiveness of the management team by handling scheduling, communication, and administrative tasks with professionalism and discretion.

As a Management Executive Secretary, you will coordinate activities, manage correspondence, and ensure smooth office operations. Your ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain confidentiality will be key to supporting the organization’s goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the Chief Officer’s calendar, scheduling appointments, meetings, and events.
  • Prioritize and coordinate conflicting schedules and commitments.
  • Plan and coordinate all aspects of the Chief Officer’s business travel, including transportation, accommodation, and itineraries.
  • Ensure travel arrangements are efficient and cost-effective.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for the Chief Officer, managing phone calls, emails, and correspondence.
  • Draft and prepare written communications, such as emails, memos, and letters, on behalf of the Chief Officer.
  • Arrange and coordinate meetings, conferences, and events for the Chief Officer.
  • Prepare meeting materials, agendas, and take minutes as required.
  • Maintain organized and up-to-date filing systems for executive-level documents and records.
  • Conduct research and gather information to support the Chief Officer’s decision-making processes.
  • Track and process the Chief Officer’s expenses, ensuring compliance with company policies and regulations.
  • Prepare expense reports and maintain accurate records.
  • Provide administrative and operational support for special projects or initiatives assigned by the Chief Officer.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders as needed.
  • Handle confidential and sensitive information with utmost discretion and professionalism.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality regarding executive-level matters and communications
  • Recommend training and development intervention ns for team members to build their capabilities
  • Contribute to the identification of opportunities for the continuous improvement of systems, processes and practices to increase productivity and operational efficiency.
  • Implement all relevant Department’s policies, processes, procedures and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
  • Contribute to the preparation of timely and accurate reports to meet departmental requirements, policies and standards.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is required 
  • Master’s degree in Business Administration or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is preferred 
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in executive secretarial or administrative support roles.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to multitask effectively.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • High level of discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive information.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Detail-oriented with a proactive and adaptable mindset.

jobs.title: Management Executive Secretary - IT Background
jobs.description:

While the executive leads the technology division, your focus will be on seamless administrative execution, high-level stakeholder management, and calendar optimization. Key Competencies

  • C-Suite Polish & Diplomacy: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the confidence to interact with high-profile stakeholders and board members.
  • Exceptional Organization: A master of prioritization and multitasking who can manage tight deadlines and high-pressure situations with grace.

jobs.title: Master Data Management (MDM) Administration Specialist (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is actively searching for a Master Data Management (MDM) Administration Analyst to join our growing team. In this role, you will play a vital part in ensuring data accuracy and consistency across the organization by managing MDM processes and tools. Your responsibilities will include the administration of MDM systems, as well as supporting data governance initiatives to improve data quality and compliance.

The MDM Administration Analyst will work closely with various stakeholders to facilitate data entry, maintenance, and retrieval, while also providing analysis and reporting on master data issues.   • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is required
  • Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE) preferred
  • 5 years experience in the same Field
  • Experience in Information Technology / Data Solutions / Networking / Cybersecurity preferred

jobs.title: Master Data Management Business Analyst - Informatica
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a proficient Master Data Management (MDM) Business Analyst - Informatica to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will serve as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure that Informatica-based MDM solutions effectively meet organizational data management needs.

You will be responsible for gathering and documenting business requirements, analyzing existing data processes, and collaborating with technical teams on solution design and implementation. You will also help in identifying data quality issues, facilitate data governance activities, and support ongoing MDM initiatives to improve data accuracy, consistency, and compliance.

If selected, the work location would be onsite at Al Khobar.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their master data requirements, document data definitions, and analyze data structures for optimal data management.
  • Plan and execute data migration activities, including data mapping, data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes, during system upgrades or platform transitions.
  • Ensure compliance with data security and privacy regulations, implement access controls, and monitor data usage to protect sensitive master data.
  • Conduct thorough analysis of existing master data sets to identify discrepancies, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement, providing actionable insights to stakeholders.
  • Develop and generate reports, dashboards, and data visualizations to provide insights into master data quality, trends, and performance, supporting decision-making processes.
  • Facilitate change management activities related to master data management initiatives, including communication, training, and stakeholder
  • Develop and enforce master data governance policies, standards, and processes to ensure data quality, consistency, and compliance with regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborate with business users and IT teams to map data sources, define data hierarchies, and create data models that support effective master data management.
  • Define and implement data standardization rules and processes to harmonize master data elements across disparate systems and business units.
  • Coordinate the integration of master data management solutions with existing enterprise systems, ensuring seamless data flow and interoperability.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is required
  • 5+ Years of Work Experience as a Master Data Management (MDM) Business Analyst or similar role is required.
  • Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE) preferred
  • Certifications in MDM or Informatica is highly preferred.
  • Experience in Information Technology / Data Solutions / Networking / Cybersecurity preferred
  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst, specifically in Master Data Management (MDM).
  • Strong understanding of MDM principles, data governance, and data quality management.
  • Experience with MDM tools (e.g., Informatica, SAP MDG, Oracle) is a plus.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with stakeholders.

jobs.title: Material Expeditor - Rig Site (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Material Expeditor to support material procurement, expediting, tracking, and delivery activities for rig-site operations in the Oil & Gas industry. The candidate will coordinate closely with suppliers, vendors, procurement teams, logistics teams, and site personnel to ensure all required materials are available on time and according to project requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor and track material orders from purchase order placement through final delivery.
  • Coordinate with suppliers and vendors to confirm material availability and delivery schedules.
  • Follow up regularly on pending orders, delayed materials, shortages, and backorders.
  • Coordinate with procurement, logistics, warehouse, and rig-site teams regarding material requirements.
  • Maintain accurate material tracking sheets, delivery records, and related documentation.
  • Review purchase orders and delivery information to ensure materials are supplied as required.
  • Identify potential delivery delays and communicate issues to the concerned teams.
  • Support the resolution of material shortages and delivery-related issues.
  • Provide regular updates on material status, expected delivery dates, and outstanding items.
  • Ensure critical materials are prioritized and delivered to the rig site as per operational requirements.
  • Maintain proper records and documentation related to expediting activities.
  • Work effectively in a fast-paced rig-site environment and meet operational deadlines.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, Materials Management, or a related field.
  • Fresh graduates to 5 years of relevant experience in material expediting, procurement, logistics, supply chain, or materials management.
  • Oil & Gas, drilling, rig-site, or industrial project experience is preferred.
  • Basic understanding of procurement and material management processes.
  • Knowledge of purchase orders, material tracking, supplier coordination, and delivery schedules.
  • Good communication and coordination skills.
  • Strong follow-up and problem-solving abilities.
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
  • Ability to manage multiple material requirements and meet deadlines.

jobs.title: Material Movers - PWHT PLANTS
jobs.description:
ERAM is seeking experienced Material Movers / Loading & Unloading Personnel with exposure to Post-Weld Heat Treatment (PWHT) operations for an industrial project in Saudi Arabia.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Load, unload, and transport pipes, spools, pressure vessels, structural steel, and other fabrication materials.
  • Support PWHT operations by moving materials to and from heat treatment areas or furnaces.
  • Assist PWHT technicians during setup, execution, and completion of heat treatment activities.
  • Operate material handling equipment such as forklifts, pallet jacks, chain blocks, or cranes (where authorized).
  • Ensure safe handling, storage, and movement of materials in accordance with site safety procedures.
  • Maintain housekeeping and assist with general yard and fabrication activities.

Requirements

Experience in PWHT (Post-Weld Heat Treatment) projects, fabrication yards, refineries, petrochemical plants, or piping construction.

Hands-on experience in loading, unloading, and material handling within industrial environments.

Knowledge of safe lifting practices and material handling procedures.

Experience working on Saudi Aramco, SABIC, EPC, or similar industrial projects is an advantage.

Ability to work in physically demanding environments while following HSE standards.

Contract Duration: 1 Year

jobs.title: Material Specialist - (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
We are currently seeking a knowledgeable and proactive Material Specialist to join our team in Saudi Arabia. This critical role involves managing the procurement and supply chain of materials necessary for various projects within the oil and energy sectors. You will work closely with project managers and engineering teams to ensure that all materials meet quality standards, are delivered on time, and align with project specifications.

By facilitating effective communication with suppliers and stakeholders, you will play an integral role in enhancing the efficiency of our operations.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute material procurement plans to ensure timely acquisition of resources necessary for project execution.
  • Evaluate and select vendors based on quality, cost, and delivery capabilities.
  • Maintain inventory records and monitor stock levels to forecast and manage material needs effectively.
  • Conduct market assessments to stay attuned to industry trends and supply chain dynamics.
  • Prepare and manage procurement documentation, such as contracts, purchase orders, and supplier agreements.
  • Coordinate the logistics of material transportation, ensuring compliance with project requirements.
  • Facilitate continuous improvement initiatives in material management processes and practices.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a closely related field.
  • 3+ Years of relevant Work experience.
  • Experience in materials procurement and supply chain logistics, preferably within the oil and energy industry.
  • Strong negotiation and relationship management skills to liaise effectively with suppliers.
  • Excellent analytical skills to evaluate supplier performance and material quality.
  • Effective communication skills to interact with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Familiarity with supply chain software and tools is a plus.

Benefits

Salary is not a constraint ,company is looking for right candidate .

jobs.title: Maximo EAM Functional Specialist
jobs.description:
The IBM Maximo EAM Functional Specialist is responsible for administering, configuring, supporting, and enhancing the IBM Maximo Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) system. The role provides technical support, develops workflows and reports, manages system integrations, troubleshoots issues, and collaborates with business users and IT teams to ensure reliable and efficient asset management operations.

Key Responsibilities.

  • Administer, configure, and support IBM Maximo 7.x applications.
  • Troubleshoot Maximo, IBM HTTP Server, and integration-related issues.
  • Develop and maintain Maximo workflows, roles, actions, and action groups.
  • Create and maintain BIRT/Actuate reports and Cognos integration.
  • Perform data migration using MDL, GDL, SQL, and PL/SQL.
  • Configure and support Maximo Integration Framework (MIF) interfaces.
  • Prepare technical documentation and system configuration guides.
  • Collaborate with users, vendors, and IT teams to deliver system enhancements and resolve issues.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 6 years of IT experience, including at least 5 years with IBM Maximo.
  • Strong experience in Maximo 7.x installation, configuration, and administration.
  • Knowledge of Maximo workflows, MIF, BIRT, Cognos, and WebSphere.
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, IBM DB2, SQL, and PL/SQL.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • IBM Maximo 7.x certification is preferred, with the ability to work in a multicultural environment.

jobs.title: MDM Product specialist
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Mechanical / Static Equipment Engineer Specialist (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Mechanical / Static Equipment Engineer Specialist will lead the mechanical design review, construction support, commissioning, testing, and engineering activities for new shale gas facilities. The role requires extensive experience with static and rotating equipment in oil and gas production facilities, along with a strong understanding of plant operations, process technologies, equipment reliability, and maintenance.

The successful candidate will provide technical leadership throughout the project lifecycle, from engineering design and installation to commissioning, startup, operations support, and optimization. The role also requires collaboration with multidisciplinary teams and support for Saudi Aramco's capital investment and business strategy initiatives.

  • Lead mechanical design reviews for new installation and upgrade projects.
  • Develop and review engineering design packages, PFDs, P&IDs, and technical drawings.
  • Provide day-to-day technical support to Operations and Maintenance teams.
  • Troubleshoot static and rotating equipment issues and recommend solutions.
  • Support construction, installation, pre-commissioning, commissioning, and startup activities.
  • Participate in Turnaround & Inspection (T&I) and performance testing activities.
  • Conduct feasibility studies and recommend technical and economic optimization solutions.
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams, prepare technical reports, and support management decisions.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Chemical, or Petroleum Engineering (Master’s preferred).
  • Minimum 15 years of experience in oil & gas, refinery, petrochemical, or gas processing facilities.
  • Strong experience in static equipment (vessels, exchangers, columns, tanks, reactors).
  • Good knowledge of rotating equipment (pumps, compressors, turbines).
  • Experience in EPC phases: FEED, detailed engineering, construction, and commissioning.
  • Strong knowledge of ASME, API, and TEMA codes and standards.
  • Working knowledge of engineering software (PVElite, CAESAR II, HTRI).
  • Strong communication, leadership, and multidisciplinary coordination skills.

jobs.title: Mechanical Foreman (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Qualifications & Experience:

  • Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent technical qualification.
  • 5–8 years of hands-on experience in maintenance of gas plants and pipeline systems.
  • Strong expertise in maintenance of mechanical equipment, including:
    • Static equipment (pressure vessels, heat exchangers, piping, valves)
    • Rotary equipment (pumps, compressors, turbines, blowers)
  • Experience using SAP PM for maintenance work orders, notifications, and history tracking is preferred.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Supervise and execute preventive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance activities for mechanical equipment in gas plants and pipelines.
  • Lead and manage mechanical technicians and fitters, ensuring work is performed safely and efficiently.
  • Ensure strict compliance with HSE policies, permit-to-work systems, and safety procedures.
  • Coordinate with operations to plan maintenance activities, shutdowns, and equipment isolation.
  • Assign daily tasks, monitor progress, and ensure timely completion of maintenance jobs.
  • Perform troubleshooting and support root cause analysis (RCA) for equipment failures.
  • Verify job quality, conduct inspections, and ensure equipment readiness before handover to operations.
  • Ensure proper use of tools, spare parts, and materials; support inventory control and spare management.
  • Prepare and close maintenance work orders, reports, and equipment history records.
  • Support plant start-up, shutdown, and emergency maintenance activities.
  • Provide on-the-job training and mentoring to technicians to enhance team capability.

Key Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of gas plant and pipeline mechanical systems
  • Leadership and team supervision skills
  • Maintenance planning and execution
  • Equipment troubleshooting and problem-solving
  • Good communication and coordination skills
  • Basic computer skills; SAP PM knowledge is an advantage

jobs.title: Mechanical Maintenance Engineer - HVAC (Petrochemical Experience)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is hiring for a Mechanical Manitenance Engineer - HVAC with core experience in Petrochemical Plants. The candidate would be responsible for maintaining the reliability, availability, and performance of HVAC and Mechanical Refrigeration Units (MRUs) serving critical petrochemical facilities. Leads preventive and predictive maintenance programs, troubleshooting activities, root cause investigations, reliability improvement initiatives, and spare parts optimization to ensure safe and uninterrupted operation.

Key Responsibilities

·         Extensive experience in maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing HVAC, chiller, and industrial refrigeration systems in petrochemical and process plant environments.

·         Hands-on expertise with Mechanical Refrigeration Units (MRUs), centrifugal, screw, and reciprocating chillers, AHUs, package units, ventilation systems, compressors, condensers, evaporators, pumps, and refrigeration control systems.

·         Diagnose and resolve mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, refrigeration, and control-related failures to ensure maximum equipment availability and reliability.

·         Analyze operating parameters including temperature, pressure, flow, superheat, subcooling, and compressor performance to identify system abnormalities and implement corrective actions.

·         Perform equipment performance evaluations, condition assessments, and reliability improvements to minimize downtime and optimize energy efficiency.

·         Proficient in interpreting HVAC/refrigeration schematics, P&IDs, electrical drawings, and OEM technical documentation.

·         Experienced in Building Management System (BMS) and HVAC control systems, including monitoring equipment performance, troubleshooting control logic, analyzing alarms, optimizing system operation, and integrating HVAC assets with centralized monitoring and control platforms.

  • Perform RCI investigations for critical and repetitive equipment failures.
  • Implement corrective and preventive actions to improve equipment reliability.

 

Preventive & Predictive Maintenance

  • Develop and optimize preventive maintenance programs based on equipment criticality and reliability data.
  • Ensure timely completion of maintenance plans and work orders.

Spare Parts Management

  • Review and optimize HVAC spare parts inventory.
  • Identify critical and insurance spare parts requirements.
  • Establish minimum and maximum inventory levels based on risk and lead times.
  • Coordinate with procurement and warehouse teams to ensure spare availability.
  • Support obsolescence management and spare part standardization initiatives.

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with company safety regulations and engineering standards.
  • Participate in PSSR, risk assessments, and incident investigations when required.
  • Support process safety requirements related to HVAC systems serving critical occupied buildings.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 10 years experience in petrochemical, refinery, oil & gas
  • Bachelor Degree in Engineering
  • HVAC, Chillers & Industrial Refrigeration Systems Maintenance & Troubleshooting
  • MRU Operation and Maintenance
  • Reliability Engineering
  • Preventive & Predictive Maintenance
  • RCI
  • Spare Parts Optimization
  • Building Management Systems (BMS)

jobs.title: Mechanical Maintenance Technician (Rotating) Saudi Arabia
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a skilled Mechanical Maintenance Technician (Rotating) to join our client's team in Saudi Arabia. This specialized role focuses on the maintenance, repair, and troubleshooting of rotating equipment such as turbines, compressors, pumps, and motors critical to industrial operations.

As a Mechanical Maintenance Technician (Rotating) at Eram Talent, you will play a vital role in ensuring the reliability and optimal performance of rotating machinery, contributing to uninterrupted production and safety compliance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance on rotating equipment including pumps, compressors, turbines, blowers, and gearboxes.
  • Troubleshoot and diagnose mechanical failures in rotating machinery and carry out detailed root cause analysis (RCA).
  • Execute precision alignment, dynamic balancing, and overhaul of rotating equipment in line with OEM standards.
  • Conduct condition monitoring activities such as vibration analysis, temperature monitoring, and performance checks.
  • Inspect and maintain seals, bearings, couplings, and lubrication systems.
  • Read and interpret mechanical drawings, P&IDs, and technical manuals for maintenance execution.
  • Support plant shutdowns, turnarounds, and major maintenance activities.
  • Work closely with operations and reliability teams to improve equipment uptime and performance.
  • Ensure all maintenance activities are recorded accurately in CMMS (e.g., SAP PM).
  • Follow all HSE policies, procedures, and permit-to-work systems strictly.
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to enhance reliability and reduce failures.
  • Mentor junior technicians and share technical expertise within the team.

Requirements

  • Diploma or Technical Certification in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in maintenance of rotating equipment in petrochemical, refinery, or oil & gas industries.
  • Strong hands-on experience with pumps, compressors, turbines, and other rotating machinery.
  • Expertise in alignment, balancing, vibration analysis, and troubleshooting techniques.
  • Good understanding of bearings, seals, lubrication systems, and mechanical components.
  • Experience using CMMS systems such as SAP PM or equivalent.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and P&IDs.
  • Solid knowledge of safety standards and maintenance best practices in industrial environments.
  • Experience in shutdowns/turnarounds is highly preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently under pressure.
  • Good communication and teamwork skills.

jobs.title: Media and Content Creation (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Public Relations Representative will support the Gas Business through media monitoring, media coordination, content development, and executive communications.

jobs.title: Microbiologist - Beverage Industry
jobs.description:
ERAM Talent is seeking for an experienced Microbiologist.

The successful candidate will be responsible for conducting microbiological testing on raw materials, water, production environments, and finished products to ensure compliance with food safety and quality standards. The role requires expertise in detecting microbial contamination, maintaining laboratory quality systems, and supporting production teams with microbiological investigations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform microbiological analysis on raw materials, processing water, environmental samples, and finished beverage or powder products.
  • Detect and identify spoilage microorganisms, including yeasts, molds, bacteria, and foodborne pathogens.
  • Conduct routine environmental monitoring through surface swabs, air sampling, and sanitation verification.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of cleaning and sanitation programs, including Clean-In-Place (CIP) systems.
  • Isolate, identify, and quantify microbial contaminants using standard microbiological techniques.
  • Investigate contamination sources and support root cause analysis for microbiological deviations.
  • Maintain accurate laboratory records, microbiological reports, and Certificates of Analysis (COAs).
  • Ensure compliance with Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), biosafety procedures, and laboratory quality standards.
  • Monitor and calibrate laboratory equipment, including incubators, autoclaves, and other microbiological instruments.
  • Perform quality control checks on culture media and laboratory reagents.
  • Collaborate with QA/QC and Production teams to investigate product spoilage, contamination incidents, and out-of-specification (OOS) results.
  • Report microbiological deviations promptly and support product hold and corrective action procedures.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Microbiology, Food Microbiology, Biotechnology, Food Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience as a Microbiologist within the Food & Beverage Manufacturing industry.
  • Hands-on experience in microbiological testing of beverages, food products, raw materials, and processing water.
  • Strong knowledge of microbiological analysis techniques, pathogen detection, and environmental monitoring.
  • Familiarity with Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), GMP, HACCP, ISO 22000, and food safety regulations.
  • Experience using laboratory equipment such as incubators, autoclaves, microscopes, and microbiological testing instruments.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to investigate contamination events and support corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in beverage, juice, dairy, or powdered food manufacturing.
  • Knowledge of Clean-In-Place (CIP) validation and environmental hygiene monitoring.
  • Familiarity with microbiological Certificates of Analysis (COAs) and Out-of-Specification (OOS) investigations.
  • Exposure to shelf-life studies and food safety management systems.

jobs.title: NDT Level III Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and certified NDT Level III Engineer / Inspector to lead our Non-Destructive Testing operations. In this role, you will serve as the ultimate technical authority for our NDT program. You will be responsible for developing testing procedures, ensuring compliance with international codes and standards, and mentoring and certifying Level I and Level II technicians.

🔧 Key Responsibilities

  • Procedure Development: Write, review, approve, and maintain NDT procedures, techniques, and work instructions in compliance with applicable codes and standards (e.g., ASME, AWS, ASTM, API, EN, NAS410).
  • Technical Leadership: Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) to resolve complex inspection anomalies and interpret advanced test data.
  • Personnel Qualification: Oversee the training, examination, and certification program for all Level I and Level II NDT personnel.
  • Method Selection: Evaluate engineering drawings and components to determine the most effective NDT methods and equipment for quality control.
  • Auditing & Compliance: Conduct internal and vendor audits to ensure NDT operations align with quality management systems (e.g., ISO 9001, AS9100, Nadcap).
  • Client & Regulatory Liaison: Act as the primary technical point of contact during third-party regulatory audits and client technical reviews.

Requirements

Certifications: Active ASNT, ISO 9712, or NAS410 Level III certification in at least two major methods (e.g., UT, RT, MT, PT, ET).

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical field is preferred (equivalent hands-on industrial experience will be considered).

Experience:

  • Minimum of 3–5 years of active experience as a certified Level II technician prior to achieving Level III status.
  • Proven experience writing technical procedures and training personnel.

Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of materials science, manufacturing/fabrication processes, and defect mechanisms.

Soft Skills: Strong analytical problem-solving skills, clear technical writing ability, and excellent instructional skills for teaching junior staff.

jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a skilled Network Engineer to join our growing team in Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing network solutions that support various business operations and optimize performance. Your expertise will help ensure effective network connectivity, security, and reliability across the organization's infrastructure.

You will work closely with IT teams to understand their networking needs and work to deliver effective solutions that enhance organizational performance and support strategic objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement network systems, including LAN, WAN, and wireless networks.
  • Configure and manage networking devices like routers, switches, and firewalls.
  • Monitor network performance and stability, identifying areas for improvement and troubleshooting issues.
  • Develop and implement network security protocols to safeguard data and technology infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with IT teams to assess network needs and install necessary upgrades.
  • Prepare and maintain documentation of network configurations, standards, and procedures.
  • Stay updated on emerging networking technologies and trends that can improve operations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years' experience in network engineering or related roles.
  • Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent are highly desirable.
  • At least 2 year of IT professional experience, with experience in networking.
  • Experience working with BGP, EIGRP, and ISIS (mandatory).
  • Experience with network-related equipment, including the use of sniffers, network monitoring tools, etc.
  • Operating and troubleshooting experience with the following Cisco products:
  • Switches: 6500, 4500, 3750, 3560, 2960
  • Technical knowledge of the following technologies and protocols:
    • VLAN
    • VTP
    • Trunk (802.1q)
    • Spanning Tree
