jobs.title: News Analyst - SMP
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a detail-oriented and insightful News Analyst focused on Saudi Arabia to join our team. In this role, you will monitor, analyze, and interpret news and media content related to Saudi Arabia, providing valuable insights and reports that help inform strategic decision-making for our clients and stakeholders.

The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of the political, economic, and social landscape of Saudi Arabia, with the ability to critically evaluate news sources and trends.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor all media channels across online, social and broadcast.
  • Flag and post critical media news on timely manner and according to predefined criteria.  
  • Respond to incoming media inquiries with accuracy and ensure proper tracking.
  • Utilize media monitoring software and tools to monitor news.
  • Coordinate daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly media impact reports summarizing media mentions and analysis and ensure proper distribution internally.
  • Work closely with Media relations and other teams to ensure timely responses.
  • Actively support in crisis situations following the corporate crisis communications manual.

Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s degree in the fields Mass Communications, Corporate Communications, Media, Media Relations, Crisis Communications, Media Monitoring, Public Relations, or Journalism.
  • Candidate should have at least 1 year of professional experience.
  • Candidate should have ability to monitor and analyze media news
  • Candidate should have good English and Arabic language capabilities
  • Candidate should be ready to work in shifts schedule
  • Experience in news analysis, media monitoring, or related roles focusing on Saudi Arabia or the Middle East.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work under tight deadlines and handle multiple priorities.
  • Proficiency in Arabic and English languages.
  • Familiarity with news databases and media monitoring tools is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.

jobs.title: O&M Engineer (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The O&M Engineer is responsible for supporting the safe, efficient, and reliable operation and maintenance of gas plant and pipeline systems. The role focuses on plant operations, mechanical equipment maintenance, and ensuring asset integrity in compliance with safety and operational standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform and support day-to-day operations and maintenance activities for gas plants and pipeline systems.
  • Monitor plant and pipeline performance to ensure safe and efficient operation.
  • Execute preventive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance activities.
  • Maintain mechanical equipment, including static and rotary equipment such as vessels, heat exchangers, pumps, compressors, and valves.
  • Diagnose equipment faults and implement corrective actions to minimize downtime.
  • Support shutdowns, turnarounds, and major maintenance activities.
  • Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements.
  • Prepare maintenance reports, work orders, and technical documentation.
  • Coordinate with operations teams, contractors, and vendors during maintenance activities.
  • Utilize SAP PM for maintenance planning, execution, and reporting (preferred).

Qualifications & Experience

Education:

  • University degree in Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Engineering.

Experience:

  • 5 - 8 years of experience in operations and maintenance of gas plants and pipelines.
  • Proven experience in plant and pipeline operations.
  • Strong hands-on experience in maintenance of mechanical equipment (static and rotary).

Technical Skills:

  • Knowledge of gas processing facilities and pipeline systems.
  • Expertise in mechanical maintenance practices and equipment reliability.
  • SAP PM experience preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Good understanding of safety procedures and permit-to-work systems.
  • Ability to work in a team-based operational environment.
  • Effective communication and reporting skills.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence.

jobs.title: Operations Engineer - Facility Management (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Operations Engineer will be responsible for monitoring and controlling the operation of all facility systems and coordinating maintenance-related activities at the Primary Nursery Facility in NEOM. The role will also oversee the delivery of support services, including Janitorial, Horticulture, Pest Control, Waste Management, and Office Services.

The Operations Engineer will ensure the safe, efficient, and reliable operation of electro-mechanical systems, monitor service provider performance, ensure compliance with operational KPIs, resolve customer complaints, and continuously identify opportunities to improve facility performance, energy efficiency, and end-user satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise and coordinate the daily operation of all MEP and electro-mechanical systems at the Primary Nursery Facility.
  • Monitor and control equipment including MCCs, pumps, VFDs, fans, instrumentation, emergency generators, AHUs, chillers, and related systems.
  • Plan operational activities, establish priorities, and coordinate maintenance and project-related works.
  • Conduct regular inspections and monitor system performance to ensure facility readiness, reliability, and compliance with operational requirements.
  • Analyze system performance, operating parameters, alarms, and set points, and implement corrective actions and improvement initiatives.
  • Respond promptly to emergencies, major faults, equipment failures, and operational interruptions.
  • Support Root Cause Analysis (RCA), incident investigations, commissioning activities, and the implementation of corrective actions.
  • Manage and monitor contractors and service providers delivering Janitorial, Horticulture, Pest Control, Waste Management, and Office Services.
  • Ensure customer satisfaction by resolving complaints, high-priority tickets, and recurring operational issues while monitoring service delivery against KPIs.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4–6 years of experience in Facility Management, Facility Operations, or a similar role.
  • Proven experience in the operation and monitoring of MEP and electro-mechanical systems.
  • Good knowledge of facility systems and equipment, including MCCs, pumps, VFDs, generators, AHUs, chillers, fans, and instrumentation.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and understand MEP commissioning procedures.
  • Experience in contractor management, service provider coordination, and KPI monitoring.
  • Strong knowledge of troubleshooting, problem-solving, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and corrective action processes.
  • Good communication, leadership, coordination, analytical, and customer service skills.
  • Good command of written and spoken English, with the ability to work effectively under pressure and respond to operational emergencies.

jobs.title: Pasteurization Plant Operator (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a dedicated Pasteurization Plant Operator to join a reputable client in Saudi Arabia. This role involves operating and monitoring the pasteurization process within a food or beverage production facility to ensure products meet safety, quality, and regulatory standards. As a Pasteurization Plant Operator, you will play a crucial part in maintaining the integrity and efficiency of production operations.

Location: Eastern Region,Saudi Arabia

Job Duration: 1 Year

Responsibilities

  • Operate and monitor pasteurization equipment according to established procedures and safety guidelines.
  • Conduct regular inspections and maintenance of pasteurization machinery to prevent breakdowns.
  • Record and report operational data, including temperature, pressure, and production volumes.
  • Identify and troubleshoot process deviations or equipment malfunctions promptly.
  • Ensure compliance with food safety standards and quality control policies.
  • Collaborate with quality assurance and maintenance teams to optimize production processes.
  • Maintain a clean and safe working environment following health and safety protocols.

Requirements

  • Diploma or degree in Food Technology, or related field.
  • 3+ Years of work experience in the same field
  • Proven experience in operating pasteurization or heat-treatment equipment within a production environment.
  • Good understanding of food safety standards and quality assurance practices.
  • Ability to perform routine maintenance and troubleshoot equipment issues.
  • Strong attention to detail and adherence to safety procedures.
  • Effective communication skills and ability to work in a team.
  • Willingness to work in shifts as required.

jobs.title: Petrophysics Data Quality Specialist
jobs.description:
Eram Talent, a division of Eram Group, is an ISO 9001:2015-certified provider of human resources, industrial projects, and maintenance services solutions across a wide range of sectors, including Oil & Gas, petrochemical, power, infrastructure, water, mining, healthcare, and IT. This opportunity sits within the Oil & Energy space and is suited to a specialist who can help strengthen the quality, consistency, and usability of subsurface petrophysical data. Preferred certificate

  • Master's degree in Data Analysis, Data Science, Business Analytics, or MIS is preferred.

jobs.title: Piping & Layout Lead Engineer (China)
jobs.description:
Serves as the technical authority for all piping design activities in EPC projects, accountable for technical decisions, quality, schedule, and cost control. Acts as the primary interface with project management and other engineering disciplines to ensure full compliance with SAES, SAMSS, and applicable regulations.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Leadership

  • Lead and oversee all piping design activities (layout, materials, stress, supports).
  • Review and approve key deliverables: P&IDs, Piping Class Sheets, GADs, Isometrics, Stress Reports.
  • Resolve complex technical and coordination issues across disciplines.
  • Ensure design quality, constructability, and cost optimization.

2. Standards & Compliance

  • Ensure full adherence to (SAES, SAMSS) and international codes (ASME B31.3, API, ASTM).
  • Integrate company procedures with client requirements.

3. Discipline Coordination

  • Interface with Process, Equipment, Structural, Instrumentation, Electrical, and Civil teams.
  • Provide piping loads, review nozzle orientations, and support 3D model reviews (30%, 60%, 90%).

4. Client & Vendor Management

  • Lead technical meetings with clients and secure design approvals.
  • Review and approve vendor documents for critical piping items (valves, fittings, supports).

5. Team & Quality Management

  • Manage and mentor piping designers and stress engineers.
  • Implement QA/QC procedures and mitigate technical risks.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Mechanical, Chemical, or Petrochemical Engineering.
  • Certification: P.E. or CEng (or equivalent qualification) preferred.
  • Experience: 15+ years in piping design for oil & gas/petrochemical EPC; minimum 2 full-cycle projects as Lead.
  • Software: Proficient in CAESAR II, SP3D/AVEVA E3D.
  • Knowledge: Expert in SAES, SAMSS, ASME B31.3, API, ASTM standards.
  • Skills: Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making in multicultural environments.
  • Language: Fluent English (spoken & written).
  • Other: Fit for long-term overseas assignments; high integrity and professionalism.

jobs.title: Planning & Control Manager (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a skilled and experienced Planning & Control Manager to join our team in Saudi Arabia. The Planning & Control Manager works under C&C Business Operations and is responsible for providing an oversight into all C&C Projects and Initiatives in terms of financial governance, planning, monitoring and reporting. The main objectives are to:

·Establish and maintain C&C projects financial procedures, business processes, reporting and overall compliance and governance. Monitor and report on overall C&C program of projects and initiatives, in terms of budget, forecast, cash-flow, accrual accounting and financial management.

Work with C&C stakeholders and Finance to align C&C strategic objectives and KAUST policies and procedures.

Conduct various analysis on C&C projects cost, benchmarking and commercial performance.

Responsibility

  • Lead financial governance for all projects, establishing and maintaining policies, procedures, and controls aligned with best practices.
  • Ensure compliance with project control requirements, including budget approvals, scope alignment, project charters, change management, and risk processes.
  • Coordinate with Finance, Procurement, and stakeholders to manage and control all project-related financial activities.
  • Develop and implement cost control strategies to meet project budgets, schedules, and overall program objectives.
  • Conduct gap and performance analysis to improve productivity, optimize resource utilization, and identify areas of concern.
  • Oversee project planning and budgeting from feasibility to completion, including resource planning and procurement strategies.
  • Monitor and report project performance, tracking costs, payments, progress, and schedules, including variance and trend analysis.
  • Manage cash flow and invoicing processes, including accruals, advance payments, and coordination with contracts and finance teams.
  • Drive stakeholder collaboration and reporting, ensuring clear communication and alignment across project managers, finance, and leadership.
  • Enhance project performance and governance through benchmarking, contractor performance evaluation, lessons learned systems, and management reporting.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field (PMP certification is a plus).
  • Minimum 10+ years of experience in project planning, cost control, and financial management.
  • Strong expertise in budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, and financial governance.
  • Proven experience in managing large-scale projects and coordinating with Finance, Procurement, and Project teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel) and SAP systems.
  • Solid understanding of accounting principles, risk management, and compliance frameworks.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to present financial data effectively.
  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and ability to work under pressure while meeting deadlines.

·Establish and maintain C&C projects financial procedures, business processes, reporting and overall compliance and governance. Monitor and report on overall C&C program of projects and initiatives, in terms of budget, forecast, cash-flow, accrual accounting and financial management.

Work with C&C stakeholders and Finance to align C&C strategic objectives and KAUST policies and procedures.

Conduct various analysis on C&C projects cost, benchmarking and commercial performance.

Responsibility

  • Lead financial governance for all projects, establishing and maintaining policies, procedures, and controls aligned with best practices.

  • Develop and implement cost control strategies to meet project budgets, schedules, and overall program objectives.
  • Conduct gap and performance analysis to improve productivity, optimize resource utilization, and identify areas of concern.

  • Monitor and report project performance, tracking costs, payments, progress, and schedules, including variance and trend analysis.
  • Manage cash flow and invoicing processes, including accruals, advance payments, and coordination with contracts and finance teams.

  • Enhance project performance and governance through benchmarking, contractor performance evaluation, lessons learned systems, and management reporting.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field (PMP certification is a plus).
  • Minimum 10+ years of experience in project planning, cost control, and financial management.
  • Strong expertise in budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, and financial governance.
  • Proven experience in managing large-scale projects and coordinating with Finance, Procurement, and Project teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel) and SAP systems.
  • Solid understanding of accounting principles, risk management, and compliance frameworks.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to present financial data effectively.
  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and ability to work under pressure while meeting deadlines.

jobs.title: Planning Analyst - Utilities (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Analyst II – Planning is responsible for supporting operational planning, maintenance scheduling, resource coordination, and performance monitoring activities for the MASA Water Treatment Plant. The role ensures efficient plant operations through accurate planning, data analysis, preventive maintenance coordination, and reporting while maintaining compliance with safety, environmental, and operational standards.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly operational and maintenance plans for the water treatment plant.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Maintenance, Procurement, and Engineering teams to ensure smooth execution of planned activities.
  • Monitor plant performance indicators, operational efficiency, and maintenance schedules.
  • Analyze operational data and generate reports to support management decision-making.
  • Track preventive and corrective maintenance activities through CMMS/SAP systems.
  • Ensure availability of required manpower, materials, spare parts, and resources for scheduled activities.
  • Support shutdown planning, turnaround activities, and emergency maintenance coordination.
  • Maintain records of work orders, equipment history, operational logs, and planning documentation.
  • Assist in identifying operational risks, bottlenecks, and process improvement opportunities.
  • Ensure compliance with HSE regulations, company policies, and quality standards.
  • Coordinate with contractors and vendors regarding planned activities and service schedules.
  • Prepare KPI reports, performance dashboards, and operational summaries for management review.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in planning or operations support within water treatment, utilities, industrial plants, or process industries.
  • Experience in maintenance planning and scheduling is preferred.
  • Knowledge of water treatment plant operations and maintenance processes is an advantage.
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications, especially Excel and reporting tools.
  • Experience with SAP/CMMS systems preferred.

jobs.title: Process Engineer (Refinery) - Saudi Arabia
jobs.description:
Eram Talent, a leading talent acquisition company in the Oil & Energy sector, We are seeking an experienced Process Engineer (Refinery) to be stationed at YASREF refinery. The ideal candidate will provide on-site technical support, troubleshooting, and optimization for refinery process units, ensuring safe, efficient, and reliable operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide expert-level process engineering support for refinery operations.
  • Monitor plant performance and recommend improvements to optimize efficiency, reliability, and safety.
  • Troubleshoot operational issues and provide immediate technical solutions.
  • Support plant modifications, debottlenecking, and process optimization initiatives.
  • Review and validate process design, simulation, and operational data.
  • Coordinate with operations, maintenance, and technical teams to resolve process-related challenges.
  • Ensure compliance with safety standards, environmental regulations, and company procedures.
  • Participate in shutdowns, startups, and commissioning activities when required.

Requirements

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical Engineering or related field.
  • Minimum 10+ years of experience in refinery process engineering roles.
  • Strong experience in refinery operations and technical support.

Technical Expertise (Mandatory)

Must have experience in at least one of the following refinery process units:

  • Two Stage Hydrocracking
  • LPG Olefin Saturation
  • Mercaptan Removal
  • Delayed Coking

OR strong experience in the following areas:

  • Refinery Process Simulation
  • Relief Load & Flare System Analysis
  • Process Hydraulics Calculations
  • Fired Heaters Design & Operation
  • Refinery Real-Time Optimization (RTO)

Required Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Expertise in process simulation tools (e.g., Aspen HYSYS, UniSim).
  • In-depth understanding of refinery operations and safety standards.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced operational environment.

jobs.title: Procurement Engineer (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Procurement Engineer is responsible for managing the complete procurement lifecycle for EPC projects, including sourcing materials, equipment, long-lead items, and subcontracted services. The role ensures cost-effective purchasing, timely delivery, compliance with technical specifications, and adherence to project schedules while supporting successful project execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the end-to-end procurement process for project materials, equipment, long-lead items, and subcontracted services in accordance with project requirements.
  • Prepare RFQs, evaluate supplier quotations, and conduct technical and commercial bid evaluations with engineering and project teams.
  • Negotiate pricing, delivery schedules, payment terms, warranties, and contractual conditions to achieve the best commercial outcomes.
  • Prepare purchase orders, procurement recommendations, and contract documentation for management approval.
  • Coordinate with engineering, planning, QA/QC, logistics, construction, and project management teams to ensure timely procurement and material delivery.
  • Monitor supplier performance, expedite critical deliveries, and resolve procurement issues that could impact project schedules.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with approved vendors while identifying new suppliers to improve quality, cost, and delivery performance.
  • Track procurement progress, maintain procurement schedules, and provide regular status reports to project management.
  • Ensure compliance with company procurement procedures, client specifications, contractual obligations, and applicable HSE and quality standards.
  • Maintain accurate procurement records, vendor databases, and documentation while supporting project cost control and procurement risk management

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Minimum 15 years of procurement experience with reputed EPC contractors.
  • At least 5 years of experience in EPC projects within Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Power, Infrastructure, or Industrial sectors.
  • Proven experience in procuring long-lead items, critical equipment, bulk materials, and subcontracted services for major EPC projects.
  • Strong knowledge of EPC procurement processes, contract administration, supplier qualification, and commercial negotiations.
  • Experience in international and local sourcing, vendor development, supplier evaluation, and procurement planning.
  • Proficiency in ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or equivalent procurement software, along with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Professional certifications such as CIPS, CPM, or equivalent are preferred.
  • Excellent analytical, negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work under project deadlines.

jobs.title: Procurement Expeditor
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is actively seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Procurement Expeditor on behalf of a leading EPC client in the Oil & Gas sector in Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the timely delivery of materials, equipment, and critical documentation to keep major EPC projects—specifically Gas Oil Separation Plants (GOSP)—on schedule.

The work location would be in Haradh, Saudi Arabia.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supplier Coordination: Act as the primary point of contact between the project team and vendors to proactively monitor the manufacturing, fabrication, and delivery status of procured materials and equipment.
  • Schedule Management: Track and verify vendor schedules against project milestones, identifying potential delays early and implementing effective recovery plans.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Liaise closely with Procurement, Engineering, Quality Control, and Project Management teams to ensure all material requirements and technical specifications are aligned and met.
  • Documentation Tracking: Ensure the timely submission and approval of all required vendor data and documentation (e.g., inspection reports, shipping documents, material certificates).
  • Reporting: Maintain and update daily/weekly expediting reports, tracking logs, and ERP systems to provide accurate visibility of procurement statuses to project stakeholders.
  • Issue Resolution: Negotiate and resolve bottlenecks, supply chain disruptions, or logistical challenges that threaten project timelines.

Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a highly relevant discipline.

Experience: A minimum of 2 years of professional experience in procurement, expediting, or supply chain roles.

Industry Knowledge: Proven experience within the EPC Oil & Gas sector.

Specialized Expertise: Direct experience with GOSP (Gas Oil Separation Plant) projects is highly preferred and will be considered a strong advantage.

Technical Skills: Proficiency in tracking software, ERP systems, and standard MS Office applications (Excel, Word).

Soft Skills: Strong negotiation, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to maintain composure and drive results in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.

jobs.title: Program Analyst (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is excited to announce an opening for a Data Program Analyst in Saudi Arabia. In this critical role, you will be responsible for analyzing and managing data programs to support decision-making and operational efficiency. The Program Analyst will transform raw data into actionable insights, helping us measure our impact, improve our programs, and make data-driven decisions. This position requires a strong analytical mindset and the ability to work collaboratively with various teams to enhance data-driven strategies.

Key Responsibilities

Data Capture & Management -

  • Collect and maintain accurate data from participating startups and program activities. -
  • Ensure completeness, consistency, and reliability of data across multiple programs. -
  • Develop templates and processes for systematic data collection and verification. -
  • Generate ad-hoc reports and data analysis to support strategic planning, business development, and program improvements. -
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for startups regarding all data collection and reporting requirements.

Program Support & Analysis

  • Support program managers in planning and executing core activities (bootcamps, workshops, demo days, etc.).
  • Track program delivery against timelines and escalate risks or delays.
  • Contribute to preparation of program briefs, meeting notes, and stakeholder updates.

Dashboard Development & Reporting

  • Build and maintain dashboards to track KPIs, startup metrics, and ecosystem impact.
  • Support the preparation of presentations with clear data visualizations and insights

Startup Engagement & Program Support

  • Proactively follow up with founders and team members to ensure timely submission of data and reports
  • Support the onboarding of new startups into our data systems and reporting frameworks

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Data Science, or a related field is required.
  • 2–4 years of professional experience in data analysis, program management support, or within startup/innovation ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage datasets with an extremely high level of accuracy and attention to detail required
  • Proficiency in SQL, data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), and Excel.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage datasets with an extremely high level of accuracy and attention to detail required.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Experience with data governance and data management frameworks is a plus.
  • Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Arabic is an advantage.

jobs.title: Project Engineer (EPC)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is actively seeking a knowledgeable and experienced Project Engineer (EPC) to join our team for a prominent company within the Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) sector. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and overseeing projects through all phases of the EPC process. This role will involve ensuring that projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with quality and safety standards.

As part of ERAM Group, E-Talent is an independent Talent Acquisition Consultancy committed to connecting top-tier professionals with outstanding opportunities across various domains including Engineering, Oil & Gas, Infrastructure, and Construction. This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious engineer to drive impactful projects within a dynamic environment.

Responsibilities

1. Technology and Engineering Management

  • 1.1 Assist the Project Manager in reviewing project basic engineering design documents, ensuring full compliance with Saudi Aramco design standards (e.g., SAES, SAMSS, SABP) and project specifications.
  • 1.2 Coordinate design work across various disciplines (Process, Piping, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Civil, etc.), chair or participate in key technical coordination meetings, and resolve interface conflicts and technical challenges during the design phase.
  • 1.3 Manage the flow, approval, and archiving of project technical documents, ensuring the accuracy and completeness of all engineering deliverables.
  • 1.4 Lead or participate in the technical evaluation of Technical Queries (TQs), Material Substitution Requests (SRM), and Change Requests (CRs), and follow up on the Saudi Aramco approval process.

2. Procurement and Supplier Coordination

  • 2.1 Provide technical support to assist in the preparation of procurement technical specifications for key equipment and materials.
  • 2.2 Participate in the technical bid evaluation of key suppliers.
  • 2.3 Review technical documents submitted by suppliers (such as drawings, data sheets, calculation reports, ITP), ensuring they meet project requirements.
  • 2.4 Coordinate the resolution of any technical issues arising during equipment manufacturing.

3. Construction and Pre-Commissioning Support

  • 3.1 Provide comprehensive technical support to field construction, resolving technical challenges encountered during construction.
  • 3.2 Review the technical feasibility of Construction Method Statements.
  • 3.3 Manage engineering changes within the project scope, assess the impact of changes on cost, schedule, and technology, and strictly adhere to the change management process.
  • 3.4 Participate in onsite system Mechanical Completion checks, ensuring installation work conforms to design intent and specifications.
  • 3.5 Support pre-commissioning and commissioning activities by providing necessary technical documents and guidance.

4. Planning, Scheduling, and Reporting

  • 4.1 Assist the Project Manager in developing and controlling the project's engineering schedule.
  • 4.2 Prepare and submit weekly/monthly engineering technical progress reports to the Project Manager and the client (Saudi Aramco).
  • 4.3 Identify and assess project technical risks and propose mitigation measures.

5. Compliance and Standards

  • 5.1 Ensure all engineering activities strictly comply with Saudi Aramco's Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policies and procedures.
  • 5.2 Ensure the entire project process conforms to Saudi Aramco's Quality Management System requirements.

6. Communication and Coordination

  • 6.1 Act as one of the primary points of contact for daily technical communication with the client's (Saudi Aramco) engineers.
  • 6.2 Effectively coordinate work between the internal design team, procurement team, construction team, and subcontractors.

Requirements

1. Education and Professional Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher, majoring in Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering field.
  • Possession of PMP (Project Management Professional), Chartered Engineer, or equivalent certification is preferred.

2. Work Experience

  • 2.1 Minimum 8-10 years of project engineering experience in the oil, gas, or petrochemical industry, including at least 5 years in a Project Engineer or similar technical coordination role on large-scale Saudi Aramco petrochemical EPC projects.
  • In-depth understanding and practical experience with Saudi Aramco standards, processes, and culture are required.
  • 2.2 Project experience in oil-gas separation, production enhancement, gathering and distribution stations, or similar upstream/midstream facilities is preferred.

3. Knowledge and Skills

  • 3.1 Proficiency in at least one core engineering discipline (e.g., Process, Piping, or Mechanical) and familiarity with the fundamentals of other related disciplines.
  • 3.2 Thorough understanding of the project lifecycle, from conceptual design to mechanical completion and commissioning.
  • 3.3 Familiarity with international engineering standards (e.g., ASME, API, ANSI, IEC) and Saudi Aramco-specific standards.
  • 3.4 Proficient in MS Office (especially Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • 3.5 Proficient in project management software (e.g., Primavera P6 or MS Project).
  • 3.6 Familiarity with common engineering design software and document management systems (e.g., SPF, Aconex).
  • 3.7 Fluent in both English and Arabic, with both languages serving as working languages.

4. Core Competencies and Personal Attributes

  • 4.1 Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with technical experts, management, and clients.
  • 4.2 Ability to analyze complex problems under pressure and propose practical solutions.
  • 4.3 Ability to lead cross-functional teams in resolving technical issues, even in the absence of direct reporting lines.
  • 4.4 Capable of managing multiple tasks and large volumes of technical information simultaneously.
  • 4.5 Adaptability to fast-paced, high-demand project environments, and ability to navigate cultural differences and work challenges.
  • 4.6 Strong sense of responsibility and commitment to achieving project goals.

Benefits

Job Location: Ningbo, China & Saudi Haradh

Contract Period: 1 to 3 years depending on the project and performance.

Visa: Business visa will be provided by the Client.

jobs.title: Project Engineer : Mechanical HVAC (Residential Buildings Experience)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Project Engineer Mechanical with a strong background in residential units HVAC and mechanical systems design reviews, material installation, site supervision, and quality inspections for the mechanical components of major building rectification and upgrade programs. This role demands a high level of expertise in the design, execution, testing, and commissioning of complex mechanical systems. The ideal candidate will ensure stringent adherence to design criteria, codes, and industry standards at every stage of the project's life cycle.

Work Location : Thuwwal, Saudi Arabia

Scope of Work

  • Perform design reviews of design packages, providing constructability insights as needed to the Design & Engineering team or consultants.
  • Review and coordinate shop drawings, and as-built drawings across multiple trades and disciplines.
  • Supervise and inspect mechanical work, providing day-to-day monitoring of project progress within the project scope.
  • Perform QA/QC inspections to identify nonconforming work, issuing periodic reports to track quality metrics.
  • Respond to contractor requests for inspections, technical queries, and site clarifications, coordinating with the project management team to issue field directives as necessary.

  • Investigate and resolve complaints related to code violations, addressing issues promptly.
  • Monitor project progression via an approved schedule to ensure adherence to timelines and milestones.
  • Document deficiencies and corrective actions by photographing conditions before and after rectification.
  • Maintain comprehensive records and daily updates to the project track sheet.
  • Develop Project Charters outlining project scope, budget, and schedule to guide project planning and execution.
  • Work in partnership with other FM teams, IT, HSE, and stakeholders as needed, with transparency.
  • Be user-centric, building trust and strong relationships with customers, providing options, solutions and choices to meet their needs.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in verifying design against construction, QA/QC, material specification, Mechanical Systems commissioning mainly residential HVAC and plumbing systems.
  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering
  • Extensive knowledge and familiarity with Mechanical codes and design.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English.
  • Attention to detail

  • Multitasking
  • Customer oriented

jobs.title: Project Engineering Manager (GES and Design Management)
jobs.description:
The project Engineering Manager is Lead and manage multidisciplinary engineering and design activities for Saudi Aramco GES+ projects. Ensure engineering deliverables meet Saudi Aramco standards, project schedules, budgets, and quality requirements. Coordinate with the Client, PMT, licensors, vendors, procurement, and construction teams. Provide technical leadership across all engineering disciplines and ensure timely resolution of engineering issues throughout project execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead multidisciplinary engineering teams covering Process, Mechanical, Piping, Civil, E&I, and Telecom.

  • Ensure all engineering activities comply with Saudi Aramco standards, specifications, and procedures.
  • Coordinate engineering interfaces with the Client, PMT, licensors, vendors, procurement, and construction teams.
  • Monitor engineering progress, man-hours, resource utilization, and deliverable schedules.
  • Lead design reviews, constructability reviews, HAZOPs, and technical workshops.
  • Manage Technical Queries (TQs), design changes, engineering risks, and technical issues.
  • Provide engineering support throughout procurement, construction, and commissioning phases.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, preferably Process or Mechanical Engineering.
  • Minimum 15 years of relevant engineering experience.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in Engineering Management.
  • Proven experience working on Saudi Aramco GES+ projects.
  • Strong knowledge of Saudi Aramco engineering standards, specifications, and procedures.
  • Strong experience in multidisciplinary design management and project engineering.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

jobs.title: Project Execution Lead - EPC
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a skilled Project Execution Lead with EPC experience, specifically with a background in working with Aramco, to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in ensuring the successful execution of engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) projects while maintaining quality standards and adhering to safety regulations.

The work location would be at Rabigh, Saudi Arabia.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the planning and execution of EPC projects, ensuring compliance with contract specifications and safety standards.
  • Coordinate with various project teams to ensure timely delivery of project milestones.
  • Oversee scheduling, resource allocation, and budgeting to meet project objectives.
  • Manage stakeholder communications and maintain strong relationships with clients, including Aramco.
  • Identify and mitigate project risks while resolving any issues that arise during the project lifecycle.
  • Monitor and report on project performance, adjusting plans as necessary to meet changing conditions.
  • Ensure project documentation is complete, accurate, and archived for future reference.

Requirements

  • Minimum 12 years of extensive experience in project execution within the EPC sector, with specific experience in projects for Aramco.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field from an accredited institution.
  • Proven expertise in managing large-scale EPC projects, with a successful track record of delivering projects on time and within budget.
  • Strong knowledge of project management methodologies and tools, including PMP or similar certifications.
  • Excellent leadership, organizational, and communication skills to effectively manage cross-functional teams and project stakeholders.
  • Ability to work in high-pressure environments, balancing multiple projects and tasks simultaneously.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in project management software and tools, such as Primavera P6 or MS Project.
  • Familiarity with health, safety, security, and environmental (HSSE) regulations in the industrial sector.

jobs.title: Project Manager (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Project Manager is responsible for planning, executing, and overseeing operations and maintenance projects to ensure safe, efficient, and reliable plant and pipeline performance. The role requires strong technical expertise, leadership capabilities, and experience in gas plant and pipeline operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, manage, and execute operations and maintenance projects in line with company objectives and safety standards.
  • Oversee daily operations and maintenance activities for plants and pipelines, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.
  • Lead, supervise, and manage technical teams, contractors, and site personnel.
  • Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements.

  • Experience in maintenance planning and asset management.

  • Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • High commitment to safety and operational excellence.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Aviation Industry
jobs.description:
Eram Talent, a division of ERAM Holdings, is seeking a dedicated and experienced Project Manager for the Aviation Industry. The successful candidate will be responsible for planning, directing, and coordinating aviation-related projects to ensure they are completed on time, within scope, and on budget. This role will require close collaboration with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and clients within the aviation sector to deliver high-quality project outcomes.

The Project Manager will oversee the full project lifecycle, from initial concept through to implementation and handover, ensuring compliance with aviation industry regulations and standards. You will be expected to identify risks, manage resources, and foster excellent communication among all project partners to maintain project alignment and success.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Aviation Management, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of project management experience in the aviation industry or related sectors.
  • Strong understanding of aviation regulations, safety standards, and industry best practices.
  • Proven track record of managing aviation projects from initiation to completion.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proficiency with project management software and tools.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple competing priorities.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification preferred.
  • Knowledge of the Middle East aviation market is an advantage.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Logistics & Supplychain
jobs.description:
The Project Manager’s role is essential in ensuring the successful delivery of projects. The role holder will lead the implementation of small to large projects and collaborate with cross-functional teams and a range of internal and external stakeholders. This role will deploy the full range of the department’s tools and processes to ensure the successful design and deployment and delivery of all assigned projects throughout their full lifecycles with a strong focus on achieving the intended benefits and operational performance goals.

General Responsibilities

  • Manage and execute projects under the guidance of the Senior Project Manager and the Project Delivery Lead Management to ensure they are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with predefined and agreed objectives and quality standards.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive project schedules, and budgets. Continuously monitor project progress, identifying and addressing issues, risks and changes as they arise.
  • Work with the Director Project Delivery Lead Management to define project milestones/objectives and deliverables for projects and establish a framework for monitoring and reporting project performance.
  • Collaborate with project team members to identify and implement improvement strategies that enhance project delivery efficiency and effectiveness and mitigate issues and risks.
  • Work closely with various departments within the Centre of Excellence (COE) to ensure seamless coordination and alignment of project activities with overall business objectives.
  • Foster effective communication and collaboration among project team members and stakeholders to ensure everyone is aligned with project goals, objectives and the status of all assigned projects.
  • Implement and uphold rigorous quality assurance processes to ensure that projects meet or exceed quality standards and customer expectations.
  • Conduct regular project audits to verify adherence to established quality guidelines and identify areas for improvement.
  • Identify potential project issues, risks, changes and collaborate within the Project Delivery Teams to develop contingency and mitigation plans to proactively address challenges that may impact project delivery.
  • Allocate and manage project resources efficiently, including personnel, budget, and equipment, to optimize project delivery and ensure the efficient utilization of resources.
  • Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, progress reports, all project logs and documentation of lessons learned, in line with organizational standards.
  • Provide regular updates and reports on project status to the Director Project Delivery Lead Management, Chief Operational Excellence Officer, and relevant stakeholders.
  • Recommend training and development interventions for team members to build their capabilities.
  • Contribute to the identification of opportunities for the continuous improvement of systems, processes, and practices to increase productivity and operational efficiency.
  • Implement all relevant Department’s policies, processes, procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
  • Contribute to the preparation of timely and accurate reports to meet departmental requirements, policies, and standards.

Requirements

Qualification

  • Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is required.
  • Master’s degree in Project Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is preferred.
  • PMP or Prince2 certification is required.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in oral and written business English.
  • 7+ years of experience in project management or a related field preferably into Supplychain industries, including planning, execution, delivery, and reporting.
  • Proven experience in project management, including planning, execution, delivery, reporting and effective communication.
  • Experience working with leadership and senior stakeholders and coordinating across internal cross-functional teams.
  • Experience with any one of PMP-style project controls, Prince2, risk and change management, or structured reporting and governance.
  • Broader experience across PMP-style project controls, Prince2, risk and change management, and structured reporting and governance is preferred.
  • Experience in logistics and supply chain projects is preferred.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Railway Safety & O&M (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Project Manager will lead and manage railway safety and inspection activities for key railway operation and maintenance projects across Saudi Arabia. The role requires extensive experience in railway systems focusing on safety compliance, technical inspection, accident investigation, and regulatory oversight, ensuring the highest standards of railway operation safety.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct scheduled supervisory visits and technical inspections at major railway projects (e.g., Haramain High-Speed Railway, Riyadh Metro, Etihad Rail).
  • Lead on-site investigations immediately following railway accidents or incidents.
  • Prepare and submit detailed monitoring and investigation reports within prescribed timelines (usually within two weeks).
  • Review, update, and contribute to railway policies, regulations, and procedural documents as requested by regulatory authorities.
  • Participate in meetings with railway operators and government transport authorities, both remote and in-person.
  • Verify operator compliance with safety certifications, operating licenses, and regulatory requirements during inspections.
  • Provide continuous technical support and respond promptly to queries from the Authority staff between site visits.
  • Ensure all inspection and investigation activities strictly comply with official safety standards and protocols.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 20 years’ experience in railway systems, safety, operation, and maintenance (O&M).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Safety Management, or related technical field. Master’s degree is preferred.
  • Proven experience conducting technical investigations of railway accidents or incidents.
  • Hands-on experience with railway operation, maintenance protocols, and safety standards.
  • Prior experience working on railway projects in Saudi Arabia or GCC countries is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of international best practices for railway safety and inspection.

jobs.title: Project Planning Lead - EPC
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is excited to announce an exceptional opportunity for a Project Planning Lead specializing in Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) for Aramco projects. Located in Saudi Arabia, you will be at the forefront of managing project planning and scheduling activities, working closely with multidisciplinary teams to ensure successful delivery of some of the largest and most complex projects in the oil and gas sector.

The work location would be in Rabigh, Saudi Arabia.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules for Aramco EPC projects, ensuring alignment with project milestones and deliverables.
  • Collaborate with project managers, engineering teams, contractors, and stakeholders to gather relevant information and incorporate it into scheduling processes.
  • Utilize advanced scheduling software tools, such as Primavera P6, to create, analyze, and update project timelines thoroughly.
  • Identify potential scheduling issues and risks, proactively developing mitigation strategies to ensure timely project completion.
  • Conduct regular schedule progress reviews and provide detailed reports to stakeholders and senior management.
  • Facilitate and participate in project meetings, ensuring effective communication of planning and scheduling activities.
  • Implement best practices and continuous improvement initiatives in project planning and scheduling methodologies.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 12 years of experience in project planning and scheduling within the EPC sector, specifically for Aramco projects.
  • Expert proficiency in planning software, particularly Primavera P6 or similar tools.
  • Strong understanding of project management principles, scheduling techniques, and methodologies.
  • Ability to analyze complex project data and present it in a clear, concise manner.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the capability to work collaboratively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
  • Proactive problem-solver with exceptional organization and time management skills.

jobs.title: Projects Planning Engineer (Architect) - Saudi Arabia
jobs.description:
The Projects Planning Engineer (Architect) is responsible for planning, leading, and overseeing the planning and design phase of Academic, Research, Administrative, Support Facility, Infrastructure, and KAUST community projects from inception through the design phase. The Projects Planning Engineer-Architect is the FM Representative to a wide range of internal and external stakeholders, often managing the design, budget, schedule, and scope of multiple critical projects simultaneously.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary liaison between Facilities Management and university, research, and community stakeholders.
  • Gather, define, and document project requirements, scope, and objectives from inception through the design phase.
  • Develop project strategies, milestones, schedules, and planning documents.
  • Prepare executive-level reports and presentations for senior management.
  • Lead feasibility studies, programming studies, and early design development, either directly or through consultants.
  • Manage and coordinate external consultants, architects, and engineering firms.
  • Develop and control project budgets in coordination with cost consultants and internal teams.
  • Ensure projects align with quality standards, sustainability requirements, and institutional guidelines.
  • Lead procurement processes for selection of design consultants and contractors, in coordination with procurement and legal teams.
  • Prepare and review tender documents, contracts, and technical submissions.
  • Evaluate design proposals and recommend value engineering and cost optimization solutions.
  • Monitor and manage project risks, claims, variations, and change orders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Planning, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in architecture, planning, or project management.
  • Experience in managing large-scale capital or infrastructure projects.
  • Strong knowledge of project planning, design development, and construction processes.
  • Proficiency in project management and scheduling tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera, BIM tools).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.
  • Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.

jobs.title: Prototyping Support Technician (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is currently seeking a dedicated Prototyping Support Technician to join our team in Saudi Arabia. The Prototyping Support Technician provides operational support for outdoor testing projects and maintains general prototyping workshop equipment. The role supports the planning, coordination and execution of technical initiatives, experiments and installations, while also contributing to the reliable operation, troubleshooting and continuous improvement of Prototyping Core Lab assets and equipment.

As a Prototyping Support Technician, you will have the opportunity to work with advanced manufacturing technologies and contribute to innovative design processes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate and support renewable energy–related technical activities, including planning, scheduling, and execution of experiments, tests, and installations.
  • Provide hands-on troubleshooting and diagnostics for electrical, electronic, mechanical, and control systems within the Prototyping Core Lab.
  • Perform routine inspections and preventative maintenance to ensure equipment reliability, safety, and optimal performance.
  • Assist in equipment setup, installation, commissioning, and verification to ensure systems meet technical specifications and operational requirements.
  • Apply strong technical knowledge of electrical, mechanical, mechatronic, PLC, CNC, and control systems used in prototyping environments.
  • Coordinate technical tasks and installations effectively, ensuring timelines, resources, and safety standards are maintained.
  • Support researchers and project teams with practical problem-solving, technical guidance, and adherence to SOPs and HSE procedures.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, maintenance records, inspection reports, and project logs.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying workflow enhancements, conducting risk assessments, and implementing root cause analysis to prevent recurring issues.
  • Demonstrate adaptability and the ability to work effectively in outdoor testing environments and under operational pressure.

Requirements

  • Technical diploma or accredited apprenticeship in Electrical, Electronic, Mechatronics, Mechanical, or a related technical field.
  • 5 years of hands-on experience in commissioning, testing, and maintenance of electrical and/or mechatronic systems.
  • Practical experience servicing and maintaining prototyping workshop equipment, with PLC and CNC exposure considered an advantage.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve electrical, mechanical, electronic, and control system faults effectively.
  • Experience working in technical laboratory, workshop, or outdoor testing environments with strong adherence to safety and documentation standards.

jobs.title: QA/QC Engineer - Electrical
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is looking for a qualified QA/QC Engineer specializing in Electrical systems to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that electrical projects meet quality standards and comply with regulatory requirements.

As a QA/QC Engineer, you will play a vital role in the quality assurance process, conducting inspections, reviews, and tests on electrical installations and equipment. An experienced Electrical Engineer with a strong background in design reviews, material selection and installation, site supervision, and quality inspections for the electrical components of construction works. This role demands a high level of expertise in the design, execution, testing, and commissioning of complex electrical systems. The ideal candidate will ensure stringent adherence to design criteria, codes, and industry standards at every stage of the project life cycle.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform quality control inspections and audits on electrical systems, installations, and equipment to ensure compliance with specifications and standards.
  • Develop and implement quality assurance procedures and protocols related to electrical works.
  • Review and interpret electrical drawings, specifications, and project documents.
  • Conduct inspections and testing of electrical installations, materials, and equipment to ensure compliance with project and industry standards.
  • Monitor and verify the implementation of electrical QA/QC procedures on-site.
  • Review design documents and provide feedback to ensure constructability and compliance with codes and standards.
  • Prepare and maintain inspection test plans (ITP), checklists, and quality records.
  • Coordinate with construction, design, and procurement teams to resolve quality-related issues.
  • Ensure that all electrical work adheres to international standards (e.g., IEC, IEEE, NEC).
  • Participate in audits, material inspections, and commissioning activities.

jobs.title: Quality and Governance Specialist (Specialist)
jobs.description:
The Quality and Governance Specialist ensure maintaining high standards of quality, compliance and governance within KAUST Health. This role involves developing and overseeing clinical quality assurance initiatives and framework, ensuring adherence to regulatory standards, and working across departments to promote best practices and maintain accreditation.

The Specialist provides knowledge and guidance to KAUST Health and helps maintain the oversight of the medical services provider, ensuring that all necessary paperwork and records are kept in compliance with regulations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support in developing quality and governance frameworks, policies, and procedures that align with regulatory requirements and industry best practices. 
  • Support in conducting regular audits and performance assessments to ensure adherence to quality and governance goals. Use findings to drive continuous improvement. 
  • Analyze data and trends to pinpoint non-compliance issues or potential risks and execute actionable plans to mitigate identified concerns. 
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with accreditation standards and regulatory requirements. Provide support and monitor the preparation and compliance of the JCI, CBAHI and or any accreditation standards and extends the professional assistance to help the various departments to implement it. 
  • Support KAUST HR and Graduate Affairs with the processing of medical fit for relocation applications
  • Work closely with the KAUST Occupational Health Specialist on any Occupational Health matters. 
  • Assisting the department in the overall quality assurance and governance of health services at KAUST Health. To oversee the activities of the department in the areas of: 
  • Clinical Quality Assurance - participating in patient safety programs, completing patient safety walks and safety culture surveys. 
  • Support in quality KPI audit and validation. 
  • Understand The KAUST School health office role and the nursing team function and the Health Office, located in TKS premises and provide support and guidance as per needs.  
  • Understand the Medical referral committee process and support when assigned including facilitating approvals and organizing accommodation for high-risk pregnancies and other health patients.
  • Offering guidance to development personnel performing investigations and root cause analysis by applying expertise in quality concepts and methodologies. 
  • Maintains relationship with patients by maintaining strong open communication channels. 
  • Monitoring the Occurrence Variance Report process 
  • Be aware of the current medical equipment/instruments and provide recommendations to KH Operations team.
  • Any other ad-hoc duties as assigned by the Quality and Governance Manager. 

Requirements

  • Graduation from accredited school of nursing or having bachelor's degree in medical specialty or other related.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in quality assurance, governance, or a related function.
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience ideally including 3 years in quality and governance in a healthcare setting, preferably in Saudi Arabia. 
  • Strong knowledge of quality management systems (e.g., ISO 9001, CBAHI) and governance frameworks.
  • Proven experience in conducting audits and risk assessments.
  • Excellent analytical skills with the ability to assess complex data.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills for effective stakeholder engagement.
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to maintaining high standards.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.

Benefits

Salary is not a constraint ,company is looking for right candidate .

jobs.title: Quality Manager (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is currently seeking a Quality Manager for one of our esteemed clients in Saudi Arabia. Our client is a prominent organization committed to delivering superior products and services while maintaining exceptional quality standards.

As a Quality Manager, you will play a critical role in ensuring that all internal and external quality requirements are met. You will be responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing the quality management system across various departments. Your efforts will directly contribute to enhancing customer satisfaction and maintaining compliance with relevant regulations and standards.

This is an exciting opportunity for a dynamic individual with a solid background in quality management to make a meaningful impact in a well-respected company.

• Develop and implement quality management policies, procedures, and standards
• Oversee the quality assurance process for products and services to ensure compliance with organizational standards
• Conduct regular quality audits and assessments to identify areas for improvement
• Analyze quality metrics and prepare detailed reports for management
• Facilitate training and awareness programs on quality management principles across the organization
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve quality issues and implement corrective actions
• Monitor industry trends and ensure compliance with relevant legislation and standards
• Manage the quality assurance team and promote a culture of continuous improvement

Requirements

• Minimum of 7 years of experience in quality management, with at least 3 years in a managerial role
• Strong knowledge of quality management systems (ISO 9001, etc.)
• Proven experience in conducting audits and assessments
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
• Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities
• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration with various teams
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field (preferred)
• Relevant certifications in quality management (e.g., Six Sigma, ISO Lead Auditor) are a plus
• Proficiency in both English and Arabic is preferred

jobs.title: Reefscape Project Coordinator (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is looking for a skilled Reefscape Project Coordinator to join our team in Saudi Arabia. Reefscape Project Coordinator, who will report to the Lead, Operational Strategy & Planning, and is responsible for providing operational support for day-in-the-life operations for the project team at NEOM. jobs.title: Reporting Lead - Capital Renewal Program (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Reporting Lead to manage and drive the reporting activities for the Capital Renewal Program in Saudi Arabia. The Reporting Lead is responsible for overseeing program-wide reporting, analytics, and executive visibility for the Capital Renewal Program at KAUST. This role ensures the delivery of accurate, timely, and actionable insights across all projects, supporting leadership in strategic decision-making, governance, and execution.

The role acts as a critical link between project teams and executive management by consolidating data, managing reporting frameworks, and driving continuous improvement in reporting processes, dashboards, and program integration.

  • Lead the design, development, and delivery of regular and ad-hoc reports related to the Capital Renewal Program.
  • Collaborate with project managers, finance, and other stakeholders to define reporting requirements and KPIs.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain standardized reporting frameworks covering scope, cost, schedule, risks, and KPIs, ensuring governance, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Consolidate project data into weekly, monthly, and quarterly executive reports, delivering timely and actionable insights for leadership.
  • Establish and enforce reporting protocols, including timelines, validation workflows, and approval processes across all project teams.
  • Track and manage interdependencies across projects, ensuring alignment with operational priorities and funding cycles.
  • Identify and communicate cross-project risks, delays, and resource conflicts, providing impact assessments and mitigation strategies.
  • Design and maintain executive dashboards, offering real-time visibility into program progress, budget utilization, schedule performance, and key risks.
  • Review and validate master schedules, monitor critical path and dependencies, and proactively address slippages with recovery plans.
  • Drive continuous improvement by enhancing reporting tools, templates, and processes while promoting best practices in planning, scheduling, and program reporting.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Professional certification such as PMP is preferred.
  • Certification in data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) is an advantage.
  • Minimum 7+ years of experience in project reporting, program management, or capital project oversight.
  • Experience in managing reporting frameworks and executive dashboards.
  • Strong understanding of project lifecycle, governance, and reporting processes.
  • Experience in schedule management and critical path analysis.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook) and SAP.
  • Experience with dashboarding and analytics tools.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and mathematical skills.

jobs.title: Research and Development Engineer - Beverage/Liquid Industry
jobs.description:
ERAM Talent is seeking an experienced Research & Development (R&D) Engineer – Beverages.

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing innovative beverage formulations, improving existing products, conducting pilot trials, and supporting factory-scale production. This role requires strong expertise in beverage formulation, sugar reduction technologies, and functional ingredients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and formulate new beverage and liquid products based on market trends and customer requirements.
  • Improve existing beverage formulations to enhance taste, quality, nutritional value, and production efficiency.
  • Lead sugar reduction initiatives using alternative sweeteners while maintaining product taste, texture, and stability.
  • Develop formulations incorporating functional ingredients such as vitamins, minerals, proteins, and fibers.
  • Conduct laboratory trials, bench-top formulations, and pilot-scale testing.
  • Lead factory scale-up activities and support the successful transition from laboratory development to commercial production.
  • Evaluate thermal processing methods, including pasteurization, to ensure product quality and ingredient stability.
  • Select and evaluate raw materials and identify suitable alternatives when required.
  • Provide technical support during new product launches and production trials.
  • Train production teams on processing requirements for new formulations.
  • Troubleshoot manufacturing issues such as sedimentation, phase separation, flavor degradation, and color changes.
  • Work closely with Quality Assurance to ensure compliance with food safety and regulatory standards.
  • Conduct shelf-life studies, stability testing, and maintain complete technical documentation.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience in the Beverage or Liquid Food Manufacturing industry.
  • Proven experience in beverage formulation and product development.
  • Strong knowledge of functional ingredients and their stability in liquid applications.
  • Demonstrated experience in sugar reduction projects and alternative sweeteners.
  • Experience with pilot plant trials and factory-scale production.
  • Sound understanding of pasteurization, beverage processing, and food safety standards.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent documentation and communication abilities.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in juice, flavored beverages, dairy beverages, functional drinks, or similar liquid food products.
  • Exposure to cost optimization and product reformulation projects.
  • Familiarity with international food safety and quality management systems.

jobs.title: Research Technician (Agriculture / Greenhouse & Field Operations) Saudi Arabia
jobs.description:
The Research Technician will support the Interfacial Lab (iLab) at KAUST by assisting with greenhouse and growth chamber operations, laboratory testing, and field trials related to biochar and soil amendment research. The role involves preparing soil substrates, monitoring plant growth, conducting soil and plant analyses, supporting irrigation and field deployments, and maintaining accurate experimental records to ensure successful execution of agricultural research projects.

Requirements

  • Support greenhouse and growth chamber operations, including setting up and maintaining plant growth experiments.
  • Prepare soil substrates with biochar amendments (CarboSoil, SandX, and superhydrophobic sand) according to experimental protocols, and monitor plant health, growth conditions, and productivity metrics.
  • Conduct soil and plant sample analysis, including pH, EC, nutrient composition, and water retention.
  • Assist with field trials, soil preparation, planting, irrigation setup, soil sampling, and environmental monitoring.
  • Maintain laboratory inventory, experimental records, and ensure compliance with laboratory safety procedures.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Agriculture, Agronomy, Plant Science, Soil Science, Horticulture, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in greenhouse operations, agricultural research, field trials, and soil/plant analysis.
  • Experience with irrigation systems, greenhouse/growth chamber operations, and laboratory testing.
  • Knowledge of biochar and soil amendment technologies is an advantage.
  • Proficiency in soil and plant analysis, including pH, electrical conductivity (EC), nutrient composition, and water retention testing.
  • Ability to maintain accurate experimental records, manage laboratory inventory, and follow laboratory safety procedures.
  • Valid driving license and willingness to work at field sites when required.

jobs.title: Retail Leasing & Commercial Property Specialist
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Hospitality & Retail Services Specialist to lead and coordinate retail leasing, tenant management, retail development, and hospitality-related services across the KAUST Campus and Thuwal Corniche areas.

The role will be responsible for developing retail strategies, identifying and negotiating with prospective tenants, managing lease agreements, overseeing retailer onboarding and compliance, and coordinating retail development projects from feasibility and design through construction, commissioning, and lease-up.

The position will also support hospitality and catering services, ensuring high standards of customer experience, food safety, hygiene, HSE, operational compliance, and service quality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement retail leasing and commercial strategies aligned with community requirements, market trends, and financial objectives.
  • Identify, evaluate, negotiate, and secure suitable retail tenants, including obtaining lease commitments and Letters of Intent (LOIs).
  • Prepare, negotiate, administer, and monitor commercial lease agreements and service contracts.
  • Conduct market benchmarking, financial analysis, budgeting, and lease economics to support revenue and commercial objectives.
  • Manage the complete retailer lifecycle, including onboarding, operational readiness, inspections, compliance monitoring, performance reviews, and exit/clearance.
  • Develop and maintain retail inspection, compliance, HSE, hygiene, and service quality programs.
  • Manage retail development projects from concept, feasibility, programming, design, permitting, and construction through commissioning and lease-up.
  • Coordinate with internal departments, retailers, catering providers, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth retail and hospitality operations.
  • Oversee operational, budgetary, and financial activities related to food and non-food retail outlets and associated facilities.
