jobs.title: Rig Electrician
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking an experienced Rig Electrician to join our team. In this critical role, you will be responsible for overseeing the electrical systems on drilling rigs, ensuring the safety and efficiency of all electrical operations. You will conduct regular inspections, perform maintenance, and troubleshoot electrical issues to minimize downtime and maintain productivity.

Your expertise in both onshore and offshore operations will be invaluable as you work in a fast-paced environment that prioritizes safety and compliance with industry regulations. If you are passionate about electrical systems and seeking an opportunity to contribute to exciting projects in the oil and gas sector, we encourage you to apply.


Responsibilities

  • Install, maintain, and repair electrical systems and equipment on drilling rigs.
  • Troubleshoot and diagnose electrical faults and implement repairs as needed.
  • Perform routine inspections and maintenance on electrical panels, generators, and other related equipment.
  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations and electrical codes.
  • Work closely with the rig crew to maintain uninterrupted electrical operations.
  • Document work performed and maintain accurate maintenance records.
  • Assist in training and mentoring junior electricians and other crew members on electrical safety practices.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications:

  • a. High School Diploma or such equivalent acceptable to SAUDI ARAMCO.
  • b. associate's degree from a technical college acceptable to SAUDI ARAMCO.
  • c. Manufacturers training courses, a minimum of two (2) of the following:
  • i. Ross Hill SCR Systems
  • ii. IPS SCR System
  • 111. Baylor SCR Systems and Brake Controllers
  • iv. PLC (Prog rammable Logic Controls)
  • v. Caterpillar Engine controls
  • vi. Martin/Decker Instrumentation
  • vii . Air conditioning & Refrigeration training course
  • d. Two (2) years in the electrical field with not less than two (2) years' experience in the Oil/Gas drilling industry.
  • e. Has subject matter expert knowledge of all electrical test equipment associated with the electrical maintenance of drilling rigs, i.e. VOM, digital multimeters, oscilloscope, muggers, phase rotation detectors etc.
  • f. Have a working knowledge of computers with a minimum capability of using Microsoft programs such as word, outlook, and excel.
  • g. Familiar with API, ABS, IEEE, & SOLAS standards.
  • h. Have good leadership skills with the ability to perform on-the-job training for Rig Electricians and trainees.
  • i. Have the necessary English skills to communicate verbally and in any other written method (e.g. letters, forms and reports).
  • J. Have the necessary communication skills necessary to submit reports, complete forms and converse with supervisors and management in English.
  • k. Must have a working knowledge of drilling operations i.e. insure knowledgeable recommendations and decisions are made to minimize interruption of rig operations.
  • I. Familiar with API, IEEE, & SOLAS Standards.
  • m. Have good leadership skills with the ability to perform on-the-job training for Rig Electricians and Trainees.
  • n. Have communicating skills necessary to submit reports, complete forms and converse with supervisors and management.

jobs.title: Rig Material Expeditor (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a skilled Rig Material Expeditor to join our team in Saudi Arabia. As a Rig Material Expeditor, you will be responsible for ensuring the efficient delivery and management of drilling materials to various rig locations. Your role will be crucial in supporting the operations and logistics of our projects in the region.

Key Responsibilities

Rig Material Expeditor shall:
a) Adhere to all Saudi Aramco, D&WO and international HSE standards, policies and administrative controls.
b) Monitors the progress and shipment of drilling material. Obtains and inputs order status information in to system. 
c) Maintains material and parts inventory and status information to expedite movement of material and parts between production areas, per predetermined production schedules and maintains order priorities.
d) He reads production schedules, inventory reports, and work orders to determine type and quantity of materials required, availability of stock, and order priority.  Maintains Material Status, checks discrepancies etc.
e) He distributes materials to specified production areas, manually or using handcart, hand truck, or forklift.   He may also drive truck to outlying work areas to check status of orders or to deliver materials.
f) Conducts a daily review of assigned expeditor workload queue to ascertain which orders are to be actioned based on delivery date priorities.
g) Consolidates orders by vendors, in order to minimize the number of Contracts, and contracts the vendor status information or to Expedite material. Maintains constant contact with major vendors who routinely have large number of open orders.
h) Enters and maintain current order/LDOR status information in system.
i) Identifies as early as possible, any delays which may cause a delay in vendor’s delivery date, and advises as required.
j) Reviews conflicting delivery requirements and assures that orders are delivered in the most cost effective manner to Saudi Aramco.
k) Monitors the status and delivery of material and inspection certificates.
l) Periodically advises the supervisor on overall vendor performance for each vendor with whom the expeditors has regular contact.
m) Prepare written reports of poor vendor performance.
n) Maintains records and files and perform related clerical duties as necessary.
o) Prepare tables, indices, charts, graphs and other visual aids for use in presentations.
p) Assists in the preparation of various reports as requested by the superintendent / Supervisor.

Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent; relevant certification is a plus acceptable to Saudi Aramco.
  • 2-3 years of experience in material expediting or inventory management, preferably in the oil and gas sector.
  • Proficient in using Microsoft Office and materials management software.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills with attention to detail.
  • Effective communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
  • Able to work collaboratively in a team environment and handle multiple tasks.
  • Familiarity with HSE standards and procedures related to materials management.
  • Willingness to adapt to the dynamic nature of the offshore work environment.

jobs.title: Rigless Drilling Operations Foreman (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Rigless Drilling Operations Foreman is responsible for supervising and coordinating rigless drilling, well completion, and workover activities at onshore and offshore well sites. The role ensures safe, efficient, and timely execution of well programs in accordance with approved procedures, industry standards, and Saudi Aramco requirements.

  1. Key Responsibilities

    • Supervise rigless drilling, well completion, and workover operations at remote onshore and offshore well locations.
    • Ensure all operations are performed safely and in accordance with approved well programs, SOPs, industry best practices, and HSE standards.
    • Coordinate contractors, well services, equipment, materials, logistics, transportation, and site support required for operations.
    • Ensure compliance with Blowout Prevention (BOP) standards, equipment testing requirements, and emergency response procedures.
    • Monitor operational progress, materials, equipment, service-company activities, and associated costs; maintain accurate daily reports.
    • Ensure contractor compliance with contractual requirements, personnel competency, and equipment specifications.
    • Identify opportunities for cost optimization and operational improvement without compromising safety or well objectives.
    • Provide field guidance and on-the-job training to less experienced personnel.

  2. Required Experience & Qualifications

    • Proven experience in rigless drilling, well completion, or well workover operations.
    • Experience supervising complex or critical wells, including deep, high-pressure, sour-gas, or highly deviated wells.
    • Strong knowledge of well-site safety, BOP requirements, drilling/workover procedures, and contractor management.
    • Experience working with Saudi Aramco standards and procedures is highly preferred.
    • Willingness to work on a 28-days-on/28-days-off rotational schedule at remote onshore/offshore locations.

jobs.title: RTR Quality Control (QC) Inspector
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced RTR Quality Control (QC) Inspector to join our team on a major infrastructure project. The successful candidate will oversee the inspection and testing of Reinforced Thermosetting Resin (RTR), Glassfiber Reinforced Epoxy (GRE), and Glass Reinforced Plastic (GRP) piping systems. You will ensure that all construction and installation activities fully comply with project specifications, international codes, and client engineering standards.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES :

  • Material Inspection: Verify incoming RTR/GRE/GRP pipes, fittings, adhesives, and raw materials against material certificates, purchase orders, and project requirements.
  • Process Monitoring: Inspect joint fit-ups, adhesive bonding, lamination layups, wrapping, and curing cycles (including heating blanket applications).
  • Testing & Verification: Witness and document hydrostatic pressure testing, leak testing, and visual inspections of completed non-metallic piping networks.
  • Shaving & Qualification: Verify shaver machine settings, taper angles, and joint preparation; monitor and qualify the workmanship of RTR bonders and laminators.
  • Documentation Management: Prepare, review, and maintain Quality Control Procedure (QCP) documents, Inspection and Test Plans (ITP), and daily Quality Inspection Reports (QIR).
  • Defect Management: Identify non-conformances, issue Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and follow up on corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 to 7 years of QC inspection experience strictly dedicated to RTR/GRE/GRP piping within the oil and gas, petrochemical, or large-scale utility sectors.
  • Technical Certifications: Valid qualification/certification from major RTR manufacturers (e.g., Future Pipe Industries [FPI], Amiantit, or equivalent).
  • Standards Knowledge: Strong familiarity with international standards such as ASME B31.3, ASTM, and specific regional client specifications (such as Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards SAES-L-105, SAES-S-070, or equivalent).
  • Computer Skills: Must have passed or be ready to take the client Computer-Based Test (CBT) for RTR/Non-Metallic piping inspection.
  • Education: Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Chemical, or Materials Engineering.

jobs.title: Safety Compliance Supervisor (Train/Metro)

jobs.title: Safety Specialist - Facilities Management (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Safety Specialist will support the Safety Lead in implementing and maintaining occupational health and safety programs across KAUST facilities, operations, maintenance activities, construction works, and projects. The role will focus on field inspections, audits, risk assessments, incident investigations, safety documentation, contractor engagement, training, corrective action tracking, and compliance with ISO 45001, HSE policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.

The position requires a strong field-oriented HSE professional who can identify hazards, evaluate risks, provide practical safety guidance, investigate incidents, and work effectively with facility owners, project teams, contractors, and service providers.

Key Responsibilities

  • HSE Program Implementation: Support the Safety Lead in implementing and continuously improving risk-based safety programs across facilities, operations, maintenance, construction, and projects.
  • Safety Inspections & Audits: Conduct risk-based site inspections, safety audits, compliance evaluations, and field verifications to ensure HSE requirements are being followed.
  • Risk Assessment: Perform hazard identification and risk assessments and verify that appropriate control measures are implemented and effective.
  • Safety Documentation Review: Review HSE documents including risk assessments, method statements, safety plans, permits-to-work, lifting plans, excavation plans, confined-space controls, electrical work procedures, and MOC documentation.
  • Incident Investigation: Investigate or support investigations of accidents, injuries, incidents, and near misses, identify root causes, and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
  • Corrective Action Tracking: Monitor corrective and preventive actions arising from inspections, audits, investigations, and observations, ensuring timely closure and escalation of overdue actions.
  • HSE Training & Awareness: Develop and deliver safety training, toolbox talks, workshops, permit-to-work training, and awareness programs to improve employee and contractor competency.
  • Stakeholder & Contractor Support: Provide practical HSE guidance to facility owners, project teams, contractors, service providers, and other stakeholders to support safe execution of activities.
  • HSE Reporting & Data Analysis: Collect and analyze HSE data, KPIs, inspection findings, audit results, incident trends, and corrective action status, providing reports and recommendations to management.
  • Safety Culture & Compliance: Promote a strong safety culture, intervene in unsafe activities, communicate lessons learned, maintain accurate HSE records, and support compliance with ISO 45001, regulations, policies, procedures, and industry best practices.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Science, or a related safety discipline is required.
  • Professional Certification: ISO 45001 Lead Auditor certification is required.
  • Incident Investigation: Certification or formal training in Incident Root Cause Analysis is required.
  • HSE Experience: Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in occupational safety, facilities safety, construction safety, contractor management, projects, auditing, compliance, or related HSE functions.
  • Risk Management: Strong experience in hazard identification, risk assessment, risk control, and implementation of risk-based safety programs.
  • High-Risk Activities: Practical knowledge of safety controls for work at height, lifting operations, excavation, confined spaces, hot work, electrical work, and permit-to-work systems.
  • ISO & Audit Knowledge: Working knowledge of ISO 45001, safety management systems, auditing, inspections, incident investigation, and corrective action management. Knowledge of ISO 19011 and ISO 31000 is an advantage.
  • Safety Certifications: Additional recognized HSE qualifications such as CSP, CHST, NEBOSH Certificate/Diploma, IOSH, or equivalent are preferred. Train-the-Trainer certification is also an advantage.
  • Communication & Reporting: Excellent English communication skills with the ability to prepare professional HSE reports, inspection records, investigation reports, presentations, and safety documentation.

  • HSE Experience: Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in occupational safety, facilities safety, construction safety, contractor management, projects, auditing, compliance, or related HSE functions.
  • Risk Management: Strong experience in hazard identification, risk assessment, risk control, and implementation of risk-based safety programs.
  • High-Risk Activities: Practical knowledge of safety controls for work at height, lifting operations, excavation, confined spaces, hot work, electrical work, and permit-to-work systems.

jobs.title: Sales Executive
jobs.description:

Position: Sales Executive

Location: Saudi Arabia
Experience: 1+ Years
Industry: Oil & Gas / Industrial Services

Key Responsibilities

jobs.title: SAP IBP Consultant
jobs.description:
The SAP IBP Functional Consultant will serve as the primary subject matter expert responsible for supporting, configuring, and optimizing the client’s SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP) environment. This role acts as a critical technical-functional bridge between IT and business stakeholders, ensuring end-to-end alignment across demand forecasting, supply planning, inventory control, and Material Requirements Planning (MRP).

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

1. SAP IBP Application & Technical Support

  • Maintain, support, and enhance core SAP IBP capabilities (Demand Planning, Supply & Response, and Inventory Optimization).
  • Perform root-cause analysis on system issues, handle incident management, and resolve functional, integration, or data-flow errors.
  • Translate business requirements into clear functional specification documents (FSDs) for system enhancements and custom analytics.

2. Supply Chain & Planning Process Execution

  • Collaborate with business planning units to optimize process flows for Demand & Supply Planning, statistical forecasting, and consensus planning.
  • Configure and support Inventory Optimization models and MRP logic to maintain safety stock levels and improve service levels.
  • Ensure seamless data integration between SAP IBP and underlying ERP ecosystems (SAP S/4HANA / SAP ECC).

3. Stakeholder Enablement & Quality Assurance

  • Execute end-to-end testing cycles, including Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for system releases.
  • Conduct user training, draft functional documentation, and guide business planners on standard methodologies within the platform.

Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

Professional Experience: 5 to 7 years of hands-on experience supporting and configuring SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP).

Core Competencies:

  • Deep functional knowledge of SAP IBP (Demand, Supply, Inventory modules).
  • Comprehensive understanding of supply chain fundamentals: Forecast Accuracy, MRP execution, Inventory Control, and Demand/Supply balancing.
  • Familiarity with data integration concepts via SAP CPI-DS or SDI to S/4HANA or ECC.

Soft Skills: Strong analytical thinking, excellent client-facing communication skills, and the ability to articulate technical concepts to business leadership.

jobs.title: SAP S/4HANA Finance & Controlling Consultant (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA FICO Consultant with strong functional expertise across SAP Finance and Controlling. The ideal candidate must have a minimum of 3 full-cycle SAP implementation projects and at least Two SAP S/4HANA Conversion (System Conversion) / implementation project. The consultant will play a key role in driving the design, configuration, deployment & support of end-to-end finance processes, ensuring seamless integration across business functions.

Responsibilities

1. Solution Design & Implementation

  • Lead requirement gathering, fit-gap analysis, and solution design workshops for SAP S/4HANA Finance.

    Configure and implement:
  • General Ledger Accounting (New GL) including document splitting, parallel ledgers, centralized postings, and financial reporting.
  • Accounts Payable (AP) including vendor invoicing, payment programs, ageing reports, and integration with procurement.
  • Accounts Receivable (AR) including customer invoicing, dunning, credit management, and integration with sales/contract modules.
  • Fixed Assets Accounting covering asset acquisition, capitalization, depreciation, retirement, and year-end asset closing.
  • Bank Accounting including house banks, automated bank statement processing, EBS, and integration with online banking (host-to-host or SFTP) for automated reconciliation and payments.
  • Treasury & Risk Management (TRM) including money market transactions, fixed deposits, interest calculations, maturities, and liquidity planning.
  • Flexible Real Estate Management (REFX) including lease-in/lease-out, real estate contracts, valuation, and IFRS-16 compliance.
  • Controlling (CO) including cost elements, cost centers, internal orders, budgeting, allocations, and reporting

2. Business Process Integration

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (MM, PM, PS, HR, Procurement – ARIBA & SRM).
  • Ensure end-to-end process connectivity across procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, asset lifecycle, and budget control processes.
  • Support integration with online banking systems, and third-party systems if applicable.
  • Understanding of IDocs, BAPIs, interfaces, Fiori apps, and workflows.
  • Experience with SAP Fiori for Finance.


3. Testing, Training & Support

  • Prepare detailed configuration documents, functional specifications, and test scripts.
  • Conduct unit testing, SIT, UAT, and cutover activities.
  • Deliver user training and prepare training materials.
  • Provide post-go-live support and continuous process improvements.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, or related field.
  • SAP FI or CO certification.
  • Minimum 10+ years of SAP Finance/Controlling experience.
  • Minimum 3 full project lifecycles in SAP ECC or S/4.
  • Minimum 2 SAP S/4HANA conversion / implementation project experience.
  • Strong expertise in:
    o FI: GL/AP/AR/AA/Bank Accounting
    o CO: Cost Center, Cost Element, Internal Orders
    o TRM – Money Market / Fixed Deposits
    o REFX – Lease and Real Estate Contract Management
  • Deep understanding of Universal Journal, New Asset Accounting, Bank Communication Management, Automatic Payments (F110).
  • Experience with Financial Closing, Year-end Activities, and IFRS/GAAP compliance.
  • Experience in the Oil & Gas or large industrial sectors would be an advantage.

jobs.title: Scada Technician (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a skilled Scada Technician to join a prominent client in Saudi Arabia within the Oil & Gas industry. This role involves the installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) systems to ensure reliable and efficient operation of plant processes. The Scada Technician will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to optimize system performance and provide timely technical support.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing hardware and software components of SCADA systems, performing system upgrades, and conducting preventive maintenance activities. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic environment and contribute to critical infrastructure projects.

Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, and maintain SCADA system hardware and software components.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to SCADA communications, data acquisition, and control systems.
  • Conduct routine inspections and preventive maintenance to ensure system reliability and availability.
  • Collaborate with engineering, operations, and IT teams to implement system upgrades and improvements.
  • Maintain detailed documentation, including system configurations, maintenance activities, and incident reports.
  • Ensure compliance with safety policies and industry standards in all SCADA-related activities.
  • Provide technical support and training to operators and junior technicians as needed.

Requirements

  • Diploma or degree in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience working as a SCADA Technician or in a similar role within the Oil & Gas or industrial sector.
  • Strong knowledge of SCADA systems, including hardware, software, and communication protocols.
  • Experience with DCS, PLCs, HMI, and related control systems.
  • Familiarity with network configurations, cybersecurity practices, and industrial communication standards.
  • Proficient troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in team environments.
  • Willingness to work in Saudi Arabia and adapt to local work conditions.

jobs.title: Scaffolding Supervisor - Saudi Aramco Approved
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking an experienced Scaffolding Supervisor to oversee the safe erection, modification, inspection, and dismantling of scaffolding systems across industrial and construction projects. Reporting to the Site Manager, the role is responsible for supervising scaffolding crews, ensuring compliance with safety regulations and project specifications, and maintaining high standards of quality and productivity. The successful candidate must hold a valid Saudi Aramco Scaffolding Supervisor Card and have proven experience working on Saudi Aramco projects. The ideal candidate is locally available in Saudi Arabia and possesses strong leadership and communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise scaffold erection, modification, inspection, and dismantling activities in accordance with project requirements.
  • Ensure all scaffolding work complies with Saudi Aramco standards, company procedures, and HSE regulations.
  • Coordinate daily activities of scaffolding crews to ensure safe and efficient work execution.
  • Conduct routine inspections of scaffolding structures and ensure they are safe for use.
  • Verify scaffold tags, permits, and inspection records are maintained accurately.
  • Ensure proper use of scaffolding materials, tools, and equipment.
  • Identify and mitigate potential safety hazards related to scaffolding operations.
  • Coordinate with construction, maintenance, and HSE teams to support project schedules.
  • Conduct toolbox talks and promote a strong safety culture among workers.
  • Monitor workforce productivity and ensure work is completed within project timelines.
  • Maintain accurate reports, inspection records, and daily progress documentation.
  • Liaise with clients, site management, and inspectors regarding scaffolding activities and compliance.

Requirements

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Diploma, Technical Certificate, or equivalent qualification.
  • Proven experience as a Scaffolding Supervisor on industrial or construction projects.
  • Valid Saudi Aramco Scaffolding Supervisor Card is mandatory.
  • Strong knowledge of scaffolding standards, erection procedures, inspection, and safety practices.
  • Familiarity with Saudi Aramco HSE requirements and permit-to-work systems.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and team management skills.
  • Ability to read scaffolding drawings and project specifications.
  • Candidates currently residing in Saudi Arabia will be preferred.

jobs.title: Scheduler Engineer - (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent, a division of ERAM Group, is looking for a Scheduler Engineer to join our dynamic team in Saudi Arabia. As a Scheduler Engineer, you will play a critical role in project planning and management, ensuring that timelines are met and that projects progress smoothly throughout their lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Responsible for developing, monitoring, and controlling project schedules to ensure timely and efficient project delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain project schedules using Primavera P6.
  • Prepare baseline schedules and update progress regularly.
  • Track schedule performance, identify delays, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Conduct critical path analysis and schedule risk assessments.
  • Prepare weekly and monthly schedule reports.
  • Coordinate with engineering, procurement, and construction teams for accurate schedule inputs.
  • Support project managers with time-impact analysis and forecasting.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Industrial, or similar).
  • 3–7 years of experience in planning and scheduling.
  • GPA - 2.8 out of 4, 3.8 out of 5
  • Strong proficiency in Primavera P6.
  • Good understanding of EPC workflows and project lifecycle.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills.

Preferred Certifications

  • PMP, PSP, or equivalent (preferred but not required).

jobs.title: Secretary / Office Support Assistant (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a *Secretary / Office Support Assistant* to provide administrative and secretarial support to managers and department personnel in an office environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing calendars, coordinating meetings, handling office requests, maintaining records, and supporting daily administrative operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage calendars, appointments, meetings, and meeting room bookings for managers.
  • Handle phone calls, receive visitors, and direct inquiries to the appropriate personnel.
  • Process gate passes, corporate service requests, taxi requests, and other office-related requests.
  • Manage office stationery, supplies, B2B shopping carts, and follow up on orders and deliveries.
  • Prepare and maintain timesheets, e-leave applications, and employee leave records.
  • Coordinate business travel requests, travel arrangements, and related services for employees.
  • Prepare expense reports and support miscellaneous payment-related requests.
  • Collect reports and provide general administrative, secretarial, and office support to managers and department staff.

  • Associate Diploma or higher qualification is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree is an advantage.
  • 3–5 years of relevant experience* as a Secretary, Administrative Assistant, Receptionist, Office Support Assistant, or in a similar administrative role.
  • Experience in office administration, reception, help desk support, or expediting is preferred.
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and standard office equipment.
  • Good telephone etiquette and the ability to receive and convey messages accurately.
  • Good English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Strong organizational, coordination, and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple administrative tasks and work effectively in an office environment.

jobs.title: Senior ASU Commissioning & Start-up Engineer
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is partnering with a prestigious, industry-leading Oil & Gas organization in Saudi Arabia to identify a highly technical Senior ASU Commissioning & Start-up Engineer.

This is a critical, senior-level role for a subject matter expert with over a decade of dedicated hands-on experience in Air Separation Units (ASU). You will be the driving force behind the design, optimization, and safe operation of complex cryogenic air separation processes, ensuring peak production and stringent safety compliance in high-purity oxygen environments.

The work location would be in Tanajib /Khursaniyah.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Asset Specification & Sizing: Lead the specification and sizing of critical ASU assets, including high-pressure air compressors, air adsorption and dehydration systems, turboexpanders, Brazed Aluminum Heat Exchangers (BAHX), and cryogenic distillation columns.
  • Storage & Vaporization Management: Oversee liquid oxygen and nitrogen storage and vaporization systems to guarantee reliable peak production and backup supply.
  • Commissioning & Start-Up: Provide hands-on leadership during cryogenic ASU commissioning, start-ups, and performance guarantee testing.
  • Troubleshooting & Optimization: Act as the ultimate technical authority for troubleshooting complex operational issues and optimizing Molecular Sieve Adsorption Systems (pre-purification units) for maximum moisture removal and regeneration cycle efficiency.
  • Advanced Process Simulation: Utilize advanced proficiency in Aspen HYSYS or PRO/II, specifically calibrating process simulations for cryogenic air separation cycles and validating models against real-world plant data.
  • Safety & Compliance: Apply deep practical knowledge of Compressed Gases and Cryogenic Fluids Codes. Champion safety standards regarding oxygen compatibility and fire hazard management within high-purity oxygen environments.

Requirements

  • Bachelors Degree in Engineering
  • 10+ years of strictly hands-on, specialized experience in Air Separation Units (ASU) and Cryogenics.
  • Proven track record in cryogenic ASU commissioning, start-up, and performance testing.
  • Mastery of process simulation software (Aspen HYSYS, PRO/II) with a focus on cryogenic calibration.
  • Deep understanding of the mechanical and thermodynamic principles behind turboexpanders, BAHX, and distillation columns.
  • Uncompromising commitment to process safety, with expert knowledge of global codes and standards for handling compressed gases and cryogenic fluids.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and cross-functional leadership skills.

jobs.title: Senior Diver & Dive Operations Supervisor (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly organized and adaptable Diver & Dive Centre Supervisor who will report to the Lead, Marine & Dive Management and support the successful delivery of complex dive operations for the project team at NEOM.

 The Dive Centre Supervisor will oversee all daily dive centre operations in support of the KAUST Coral Restoration Initiative (KCRI). This role ensures safe, efficient, and high-quality dive operations that directly support coral restoration, marine monitoring, scientific diving activities, visitor engagements, and operational readiness within NEOM waters.
Working closely with other Reefscape Supervisors, the Dive Centre Supervisor manages dive centre staff, ensures equipment readiness, enforces safety protocols, plans and executes dive schedules and briefings and supports training, research activities and enhancing team technical capability.
The ideal candidate demonstrates a strong background in dive operations management, dive safety, emergency response, equipment maintenance, team leadership, and remote-area logistics.

 The position will be based at NEOM.

 

Responsibilities

  • Directly oversee all diving operations including training, marine surveys, and coral restoration activities.
  • Act as a dive supervisor ensuring safety protocols are strictly adhered to and all diving operations comply with KCRI SOPs and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead a team of divers, providing training, mentoring, and support to ensure high operational standards and safety mindsets.
  • Conduct risk assessments and develop dive plans for various operational scenarios, ensuring all aspects of diving are considered.
  • Manage all dive equipment, including inspections, maintenance, and servicing schedules; ensure readiness for all operational tasks.
  • Facilitate logistics for dive operations, including transportation, site preparation, and coordinating external support as needed.
  • Maintain accurate records of dives, safety drills, training sessions, and equipment maintenance.
  • Collaborate closely with scientists and marine biologists to support survey and restoration projects, ensuring effective dive operations.
  • Participate in emergency preparedness drills and lead incident response initiatives.
  • Communicate regularly with project management regarding operational progress, challenges, and safety concerns.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marine Sciences, Environmental Management, or a related field.
  • Recognized dive instructor certification (PADI, SSI, CMAS, or equivalent) with at least 6 years of diving experience.
  • Experience in a supervisory or management role within dive operations, particularly in marine restoration or research projects.
  • Technical diving certifications such as CCR, Trimix, or equivalent advanced qualifications are strongly preferred.
  • Proven experience in managing dive operations and equipment readiness for both recreational and professional diving tasks.
  • Recognized emergency response qualifications (e.g., Diver Medic, DMT, Instructor Trainer) preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of marine safety standards, diving protocols, and emergency response procedures.
  • Demonstrated experience in dive center operations management, equipment servicing and repair, CCR and technical diving operations, remote-environment
  • Excellent leadership and team management skills, with a focus on fostering a safety-first culture.
  • Ability to work effectively in remote locations and adapt to changing environmental conditions.

jobs.title: Senior Transportation Planning & Traffic Engineer (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Senior Transportation Planning & Traffic Safety Engineer is responsible for leading transportation planning and traffic safety initiatives, ensuring compliance with international engineering standards and best practices. The role involves conducting technical reviews, supporting traffic engineering studies, and coordinating with internal stakeholders and government authorities to enhance road safety and traffic mobility.

Experience

The ideal candidate must have a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience, primarily in:

    • Other transportation engineering and traffic safety studies
  • Provide technical support and engineering recommendations to internal and external stakeholders to improve traffic operations, mobility, and road safety.
  • Review roadway designs, engineering specifications, and proposed infrastructure improvements within and surrounding company facilities, ensuring compliance with applicable industry standards and best practices.

  • Support the continuous development of the Traffic Safety Services Engineering team by establishing technical training programs, promoting knowledge sharing, and improving engineering processes and best practices.

Technical Requirements

The candidate must demonstrate strong technical expertise in:

  • Highway Design
  • Transportation Planning
  • Traffic Engineering

  • Road Safety Audits
  • Traffic Impact Assessments
  • Temporary Traffic Management
  • Traffic Operations and Mobility Analysis

Required Skills

    • AASHTO Green Book
    • Highway Capacity Manual (HCM)
    • Highway Safety Manual (HSM)

    • Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) Standards and Guidelines

Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related with specialization in Transportation Planning and Traffic Engineering. A Master's degree in Transportation Engineering or a related discipline is preferred.

jobs.title: Sr. Mechanical Engineer - Maintenance (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking an experienced Sr. Mechanical Engineer to join a leading organization in Saudi Arabia. We are seeking a seasoned Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our Utility Department at Sadara. This role is critical to the plant’s stability, focusing on the mechanical integrity, maintenance, and reliability of world-scale utility assets. You will be the go-to technical expert for troubleshooting complex equipment failures and optimizing the lifecycle of systems that power our entire petrochemical complex.

Responsibilities

  • Lead Maintenance Execution: Oversee the preventive and corrective maintenance of utility assets, including high-pressure boilers, steam turbines, and large-scale pumping systems.
  • Advanced Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Lead formal RCA investigations for mechanical failures, utilizing methodologies like 5-Why or Fishbone to eliminate recurring "bad actors."
  • Reliability Optimization: Implement Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) strategies to improve Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) for rotating and static equipment.
  • Steam & Water System Integrity: Ensure the mechanical reliability of steam headers, demineralized water plants, and cooling water networks.
  • Turnaround & Shutdown Management: Define the mechanical scope for major plant turnarounds (TA) and supervise the overhaul of critical utility machinery.
  • Contractor Supervision: Manage third-party maintenance contractors, ensuring all work meets strict petrochemical safety and quality standards.
  • Asset Health Monitoring: Analyze vibration reports, oil analysis, and thermography data to predict failures before they occur.
  • Technical Compliance: Ensure all mechanical repairs and modifications comply with international codes, specifically API 610/617, ASME B31.3, and ASME Section VIII.
  • SAP-PM Management: Oversee the lifecycle of work orders within SAP, ensuring accurate data capture for maintenance history and spare parts inventory.
  • Safety Leadership: Drive a "Zero Harm" culture by conducting Job Safety Managements (JSA) and ensuring all maintenance activities follow Process Safety Management (PSM) protocols.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders to ensure alignment and project success.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering.
  • Industry Experience: 10+ years of maintenance engineering experience specifically within a Petrochemical Plant or Oil Refinery.
  • Utility Expertise: Proven track record maintaining utility-specific equipment (Boilers, RO Plants, Steam Turbines, and Air Compressors).
  • RCA Mastery: Demonstrated experience leading Root Cause Analysis and implementing technical solutions in a high-pressure environment.
  • Software Skills: Proficiency in SAP (Plant Maintenance module) and engineering design software (AutoCAD).
  • Standards Knowledge: Deep familiarity with API and ASME codes relevant to refinery utilities.
  • Communication: Fluent in English with the ability to present technical reliability reports to plant leadership.

jobs.title: Systems & Digital Operations Specialist - Power School
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a Systems & Digital Operations Specialist to join our team in Saudi Arabia. The Systems & Digital Operations Specialist is responsible for the effective day-to-day administration, reliability, and continuity of TKS digital systems, user devices, and classroom technology that support teaching, learning, admissions, communications, and school operations. The role also provides operational support to the Operations team, contributing to school-wide readiness, coordination, and delivery. This is a non-managerial, hands-on role focused on execution, support, and coordination in line with TKS policies and procedures.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Administer and support core school systems including PowerSchool, Toddle, and Google Workspace for Education.
  • Manage user accounts, permissions, and access controls in line with school policies and data protection standards.
  • Monitor system availability and ensure timely escalation of technical issues.
  • Support setup, configuration, and maintenance of devices (iPads, laptops, and peripherals).
  • Maintain device inventory, lifecycle management, and coordinate repairs or replacements with vendors.
  • Provide support for classroom and shared-space AV systems (projectors, displays, conferencing tools).
  • Assist teachers and staff with basic troubleshooting for lessons, meetings, and school events.
  • Support academic year readiness including onboarding, class setup, and device allocation.
  • Maintain documentation, track tickets, licenses, warranties, and vendor coordination.
  • Provide operational and cross-functional support to Academic, Admissions, HR, and Operations teams.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field (preferred).
  • Proven experience in IT support, systems administration, or digital operations.
  • Hands-on experience supporting user devices such as laptops and tablets.
  • Familiarity with systems like PowerSchool, Toddle, or similar SIS/LMS platforms.
  • Experience working with Google Workspace for Education or similar tools.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to follow procedures and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Experience supporting non-technical users, ideally in a school environment.
  • Basic knowledge of AV/classroom technology systems.
  • Understanding of data protection, confidentiality, and IT security practices.

The successful candidate will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) systems to ensure efficient and reliable operation of industrial processes and infrastructure.

Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, and maintain SCADA hardware and software components.
  • Monitor SCADA systems to ensure continuous and stable operation.
  • SCADA system monitoring & operation
  • Troubleshooting & incident response \ PLC and RTU support / communication and network support / Alarm management and ability to conduct CM & PM activities
  • Perform regular preventive maintenance and system updates to ensure optimal system performance.
  • Collaborate with engineers and operations teams to implement system improvements and upgrades.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of SCADA configurations, maintenance activities, and incident reports.
  • Ensure compliance with safety standards and organizational policies.

Requirements

  • Technical diploma in control and instrumentation or Industrial automation
  • Minimum of 5 years experience working with SCADA systems in an industrial environment.
  • SCADA system monitoring & operation
  • Troubleshooting & incident response \ PLC and RTU support / communication and network support / Alarm management and ability to conduct CM & PM activities.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Willingness to work flexible hours, including on-call support as needed.

Benefits

Salary is not a constraint ,company is looking for right candidate .

jobs.title: Technology Consulting Specialist (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is looking for a Technology Consulting Specialist to join our team in Saudi Arabia. The Technology Consulting specialist plays a major part in IT customer's educational needs and desJg.ning training materials on IT solutions. This role acts as a link between information technology and business customers by managing and ensuring the successful completion of business analysis tasks. This position requires well rounded experience and ability in multiple disciplines within IT including, but not limited to business communication, business analysis and knowledge transfer with IT personnel and customers. .

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze client business processes and existing technology infrastructure to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Designs, creates, develops, customizes and maintains training materials and resources to deliver agreed outcomes, and meet accreditation through design, configuration and testing of training environments, including creation of simulated data, and replication of external systems, interfaces and assessment systems.
  • Maintains, publicizes and promotes catalogue of IT learning and development activities. Arranges facilities and schedules with learning and development providers as appropriate.
  • Develop technology strategies and roadmaps that align with clients' business goals and objectives.
  • Provide guidance on digital transformation initiatives, including AI, cloud computing, IoT, and big data analytics.
  • Assist clients in evaluating and selecting appropriate technology solutions from vendors.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful implementation of technology projects.
  • Deliver training and support to clients to ensure successful adoption of new technologies.
  • Stay updated on emerging technology trends and share knowledge with clients and internal teams.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Economics, Finance, Business Administration, Information Systems or other quantitative discipline.
  • Experience:
    • Minimum of 6+ years of graphic design, technology/business analysis including proven facilitation skills
    • Experience in conducting trainings sessions and developing training materials.
    • Familiarity with PMI or ITIL methods, and process mapping tools .
    • Proven experience in project management and leading technology implementation projects.
    • Ability to design and maintain training materials and simulated training environments, including creation of test data and replication of external systems.
    • Strong understanding of various technologies such as cloud services, AI/ML, IoT, and enterprise software.
  • Skills:
    • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
    • Strong communication and interpersonal abilities to work with clients at all levels.
    • Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks effectively.
    • Proficiency in both English and Arabic is highly desirable.

jobs.title: Training And Development (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is seeking a dedicated Training and Development Specialist to join our dynamic team in Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing training programs aimed at enhancing employee skills and knowledge across the organization. As a key player in our HR team, you will work closely with various departments to assess training needs, develop tailored programs, and foster a culture of continuous learning.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and introduce the company’s training and development framework, policies, and standards.
  • Analyze and identify competency and skill gaps through performance data, surveys, and discussions with management.
  • Develop a long-term training roadmap aligned with business strategy and workforce planning.
  • Create and implement digital onboarding and learning programs leveraging technology (e.g., LMS, e-learning tools).
  • Develop and maintain engaging training materials, manuals, and visual aids.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of programs, trainers, and learning content, recommending improvements.
  • Manage the annual training budget and forecast future learning investments.
  • Build partnerships with external training providers and certification bodies.
  • Prepare and present reports and dashboards on training outcomes and employee skill progress.
  • Support managers and supervisors in applying coaching and learning techniques within their teams.
  • Promote a culture of continuous learning across the organization.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • A minimum of 7 years of experience in training and development or a similar role.
  • Strong knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies.
  • Proven ability to develop engaging training content and facilitate training sessions effectively.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical skills to assess training needs and evaluate program effectiveness.
  • Familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and e-learning tools.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
  • Fluency in English is required; Arabic fluency is preferred.
  • A proactive attitude towards employee development and a commitment to continuous improvement.

As a UI/UX Designer, you will be responsible for creating intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces and experiences for our clients' websites and applications. You will collaborate closely with our development team and clients to understand user needs and translate them into effective design solutions.

Eram Talent is a leading talent acquisition company that provides exceptional recruitment solutions to clients across various industries. Join our team and contribute to our mission of connecting top professionals with great companies.

Responsibilities:

A solid understanding of the user-centered design process and related methodologies. Ability to design highly usable interfaces for multiple devices and channels - internet, intranet, mobile devices, tablets and touch screens etc. Ability to produce high-quality creative designs to tight deadlines.

Requirements

b) Minimum 3 years’ experience as a UI/UX Designer.

c) Previous experience in user experience and creative design for web applications, portals and mobile applications.

d) A solid understanding of the user-centered design process and related methodologies. Ability to design highly usable interfaces for multiple devices and channels - internet, intranet, mobile devices, tablets and touch screens etc. Ability to produce high-quality creative designs to tight deadlines.

d) Proficient with design tools (such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, Illustrator, Photoshop).

jobs.title: UI/UX Specialist (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The UI/UX Specialist is responsible for shaping, designing, and continuously improving user experiences across KAUST’s IT services and touch points. The role ensures that all interfaces and journeys adopt industry-leading user-centric design principles, accessibility standards, and align with the IT Department’s UI/UX framework. A key responsibility of this role is to establish, document, and communicate clear UI/UX processes and standards to stakeholders, ensuring consistent adoption across teams and projects.

The specialist partners with service owners and user engagement specialists to conduct user research, develop prototypes, perform usability testing, and provide design governance. Through this work, the UI/UX Specialist enables the delivery of intuitive, efficient, and accessible digital experiences that support KAUST’s goals of operational excellence, technology enablement, and customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities:

  • Work with team members to define and maintain UI/UX principles, guidelines, and best practices for IT services.
  • Review interfaces and service designs for alignment with established UX guidelines and provide feedback for improvement.
  • Define and maintain UI/UX principles, guidelines, and best practices for IT services.
  • Conduct user research (interviews, surveys, observations) to identify needs and pain points.
  • Translate research insights into personas, journey maps, task flows, and actionable recommendations.
  • Design intuitive, accessible interfaces, wireframes, prototypes, and interaction flows.
  • Conduct usability testing and validate solutions through iterative feedback cycles.
  • Collaborate with IT service owners, developers, and business analysts to ensure user-centered design.
  • Ensure all designs comply with accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG 2.2), branding guidelines, and design systems.
  • Provide feedback on interfaces, service designs, and design assets to maintain quality and consistency.
  • Advocate for users, ensuring inclusivity, fairness, and accessibility in all design decisions.
  • Facilitate workshops, co-design sessions, and collaborative design discussions with stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in HCI, Information Systems, Graphic Design, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in UI/UX design, user research, or usability evaluation.
  • Strong knowledge of human-centered design principles, usability heuristics, and accessibility standards.
  • Proficiency with modern design/prototyping tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or equivalent.
  • Solid understanding of responsive design, interaction design, design systems, and user research methods.
  • Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end UX activities in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Attention to detail with a focus on producing high-quality, consistent, and accessible designs.
  • Preferred: Experience in higher education or IT service environments, contributing to design systems or institutional branding.
  • Preferred Certifications: NN/g UX Certification, IDEO U Design Thinking, CUA, CXA, or similar credentials.

jobs.title: Video Content Producer (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Video Content Producer brings KAUST’s stories to life in post-production — shaping raw footage into polished, brand-aligned content that communicates the University’s research, people, and mission to audiences across digital and institutional channels. The role combines strong editorial judgement with technical expertise across editing, colour grading, and motion graphics.

Working from production briefs under the direction of the Multimedia and Brand Production Manager, the Video Content Producer manages video projects from creative concept through to final delivery, contributes actively to pre-production planning, and serves as the team’s primary owner of motion graphics and 2D animation. The role requires a strong editorial sensibility, precise technical craft, and the discipline to manage multiple projects simultaneously to tight deadlines.

The Video Content Producer is expected to engage proactively in the team’s creative planning pipeline, maintain rigorous DAM and workflow discipline, and bring genuine creative investment to every production. Occasional out-of-office hours working will be required, for which overtime will be paid.

Key Responsibilities

Pre-Production

  • Review and analyse production briefs and participate in briefing sessions with relevant stakeholders.
  • Contribute to storyboards, editorial structures, mood boards, and creative references.
  • Identify and retrieve suitable archival footage and licensed media assets.
  • Coordinate with production teams regarding shoot requirements, technical specifications, and footage handover.

Editing and Post-Production

  • Edit and produce video content including documentaries, interviews, promotional videos, research communications, and social media content.
  • Apply transitions, motion graphics, visual effects, and animations.
  • Produce 2D motion graphics and animated sequences.
  • Perform professional colour correction and colour grading.
  • Mix and master audio, including music, voice-over, dialogue, and ambient sound.
  • Prepare final video projects in appropriate formats for web, social media, YouTube, LED screens, and other channels.
  • Manage multiple editing projects while maintaining quality and meeting delivery deadlines.

Project Management and Stakeholder Coordination

  • Manage assigned video projects from creative concept through final delivery.
  • Maintain clear communication with stakeholders regarding project requirements and timelines.
  • Provide creative guidance and constructive feedback on video requirements.
  • Maintain project schedules and proactively identify delivery or resourcing risks.

Asset Management and Workflow

  • Upload and organize production assets within defined timelines.
  • Apply proper metadata, tags, and naming conventions.
  • Maintain organized project files, footage, and finished assets within servers and DAM systems.
  • Track production activities, tasks, edit notes, comments, and deliverables using Asana or equivalent project management tools.
  • Maintain editing workstations and software and report technical or licensing issues when required.

jobs.title: Warehouse Chemist (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
The Warehouse Chemist is responsible for ensuring the safe, compliant, and efficient management of chemicals and dangerous goods within warehouse operations. The role oversees the receipt, inspection, classification, storage, handling, and disposal of hazardous materials while ensuring compliance with local and international chemical safety regulations. The Warehouse Chemist provides technical expertise to support warehouse operations, minimize risks, maintain regulatory compliance, and promote best practices in chemical management. The position also supports audits, emergency response activities, and continuous improvement initiatives related to hazardous materials management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Receive, inspect, identify, classify, and verify chemicals and dangerous goods to ensure compliance with purchase specifications and regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure the safe storage, segregation, handling, and transportation of chemicals in accordance with applicable safety standards and regulations.
  • Conduct routine inspections of chemical storage areas and recommend corrective actions to address safety, environmental, and compliance risks.
  • Monitor chemical inventory, shelf life, storage conditions, and maintain accurate records, Safety Data Sheets (SDS), and regulatory documentation.
  • Assess chemical compatibility and perform risk assessments to minimize hazards and support safe warehouse operations.
  • Coordinate the safe disposal of expired, obsolete, or hazardous chemicals in compliance with environmental and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide technical guidance and awareness training to warehouse personnel on chemical safety, hazardous material handling, PPE, and emergency response procedures.
  • Collaborate with Procurement, HSE, Logistics, and regulatory authorities to ensure compliance, support audits, investigate incidents, and continuously improve chemical management practices.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmacy, Medical Laboratory Science, Chemical Technology, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Minimum of four (4) years of experience in chemical warehouse operations, hazardous materials management, laboratory, or industrial chemical environments.
  • Strong knowledge of chemical properties, hazard classification, compatibility, and hazardous material handling practices.
  • Familiarity with applicable regulations, including GHS, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR), IMDG Code, ADR, and local regulatory requirements.
  • Proficiency in interpreting and applying Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and implementing safe chemical storage and segregation practices.
  • Experience conducting chemical risk assessments, incident investigations, and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
  • Good understanding of warehouse operations, inventory management systems, hazardous waste management, and environmental compliance.
  • Strong communication, analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office and warehouse management systems.

jobs.title: Welding Inspector (Aramco Approved)
jobs.description:
Eram Talent is on the lookout for a skilled Welding Inspector, specifically with Aramco approval, to join our esteemed team in the Oil & Energy sector. As a prominent Talent Acquisition Consultancy, we excel at connecting highly qualified professionals with impactful projects. This role is essential for ensuring the quality, safety, and compliance of mechanical and piping systems in alignment with Aramco standards.

As a Welding Inspector, your expertise will ensure that all mechanical and piping installations are up to the requisite standards, thus safeguarding both operational integrity and environmental compliance. You will collaborate closely with project teams to drive the highest standards of quality and safety in our projects.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct thorough inspections of mechanical and piping systems in accordance with Aramco standards and specifications.
  • Evaluate the quality of materials and workmanship during the installation and assembly of piping systems.
  • Prepare detailed inspection reports, documenting findings, non-conformances, and recommendations for corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with project management and engineering teams to ensure compliance with project specifications.
  • Perform inspections at various stages of the construction process to ensure all work meets safety and quality standards.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to construction teams to rectify any identified issues.
  • Participate in quality meetings and discussions with stakeholders to communicate inspection findings and address concerns.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in mechanical and piping inspection, preferably in the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Must be Aramco-approved as a Mechanical and Piping Inspector.
  • Strong knowledge and understanding of piping codes, standards, and specifications, including ASME, API, and others related to Aramco projects.
  • Experience with Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) methods and the ability to interpret inspection results accurately.
  • Excellent analytical skills with a meticulous eye for detail.
  • Strong communication skills for effective collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks while adhering to strict deadlines.
  • Proficient in using inspection tools and software for documentation and reporting.

jobs.description:
Eram Talent is looking for a highly skilled Welding QC Engineer with Hot Tap experience to join our team for a prestigious project with Aramco. As a leading Talent Acquisition Consultancy in the Oil & Energy sector, we are dedicated to connecting top-tier professionals with exciting opportunities in industries such as Oil & Gas, Infrastructure, and Energy.

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and integrity of welding operations, particularly in hot tapping processes. Your expertise will be crucial in maintaining compliance with industry standards and ensuring the safety and reliability of the projects we support.

If you have a passion for quality control in welding and a proven track record in the Oil & Gas industry, we encourage you to apply!

Responsibilities

  • Perform quality control inspections of welding activities related to hot tap operations in accordance with project specifications and standards.
  • Review and understand project documents, including welding procedures, inspection plans, and quality plans.
  • Compile and maintain records of inspections, tests, and results, ensuring compliance with Aramco's quality assurance requirements.
  • Work closely with project engineering and construction teams to identify potential quality issues and provide solutions.
  • Participate in pre-welding briefings and communicate the importance of quality expectations to all personnel involved in the welding process.
  • Monitor and ensure compliance with safety standards during all welding activities.
  • Conduct regular audits of welding processes and report findings to the QA/QC Manager.
  • Assist in the development and improvement of welding procedures and quality control protocols.
  • Prepare detailed inspection reports and documentation for approval and maintain clear communication with clients and stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Welding Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience as a Welding QC Engineer, specifically with hot tap operations.
  • Valid Aramco approval or certification as a Welding QC Engineer is required.
  • Thorough understanding of welding codes and standards (ASME, API, etc.) and experience in the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Familiarity with Aramco's quality assurance and quality control standards.
  • Experience with Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) methods and certifications is a plus.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with teams.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Yard Supervisor - Marine (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Yard Supervisor to oversee daily yard operations, manpower, equipment, and material movement. The candidate will ensure efficient yard activities while maintaining high standards of safety, housekeeping, and operational compliance.

Responsibilities

  • Supervise and coordinate daily yard operations and manpower.
  • Manage the movement, handling, loading, unloading, and storage of materials and equipment.
  • Ensure proper yard organization, housekeeping, and material identification.
  • Coordinate with logistics, marine, operations, and maintenance teams.
  • Monitor yard equipment and report maintenance requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with HSE policies, PPE requirements, and safe work procedures.
  • Prepare daily yard activity reports and maintain operational records.
  • Resolve operational issues and ensure smooth and timely yard activities.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in yard operations, marine, shipyard, logistics, or industrial environments.
  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Marine, Engineering, Operations, or a related field.
  • Proven experience supervising yard activities, manpower, equipment, loading/unloading, and material handling.
  • Strong knowledge of HSE procedures and safe working practices.
  • Good leadership, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with yard documentation, inventory/material tracking, and daily operational reporting.
  • Marine/shipyard experience is highly preferred.
